entry.title: RadGenome-Anatomy: A Large-Scale Anatomy-Labeled Chest Radiograph Dataset via Physically Grounded Volumetric Projection

author.name: Shuchang Ye, Mingyuan Meng, Hao Wang, Usman Naseem, Jinman Kim

entry.summary: Introduces RadGenome-Anatomy, the largest anatomy-labeled chest radiograph dataset with 10M+ segmentation masks across 210 anatomical structures in 25,692 studies, created via 3D-to-2D volumetric projection.

entry.title: Spatial Blindness in Whole-Slide Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Ran Su

entry.summary: Identifies 'spatial blindness' in whole-slide MIL models where context-aware architectures retain performance after coordinate permutation, showing predictions are compositional rather than spatial. Proposes ResTopoMIL.

entry.title: Focused Forcing: Content-Aware Per-Frame KV Selection for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion

author.name: Peiliang Cai, Evelyn Zhang, Jiacheng Liu, Hao Lin, Ruiqi Zhang, Weile Mo, Yue Ma, Shikang Zheng, Jiehang Huang, Dongrui Liu, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Focused Forcing for efficient autoregressive video diffusion that performs content-aware per-frame KV selection, showing that frames within the same generated chunk need distinct historical contexts and that head importance should be explicitly estimated.

entry.title: Can These Views Be One Scene? Evaluating Multiview 3D Consistency when 3D Foundation Models Hallucinate

author.name: Soumava Paul, Prakhar Kaushik, Alan Yuille

entry.summary: Studies reliability of multiview 3D consistency metrics, showing that existing metrics can give high scores to inconsistent outputs. Compares neural reconstruction priors with classical geometric verification and introduces a controlled robustness benchmark.

entry.title: Policy Library CBF: Finite-Horizon Safety at Runtime via Parallel Rollouts

author.name: Taekyung Kim, Hideki Okamoto, Bardh Hoxha, Georgios Fainekos, Dimitra Panagou

entry.summary: Proposes Policy Library CBF (PL-CBF), a runtime safety filter that evaluates fallback policies via parallel rollouts and selects the least invasive safe mode through a quadratic program. Provides theoretical analysis of policy-library coverage.

entry.title: Key-Gram: Extensible World Knowledge for Embodied Manipulation

author.name: Jingjing Fan, Siyuan Li, Botao Ren, Zhidong Deng

entry.summary: Introduces Key-Gram, a conditional-memory framework separating language-derived world knowledge from visual-state reasoning in embodied control through deterministic hashed lookup of instruction-derived key-grams.

entry.title: Access Timing as Scaffolding: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to GenAI in Education

author.name: Janne Rotter, Pau Benazet i Montobbio, Davinia Hern\'andez-Leo

entry.summary: Proposes using reinforcement learning to determine optimal timing for student access to generative AI in educational settings, treating access timing as implicit scaffolding grounded in metacognitive and cognitive load theories.

entry.title: EgoExoMem: Cross-View Memory Reasoning over Synchronized Egocentric and Exocentric Videos

author.name: Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Di Wen, Shaofang Quan, Chengzhi Wu, Jiaming Zhang, Kailun Yang, Kunyu Peng, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: EgoExoMem introduces the first benchmark for cross-view memory reasoning over synchronized egocentric and exocentric videos, with 2.6K MCQs and E²-Select for training-free dual-view frame selection.

entry.title: Deterministic Event-Graph Substrates as World Models for Counterfactual Reasoning

author.name: Fabio Rovai

entry.summary: Proposes event-graph substrates as world models using append-only RDF triple logs that support exact counterfactual queries via log forking. Outperforms the NS-DR symbolic oracle on CLEVRER benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning Bilevel Policies over Symbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Planning

author.name: Dillon Z. Chen, Till Hofmann, Toryn Q. Klassen, Sheila A. McIlraith

entry.summary: Proposes bilevel policies combining low-level imitation learning for manipulation with high-level symbolic planning for long-horizon tasks, using symbolic world models to facilitate efficient planning.

entry.title: Property-Guided LLM Program Synthesis for Planning

author.name: Andr\'e G. Pereira, Augusto B. Corr\^ea, Jendrik Seipp

entry.summary: Proposes property-guided LLM program synthesis for planning, where violated formal properties provide concrete counterexamples to guide LLM improvement rather than simple numeric scores.

entry.title: Hydra: Efficient, Correct Code Generation via Checkpoint-and-Rollback Support

author.name: Alexander Du, Jianjun Ou, Danyang Zhuo, Matthew Lentz

entry.summary: Hydra enables efficient recovery from static errors during code generation through checkpoint-and-rollback, allowing asynchronous checking and targeted recovery to earlier valid states.

entry.title: ChangeFlow -- Latent Rectified Flow for Change Detection in Remote Sensing

author.name: Bla\v{z} Rolih, Matic Fu\v{c}ka, Filip Wolf, Luka \v{C}ehovin Zajc

entry.summary: Proposes ChangeFlow, a generative approach to remote sensing change detection using latent rectified flow models that can model distributions of plausible change masks rather than single predictions, addressing ambiguity in annotations.

entry.title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Teleoperation under Stochastic Delays

author.name: Kaize Deng, Zewen Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid control framework combining LSTM-based state estimation with residual RL for robot teleoperation under stochastic communication delays, addressing signal discontinuities that cause high-frequency chattering.

entry.title: CTF4Nuclear: Common Task Framework for Nuclear Fission and Fusion Models

author.name: Stefano Riva, Carolina Introini, Antonio Cammi, Dean Price, Alexey Yermakov, Yue Zhao, Philippe M. Wyder, Judah Goldfeder, Jan Williams, Amy Sara Rude, Matteo Tomasetto, Joe Germany, Joseph Bakarji, Georg Maierhofer, Miles Cranmer, J. Nathan Kutz

entry.summary: Introduces CTF4Nuclear, a Common Task Framework providing standardized ML benchmarks for nuclear fission and fusion modeling, addressing the gap between high-fidelity simulations and real-time applications.

entry.title: Position: Early-Stage Quality Assurance in Annotation Pipelines Is More Cost-Effective Than Late-Stage Validation

author.name: Sunil Kothari, Sumukha Sharma Thoppanahalli Chandramouli, Naman Khandelwal, Parth Kulshreshtha, Ashi Jain, Kriti Banka, Tanuja Chintada, Venkata Triveni, Gulipalli Praveen Kumar, Manish Mehta, Tao Liu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that early-stage quality assurance in data annotation pipelines is more cost-effective than late-stage validation, drawing on software engineering's 'shift-left' principle showing 4-100x cost multipliers for late-detected defects.

entry.title: LoCO: Low-rank Compositional Rotation Fine-tuning

author.name: An Nguyen, Jaesik Choi, Anh Tong

entry.summary: Introduces LoCO, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that constructs orthogonal transformations via low-rank skew-symmetric matrices to preserve geometric structure of pretrained representations during adaptation.

entry.title: Constrained latent state modeling: A unifying perspective on representation learning under competing constraints

author.name: Gwenol\'e Quellec

entry.summary: Presents a unifying perspective on representation learning as constrained latent state modeling, arguing that fragmented approaches reflect underconstrained objectives that fail to specify meaningful latent state properties.

entry.title: Ada-Diffuser: Latent-Aware Adaptive Diffusion for Decision-Making

author.name: Fan Feng, Selena Ge, Minghao Fu, Zijian Li, Yujia Zheng, Zeyu Tang, Yingyao Hu, Biwei Huang, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Ada-Diffuser, a framework incorporating latent dynamic inference into diffusion-based decision-making, showing theoretical identifiability of latent processes from temporal blocks of observations.

entry.title: VideoSeeker: Incentivizing Instance-level Video Understanding via Native Agentic Tool Invocation

author.name: Yiming Zhao, Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Zhen Fang, Qing Miao, Qisheng Su, Jiawei Zhao, Jiayin Cai, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Yukun Qi, Yao Hu, Xiaolong Jiang, Feng Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes VideoSeeker for instance-level video understanding that combines visual perception with language reasoning via native agentic tool invocation, addressing limitations of text-only prompting for spatiotemporal localization.

entry.title: IVGT: Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer for Neural Scene Representation

author.name: Yuqi Wu, Tianyu Hu, Wenzhao Zheng, Yuanhui Huang, Haowen Sun, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes IVGT, an Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer that models continuous 3D geometry from unposed multi-view images using neural implicit representations in canonical coordinate systems.

entry.title: Language Game: Talking to Non-Human Systems

author.name: Yanbo Zhang, Michael Levin

entry.summary: Proposes treating non-neural biological systems as dialogue partners using Wittgenstein's language games framework, where system internal dynamics map to communication signals.

entry.title: TailedTS: Benchmark Dataset for Heavy-Tailed Time Series Prediction and Periodicity Quantification

author.name: Xinyu Chen, HanQin Cai, Lijun Ding, Jinhua Zhao

entry.summary: TailedTS introduces a large-scale benchmark dataset from Wikipedia hourly page views (24.69 billion data points) designed to test time series forecasting under heavy-tailed, zero-inflated conditions. It addresses gaps in existing benchmarks like M4/M5 that underrepresent extreme volatility.

entry.title: Avoiding Structural Failure Modes in Tabular Fair SSL: Online Primal-Dual Allocation under Confidence Gating

author.name: Hangchun Liang, Changchun Li

entry.summary: Identifies structural failure modes in tabular fair semi-supervised learning (Masking Collapse and Trivial Saturation) and proposes Online Primal-Dual Allocation (OPDA) to dynamically balance fairness and stability without per-dataset tuning.

entry.title: Multiscale Supervised Unbalanced Optimal Transport Flow Matching

author.name: Qiangwei Peng, Lezhi Chen, Peijie Zhou

entry.summary: MUST-FM scales unbalanced optimal transport for single-cell analysis by exploiting hierarchical data structure and optional supervision from cell lineages, enabling scalable flow matching for birth-death dynamics.

entry.title: GraViti: Graph-Level Variational Autoencoders with Relaxed Permutation Invariance

author.name: Roman Bresson, Konstantinos Divriotis, Johannes F. Lutzeyer, Iakovos Evdaimon, Michalis Vazirgiannis

entry.summary: GraViti is a transformer-based graph-level VAE that maps entire graphs to latent vectors, supporting interpolation and property-guided search. Shows that enforcing permutation invariance can be detrimental when canonical orderings exist.

entry.title: UB-SMoE: Universally Balanced Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Resource-adaptive Federated Fine-tuning of Foundation Models

author.name: Van-Tuan Tran, Hong-Hanh Nguyen-Le, Marco Ruffini, Merim Dzaferagic

entry.summary: UB-SMoE addresses expert utilization imbalance and non-differentiable Top-K routing issues when applying Sparse MoE to heterogeneous federated fine-tuning, with convergence analysis showing these cause degradation for resource-constrained clients.

entry.title: EmoMind: Decoding Affective Captions from Human Brain fMRI

author.name: Bilal A. Mohammed, Lin Gu, Ruogo Fang

entry.summary: EmoMind is the first end-to-end pipeline for decoding affective captions from fMRI, combining semantic scene description with a continuous 34-dimensional emotion vector decoded from the same brain recording.

entry.title: Atoms as Language: VQ-Atom: Semantic Discretization for Molecular Representation Learning

author.name: Takayuki Kimura

entry.summary: VQ-Atom converts continuous atom-level graph representations into discrete tokens representing local chemical environments using vector quantization, creating a molecular language for transformer pretraining.

entry.title: S-Bus: Automatic Read-Set Reconstruction for Multi-Agent LLM State Coordination

author.name: Sajjad Khan

entry.summary: Presents S-Bus, HTTP middleware that prevents structural race conditions in multi-agent LLM systems sharing mutable state, using a server-side DeliveryLog for Observable-Read Isolation without SDK changes.

entry.title: Differentiable Optimization Layers for Guaranteed Fairness in Deep Learning

author.name: David Troxell, Noah Roemer, Guido Mont\'ufar

entry.summary: Introduces differentiable 'fairness layers' appended to neural network outputs that guarantee output parity constraints, plus an online primal-dual algorithm for provable aggregate fairness in streaming predictions.

entry.title: State-of-the-Art Claims Require State-of-the-Art Evidence

author.name: YongKyung Oh

entry.summary: Argues that SOTA claims in AI need stronger statistical evidence, identifying a widespread claim-evidence gap where marginal mean improvements don't establish meaningful superiority across tasks.

entry.title: Olivia: Harmonizing Time Series Foundation Models with Power Spectral Density

author.name: Jingru Fei, Kun Yi, Alex Xing Wang, Qingsong Wen, Xiangxiang Zhu, Wei Fan

entry.summary: Introduces Olivia/Harmonizer, a module that reshapes spectral structures across diverse time series datasets during pretraining using normalized power spectral density, improving foundation model generalization.

entry.title: \textsc{MasFACT}: Continual Multi-Agent Topology Learning via Geometry-Aware Posterior Transfer

author.name: Xuefei Wang, Jialu Wang, Fengbo Zhang, Yihan Hu, Di Zhang, Yutong Ye, Yikun Ban, Jun Han, Ruijie Wang

entry.summary: Identifies 'topology forgetting' in multi-agent LLM systems where adapting communication topology to new tasks erases patterns needed for earlier tasks, proposing geometry-aware posterior transfer to mitigate.

entry.title: Coordinate Heterogeneity Governs Binary Quantization: From InfoNCE to Recall

author.name: Wenxuan Xiao

entry.summary: Resolves puzzle of why binary quantization works for contrastive embeddings but not others, showing coordinate heterogeneity governs BQ quality and connecting this to InfoNCE-trained Gaussian structure.

entry.title: TabKDE: Simple and Scalable Tabular Data Generation with Kernel Density Estimates

author.name: Meysam Alishahi, Yan Zheng, Junpeng Wang, Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Jeff M. Phillips

entry.summary: TabKDE proposes using copula transformations and kernel density estimation for tabular data generation, achieving near-SOTA accuracy with almost no training cost compared to expensive methods using VAEs and diffusion models.

entry.title: Learning Variable-Length Tokenization for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Minhao Wang, Bowen Wu, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Discovers the 'Popularity-Length Paradox' in generative recommendation: popular items achieve optimal performance with short IDs while tail items need longer codes. Proposes variable-length tokenization that adapts encoding length to item characteristics.

entry.title: Content-Style Identification via Differential Independence

author.name: Subash Timilsina, Hoang-Son Nguyen, Sagar Shrestha, Xiao Fu

entry.summary: Introduces content-style differential independence (CSDI), requiring that content and style variations induce orthogonal directions on the data manifold, enabling identifiable content-style separation under weaker assumptions than prior work.

entry.title: Attention Sinks and Outliers in Attention Residuals

author.name: Haozheng Luo, Haoran Dai, Shaoyang Zhang, Xi Chen, Eric Hanchen Jiang, Yijiang Li, Jingyuan Huang, Chenghao Qiu, Chenwei Xu, Zhenyu Pan, Haotian Zhang, Binghui Wang, Yan Chen

entry.summary: OASIS addresses attention sinks and activation outliers in AttnResidual architectures by introducing Softmax1-based null space and inter-layer null signaling, improving inference stability and quantization robustness.

entry.title: Equilibrium Selection in Multi-Agent Policy Gradients via Opponent-Aware Basin Entry

author.name: Yevhen Shcherbinin, Arina Redina, Maxim Kalpin, Vlad Kochetov

entry.summary: Studies equilibrium selection in multi-agent policy gradients, identifying peer-learning corrections as the main mechanism determining which Nash equilibrium is reached. Provides conditions under which target equilibria are selected.

entry.title: Foundation Models for Credit Risk Prediction: A Game Changer?

author.name: Bart Baesens, Andreas Goethals, Stefan Lessmann, Simon De Vos, Cristi\'an Bravo, David Martens, Victor Medina-Olivares, Christophe Mues, Maria Oskarsd\'ottir, Seppe vanden Broucke, Tim Verdonck, Wouter Verbeke

entry.summary: Benchmarks foundation models for credit risk prediction, evaluating whether pretrained tabular and language foundation models can improve upon traditional gradient boosting + SHAP approaches that are current industry standard.

entry.title: Concise and Logically Consistent Conformal Sets for Neuro-Symbolic Concept-Based Models

author.name: Samuele Bortolotti, Emanuele Marconato, Andrea Pugnana, Andrea Passerini, Stefano Teso

entry.summary: Integrates conformal prediction with neuro-symbolic concept-based models, formalizing three desiderata (consistency, coverage, conciseness) and providing rigorous coverage guarantees that respect logical constraints.

entry.title: Privacy Preserving Reinforcement Learning with One-Sided Feedback

author.name: Lin William Cong, Guangyan Gan, Hanzhang Qin, Zhenzhen Yan

entry.summary: POOL is a privacy-preserving RL algorithm for continuous state/action spaces with one-sided feedback, achieving sample complexity matching non-private lower bounds while providing differential privacy guarantees.

entry.title: ISEP: Implicit Support Expansion for Offline Reinforcement Learning via Stochastic Policy Optimization

author.name: Yifei Chen, Shaoqin Zhu, Xiaoqiang Ji

entry.summary: Proposes ISEP for offline RL that implicitly expands the feasible action support beyond the behavior policy through value function interpolation, using stochastic policy optimization to avoid mode collapse in multimodal landscapes.

entry.title: Graph Hierarchical Recurrence for Long-Range Generalization

author.name: Stefano Carotti, Marco Pacini, Alessio Gravina, Davide Bacciu, Bruno Lepri, Sebastiano Bontorin

entry.summary: Introduces Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR), a framework combining GNNs with hierarchical graph abstractions through pooling to capture long-range correlations. Demonstrates improved out-of-range generalization on graph tasks.

entry.title: scHelix: Asymmetric Dual-Stream Integration via Explicit Gene-Level Disentanglement

author.name: Xichen Yan, Zelin Zang, Changxi Chi, Jingbo Zhou, Chang Yu, Jinlin Wu, Shenghui Cheng, Fuji Yang, Jiebo Luo, Zhen Lei, Stan Z. Li

entry.summary: Presents scHelix for single-cell RNA-seq integration that explicitly partitions genes into domain-invariant anchors and domain-sensitive variants, using a dual-stream sparse diffusion encoder to balance batch effect removal with biological fidelity.

entry.title: Stochastic Penalty-Barrier Methods for Constrained Machine Learning

author.name: Adam Bos\'ak, Andrii Kliachkin, Jana Lep\v{s}ov\'a, Gilles Bareilles, Jakub Mare\v{c}ek

entry.summary: Proposes the Stochastic Penalty-Barrier Method (SPBM) for constrained non-convex, non-smooth optimization in deep learning, combining exponential dual averaging with stabilized penalty schedules and Moreau envelopes.

entry.title: An Assessment of Human vs. Model Uncertainty in Soft-Label Learning and Calibration

author.name: Maja Pavlovic, Silviu Paun, Massimo Poesio

entry.summary: Conducts a controlled study showing that human soft-labels provide accuracy gains and act as a regularizer improving calibration on difficult samples, after carefully decoupling the benefits from mode-shift corrections in mislabeled data.

entry.title: Patchwork: A compact representation for 3D polygonal shapes

author.name: Ruichen Zheng, Biao Zhang, Michael Birsak, Mikhail Skopenkov, Peter Wonka

entry.summary: Introduces Patchwork, a compact shape representation for 2D/3D geometry with provable complexity bounds and arbitrary precision approximation, using gradient-based optimization with progressive pruning.

entry.title: Stable and Near-Reversible Diffusion ODE Solvers for Image Editing

author.name: Barbora Barancikova, Daniil Shmelev, Cristopher Salvi

entry.summary: Investigates the trade-off between reversibility and numerical stability in diffusion ODE solvers for image editing, proposing near-reversible solvers that balance background preservation with prompt alignment.

entry.title: Dimension-Uniform Discretization Analysis of Preconditioned Annealed Langevin Dynamics for Multimodal Gaussian Mixtures

author.name: Lorenzo Baldassari, Josselin Garnier, Knut Solna, Maarten V. de Hoop

entry.summary: Analyzes discretization of preconditioned annealed Langevin dynamics for Gaussian mixtures, showing how preconditioning achieves dimension-uniform stability and comparing Euler-Maruyama vs exponential integrator approaches.

entry.title: Compositional Adversarial Training for Robust Visual Watermarking

author.name: Anirudh Satheesh, Michael-Andrei Panaitescu-Liess, Andrew Xu, Georgios Milis, Heng Huang, Zikui Cai, Furong Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Compositional Adversarial Training (CAT) for robust watermarking, using a learned sequential differentiable adversary that selects attack compositions to maximally disrupt watermark detection during training.

entry.title: Plan First, Diffuse Later: Extrinsic Graph Guidance for Long-Horizon Diffusion Planning

author.name: Yaniv Hassidof, Adir Morgan, Yilun Du, Kiril Solovey

entry.summary: Proposes extrinsic graph-based search guidance for compositional diffusion planning, performing exploration outside the denoising process to achieve better global coherence in long-horizon tasks more efficiently.

entry.title: Adversarial Fragility and Language Vulnerability in Clinical AI: A Systematic Audit of Diagnostic Collapse Under Imperceptible Perturbations and Cross-Lingual Drift in Low-Resource Healthcare Settings

author.name: Anthonio Oladimeji Gabriel, Ahmad Rufai Yusuf

entry.summary: Presents first systematic dual audit of clinical AI vulnerabilities: adversarial image fragility (accuracy drops from 89.3% to 62% with imperceptible perturbations) and cross-lingual diagnostic drift across 17 languages.

entry.title: $\mathcal{O}(n)$ alternative to Quantum Fourier Transform with efficient neural net classical post-processing

author.name: Kaiming Bian, Zujin Wen, Oscar Dahlsten

entry.summary: Proposes O(n) alternative to Quantum Fourier Transform using Hadamard and controlled-Phase gates with neural network classical post-processing, maintaining information needed for hidden subgroup problems.

entry.title: Capturing LLM Capabilities via Evidence-Calibrated Query Clustering

author.name: Fangzhou Wu, Sandeep Silwal, Qiuyi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ECC algorithm for LLM capability-aware query clustering that calibrates semantic embeddings using limited model comparison data and Bradley-Terry capability profiles.

entry.title: Sample efficient inductive matrix completion with noise and inexact side information

author.name: Yuepeng Yang, Cong Ma

entry.summary: Closes the gap between noiseless and noisy inductive matrix completion, providing sample-efficient guarantees using nonconvex projected gradient descent with spectral initialization when side information is inexact.

entry.title: Scalable Bi-causal Optimal Transport via KL Relaxation and Policy Gradients

author.name: Haoyang Cao, Jesse Hoekstra, Renyuan Xu, Yumin Xu, Ruixun Zhang

entry.summary: Develops scalable framework for bi-causal optimal transport using KL relaxation and policy gradients, enabling computation of couplings that respect information flow for continuous distributions over long horizons.

entry.title: Is Complex Training Necessary for Long-Tailed OOD Detection? A Re-think from Feature Geometry

author.name: Ningkang Peng, Xuanming Chen, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Shows that complex training procedures for long-tailed OOD detection may be unnecessary, proposing a simple post-hoc detector (HPM) that normalizes features to unit sphere with pooled covariance, outperforming training-intensive methods.

entry.title: Real-time Multi-instrument Autonomous Discovery of Novel Phase-change Memory Materials

author.name: Chih-Yu Lee, Haotong Liang, Ryan Kim, Austin McDannald, Carlos A Rios Ocampo, A. Gilad Kusne, Ichiro Takeuchi

entry.summary: Demonstrates Multi-instrument Autonomous Discovery (MAD) framework combining structural and functional property optimization in closed-loop for discovering novel phase-change memory materials.

entry.title: A note on connections between the F\"ollmer process and the denoising diffusion probabilistic model

author.name: Yuta Koike

entry.summary: Clarifies connections between the Föllmer process and DDPM sampler, showing discretized Föllmer processes give natural hyperparameter settings for DDPM and systematically recover score-free sampling algorithms.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Communication for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sangjun Bae, Yisak Park, Sanghyeon Lee, Seungyul Han

entry.summary: Proposes LMAC, using LLMs to design communication protocols for multi-agent RL that enable agents to reconstruct underlying state uniformly, iteratively refining protocols using state-awareness criteria.

entry.title: From Volume to Value: Preference-Aligned Memory Construction for On-Device RAG

author.name: Changmin Lee, Jaemin Kim, Taesik Gong

entry.summary: Proposes EPIC for on-device RAG that focuses on storing user preference-relevant information under tight memory budgets, integrating preferences throughout the retrieval pipeline for personal AI agents.

entry.title: AI4BayesCode: From Natural Language Descriptions to Validated Modular Stateful Bayesian Samplers

author.name: Jungang Zou, Alex Ziyu Jiang, Qixuan Chen

entry.summary: Presents AI4BayesCode, an LLM-driven system that translates natural-language Bayesian model descriptions into validated MCMC samplers through modular decomposition and pre-generation validation. Aims to reduce the coding bottleneck in probabilistic programming.

entry.title: Beyond Sentiment Classification: A Generative Framework for Emotion Intensity Evaluation in Text

author.name: Francesco A. Fabozzi, Dasol Kim, William N. Goetzmann

entry.summary: Shifts emotion modeling from classification to continuous intensity evaluation (0-100 scale) by fine-tuning generative LLMs. Outperforms classification baselines and shows surprising generalization to related constructs like sentiment and arousal.

entry.title: Can LLMs Think Like Consumers? Benchmarking Crowd-Level Reaction Reconstruction with ConsumerSimBench

author.name: Tianyu Wang, Jiajun Li, Jianghao Lin

entry.summary: Introduces ConsumerSimBench, a benchmark testing whether LLMs can reconstruct concrete consumer reaction patterns from Chinese social media topics. Decomposes evaluation into auditable yes-no decisions over 23,122 atomic criteria.

entry.title: Taming "Zombie'' Agents: A Markov State-Aware Framework for Resilient Multi-Agent Evolution

author.name: Taolin Zhang, Pukun Zhao, Qizhou Chen, Jiuheng Wan, Chen Chen, Xiaofeng He, Chengyu Wang, Richang Hong

entry.summary: Proposes AgentRevive, a Markov state-aware framework that uses soft state transitions instead of hard pruning to manage 'zombie' agents in multi-agent systems, allowing temporarily underperforming agents to recover.

entry.title: Beyond Catalogue Counts: the Dataset Visibility Asymmetry in Low-Resource Multilingual NLP

author.name: Zhiyin Tan, Changxu Duan

entry.summary: Introduces Resource Density Index (RDI) to reveal that dataset visibility in multilingual NLP catalogues doesn't reflect actual dataset creation, citation, or reuse. Shows 59% of top 200 languages have zero RDI across major catalogues.

entry.title: Internalizing Tool Knowledge in Small Language Models via QLoRA Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yuval Shemla, Ayal Yakobe, Tanmay Agarwal

entry.summary: Investigates whether small language models (Gemma 4 E4B, Qwen3-4B) can internalize tool-use knowledge through QLoRA fine-tuning, enabling structured planning without explicit tool descriptions at inference time. Achieves significant token overhead reduction.

entry.title: iPOE: Interpretable Prompt Optimization via Explanations

author.name: Jiahui Li, Sean Papay, Roman Klinger

entry.summary: Introduces iPOE, an interpretable prompt optimization method that uses explanations (from humans or automatically generated) to create annotation guidelines that guide the optimization process, making prompt changes transparent.

entry.title: Responsible Agentic AI Requires Explicit Provenance

author.name: Jinwei Hu, Xinmiao Huang, Qisong He, Youcheng Sun, Yi Dong, Xiaowei Huang

entry.summary: Argues that responsible agentic AI requires explicit provenance across the full lifecycle, making responsibility computable and actionable. Proposes a framework along four axes for traceable, interventionable provenance.

entry.title: QQJ: Quantifying Qualitative Judgment for Scalable and Human-Aligned Evaluation of Generative AI

author.name: Marjan Veysi, Pirooz Shamsinejadbabaki, Mohammad Zare, Mohammad Sabouri

entry.summary: Introduces QQJ (Quantifying Qualitative Judgment), a scalable evaluation framework for generative AI that bridges human-defined evaluation principles with automated scoring to improve consistency and alignment with human judgment.

entry.title: ContraFix: Agentic Vulnerability Repair via Differential Runtime Evidence and Skill Reuse

author.name: Simiao Liu, Fang Liu, Li Zhang, Yang Liu, Yinghao Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes ContraFix for automated vulnerability repair using differential runtime evidence (comparing crashing vs. safe execution) and skill reuse to improve semantic understanding of root causes.

entry.title: CodeBind: Decoupled Representation Learning for Multimodal Alignment with Unified Compositional Codebook

author.name: Zeyu Chen, Jie Li, Kai Han

entry.summary: Proposes CodeBind, a multimodal alignment framework using a shared-specific codebook design that decomposes features into shared components for semantic consistency and specific components for modality-unique details.

entry.title: SWoMo: Neuro-Symbolic World Model for Cataract Surgery Simulation

author.name: Ssharvien Kumar Sivakumar, Akwele Johnson, Anirudh Dhingra, Yannik Frisch, Ghazal Ghazaei, Anirban Mukhopadhyay

entry.summary: Introduces SWoMo, a neuro-symbolic world model for cataract surgery simulation that decouples motion generation from visual realism using rule-based physics simulation and neural rendering.

entry.title: Accelerating Rectified Flow Models via Trajectory-Aware Caching

author.name: Xiao Liu, Kai Liu, Naiyang Guan, Hongliang Lu, Zhixin Wang, Zhikai Chen, Renjing Pei, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TACache, a training-free acceleration framework for rectified flow models using trajectory-aware caching with orthogonal decomposition. Follows a skip-then-compensate paradigm to reduce approximation errors.

entry.title: RHINO: Reconstructing Human Interactions with Novel Objects from Monocular Videos

author.name: Lixin Xue, Chengwei Zheng, Georgios Paschalidis, Chen Guo, Manuel Kaufmann, Juan Zarate, Dimitrios Tzionas

entry.summary: Develops RHINO, a three-step framework for reconstructing human-object interactions from monocular RGB video, recovering human, novel object, and static scene in a common world frame without known 3D shapes.

entry.title: Image-to-Video Diffusion: From Foundations to Open Frontiers

author.name: Xianlong Wang, Wenbo Pan, Shijia Zhou, Ke Li, Yuqi Wang, Zeyu Ye, Hangtao Zhang, Leo Yu Zhang, Xiaohua Jia

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of diffusion-based image-to-video generation treating it as a standalone subject, covering formulation, architectures, datasets, evaluation, and organizing advances by conditioning types.

entry.title: HierEdit: Region-Aware Hierarchical Diffusion for Efficient High-Resolution Editing

author.name: Yuyao Zhang, Alexander Huang-Menders, Yu-Wing Tai

entry.summary: Introduces HierEdit, a region-aware hierarchical diffusion framework for efficient high-resolution image editing that performs edits on low-res proxy then upscales only modified regions with local-window diffusion.

entry.title: Single-Sample Black-Box Membership Inference Attack against Vision-Language Models via Cross-modal Semantic Alignment

author.name: Jiaqing Li, Yajuan Lu, Xiaochuan Shi, Gang Wu, ZhongYuan Wang, Chao Liang

entry.summary: Proposes a single-sample black-box membership inference attack against VLMs by exploiting cross-modal semantic alignment differences between member and non-member samples.

entry.title: Soap2Soap: Long Cinematic Video Remaking via Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Yiren Song, Huilin Zhong, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Haofan Wang, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Proposes Soap2Soap, a multi-agent framework for series-level cinematic video remaking that maintains identity, motion, and narrative consistency across hundreds of shots using dual-bridge consistency.

entry.title: AgentSteerTTS: A Multi-Agent Closed-Loop Framework for Composite-Instruction Text-to-Speech

author.name: Bin Kang, Shaoguo Wen, Yang Fan, Shunlong Wu, Junjie Wang, Yulin Li, Junzhi Zhao, Junle Wang, Zhuotao Tian

entry.summary: Introduces AgentSteerTTS, a multi-agent closed-loop framework for TTS with composite instructions, using adversarial disentanglement to separate speaker identity from emotion-prosody.

entry.title: Error-Decomposed Class-Conditional Fusion for Statistically Guaranteed Hard-Category Robust Perception

author.name: Guowei Luo (Hefei University of Technology, Hefei, China), Ziqi Shi (Lishui University, Lishui, China), Zhao Xie (Hefei University of Technology, Hefei, China)

entry.summary: Defines the Hard-Category Reliability Problem in object detection and proposes ED-CCF, a decision-layer fusion framework using quad-state error taxonomy to improve performance on vulnerable minority classes without degrading stable classes.

entry.title: Patch-MoE Mamba: A Patch-Ordered Mixture-of-Experts State Space Architecture for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Diego Adame, Fabian Vazquez, Jose A. Nunez, Huimin Li, Jinghao Yang, Erik Enriquez, DongChul Kim, Haoteng Tang, Bin Fu, Pengfei Gu

entry.summary: Proposes Patch-MoE Mamba, combining patch-ordered scanning with mixture-of-experts in state space models for medical image segmentation, addressing spatial structure disruption and fusion limitations.

entry.title: PlantPose: Universal Plant Skeleton Estimation via Tree-constrained Graph Generation

author.name: Xinpeng Liu, Hiroaki Santo, Yosuke Toda, Fumio Okura

entry.summary: Introduces PlantPose for universal plant skeleton estimation from images, using tree-constrained graph generation to handle arbitrary branching topologies unlike fixed-topology human pose estimation.

entry.title: Evidence-Guided Unknown Rejection for High-Confidence Near-Known Unknowns

author.name: Xi Chen (School of Computer Science and Cyber Engineering, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China), Yingjun Xiao (School of Artificial Intelligence, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China), Gang Fang (Institute of Computing Science and Technology, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China)

entry.summary: Proposes EGUR-A for open-set recognition that changes the decision from threshold-based scoring to evidence-based acceptance, addressing high-confidence near-known unknowns.

entry.title: Beyond Euclidean Prototypes: Spectral Disentanglement and Geodesic Matching for Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Penghao Jia, Zhiyong Huang, Mingyang Hou, Zhi Yu, Shuai Miao, Jiahong Wang, Yan Yan

entry.summary: Proposes spectral disentanglement and geodesic matching for few-shot medical image segmentation, separating organ shape, texture, and boundary into independent spectral-domain cues.

entry.title: SurgLQA: Scalable Long-Horizon Surgical Video Question Answering

author.name: Diandian Guo, Xikai Yang, Ruiyang Li, Jialun Pei, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: Proposes SurgLQA, a long-horizon surgical video QA framework using Faithful Temporal Consolidation to build compact long-range representations while preserving temporal fidelity.

entry.title: SGSoft: Learning Fused Semantic-Geometric Features for 3D Shape Correspondence via Template-Guided Soft Signals

author.name: Soyeon Yoon, Chang Wook Seo, Hyunjung Shim

entry.summary: Proposes SGSoft for 3D shape correspondence using template-guided soft geodesic signals and semantic priors, enabling single feed-forward dense correspondence retrieval across deformable shapes.

entry.title: SENSE: Satellite-based ENergy Synthesis for Sustainable Environment

author.name: Kailai Sun, Mingyi He, Heye Huang, Can Rong, Alok Prakash, Baoshen Guo, Shenhao Wang, Jinhua Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes SENSE, a generative framework for urban building energy modeling using satellite imagery and diffusion models to synthesize building energy layers for sustainable urban planning.

entry.title: Token-Space Mask Prediction for Efficient Vision Transformer Segmentation

author.name: Calvin Galagain, Martyna Poreba, Fran\c{c}ois Goulette

entry.summary: Introduces TokenMask, a token-space mask head for ViT segmentation that computes mask logits directly from query-token affinities rather than reconstructing dense spatial feature maps. This simplifies computation while maintaining competitive accuracy.

entry.title: EgoInteract: Synthetic Egocentric Videos Generation for Interaction Understanding and Anticipation

author.name: Rosario Leonardi, Francesco Ragusa, Daniele Materia, Alessandro Passanisi, James Fort, Jakob Engel, Giovanni Maria Farinella

entry.summary: Presents EgoInteract, a controllable simulator for generating synthetic egocentric videos with fine-grained human-object interactions, enabling precise control over camera, body/hand motion, object manipulation, and scene composition.

entry.title: LESSViT: Robust Hyperspectral Representation Learning under Spectral Configuration Shift

author.name: Haozhe Si, Yuxuan Wan, Yuqing Wang, Minh Do, Han Zhao

entry.summary: LESSViT introduces a sensor-flexible ViT architecture for hyperspectral imaging that generalizes across different spectral configurations through Low-rank Efficient Spatial-Spectral attention, addressing the fundamental challenge of varying sensor specs.

entry.title: StableHand: Quality-Aware Flow Matching for World-Space Dual-Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video

author.name: Huajian Zeng, Chaohua Yao, Yuantai Zhang, Jiaqi Yang, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Xingxing Zuo

entry.summary: StableHand proposes quality-aware flow matching for world-space dual-hand motion estimation from egocentric video, addressing the challenge of hands leaving camera view and severe occlusions during hand-object interaction.

entry.title: SPIKE: An Adaptive Dual Controller Framework for Cost-Efficient Long-Horizon Game Agents

author.name: Wencan Jiang, Jiangning Zhang, Jianbiao Mei, Jinzhuo Liu, Yu Yang, Xiaobin Hu, Zhucun Xue, Yong Liu, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: SPIKE presents an adaptive dual-controller framework for cost-efficient long-horizon game agents that separates low-frequency strategic planning from fast reactive execution, with event-triggered switching between controllers.

entry.title: Advancing Narrative Long Video Generation via Training-Free Identity-Aware Memory

author.name: Jinzhuo Liu, Jiangning Zhang, Wencan Jiang, Yabiao Wang, Dingkang Liang, Zhucun Xue, Ran Yi, Yong Liu

entry.summary: IAMFlow proposes a training-free identity-aware memory framework for long narrative video generation that explicitly tracks persistent entity identities across prompt transitions, preventing identity drift and character duplication.

entry.title: QuadLink: Autoregressive Quad-Dominant Mesh Generation via Point-Relation Learning

author.name: Yiheng Zhang, Zhe Zhu, Tingrui Shen, Zhuojiang Cai, Tianxiao Li, Zixing Zhao, Qiujie Dong, Zhiyang Dou, Jiepeng Wang, Le Wan, Yuwang Wang, Wenping Wang, Yuan Liu, Cheng Lin

entry.summary: QuadLink presents a unified three-stage framework for generating production-ready quad-dominant meshes from point clouds through point-relation learning, formulating mesh generation as centroid-conditioned vertex linking.

entry.title: Mono-Hydra++: Real-Time Monocular Scene Graph Construction with Multi-Task Learning for 3D Indoor Mapping

author.name: U. V. B. L. Udugama, George Vosselman, Francesco Nex

entry.summary: Presents Mono-Hydra++, a real-time monocular RGB+IMU pipeline for constructing 3D scene graphs in indoor environments using multi-task learning. Designed for resource-constrained aerial robots that cannot use RGB-D cameras or LiDAR.

entry.title: TIGER-FG: Text-Guided Implicit Fine-Grained Grounding for E-commerce Retrieval

author.name: Xinyu Sun, Huangyu Dai, Lingtao Mao, Zexin Zheng, Zihan Liang, Ben Chen, Chenyi Lei, Wenwu Ou

entry.summary: Proposes TIGER-FG for e-commerce image retrieval that handles modality and granularity asymmetries between cropped query images and full item images with text. Uses text-guided implicit fine-grained grounding without explicit detection.

entry.title: SADP: Subgoal-Aware Diffusion Policy for Explainable Robots Learned from Foundation Model Generated Demonstrations

author.name: Site Hu, Takato Horii

entry.summary: Proposes Subgoal-Aware Diffusion Policy (SADP) that uses foundation models to generate subgoal-annotated demonstrations, enabling robots to explain their decision-making process during long-horizon manipulation tasks.

entry.title: MUSE: Multimodal Uncertainty Quantification of State Estimation

author.name: Minkyung Kim, Henry Che, Bhargav Chandaka, Bhumsitt Pramuanpornsatid, Chengyu Yang, Sheng Cheng, Xiaofeng Wang, Naira Hovakimyan, Shenlong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MUSE, a real-time multimodal uncertainty quantification framework for visual-inertial odometry that addresses heteroscedastic and multimodal nature of state estimation uncertainty.

entry.title: Not What You Asked For: Typographic Attacks in Household Robot Manipulation

author.name: Ali Iranmanesh, Peng Liu

entry.summary: Evaluates typographic attacks (adversarial printed text in physical scenes) against CLIP-based household robot manipulation in simulation. Shows these attacks can override visual judgment in the full Sense-Plan-Act pipeline.

entry.title: Controlling False Discovery in Arbitrarily Structured Hypothesis Spaces via Reproducing Kernels

author.name: Binyamin Perets, Shie Mannor

entry.summary: Reframes structured False Discovery Rate control as a regularized learning problem in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces, unifying continuous domains, graphs, and hierarchies under one framework while increasing discovery power.

entry.title: Context, Reasoning, and Hierarchy: A Cost-Performance Study of Compound LLM Agent Design in an Adversarial POMDP

author.name: Igor Bogdanov, Chung-Horng Lung, Thomas Kunz, Jie Gao, Adrian Taylor, Marzia Zaman

entry.summary: Controlled study of compound LLM agent design in a cyber defense POMDP, evaluating five model families across context, reasoning, and hierarchy dimensions with token-level cost accounting.

entry.title: Do Biological Structural Guarantees Earn Their Complexity?

author.name: Bogdan Banu

entry.summary: Benchmarks biologically-inspired AI agent frameworks (gene regulatory networks, immune systems, metabolic control) against simpler alternatives across 10M+ data points, testing whether biological structural guarantees justify their complexity.

entry.title: DiffVAS: Diffusion-Guided Visual Active Search in Partially Observable Environments

author.name: Anindya Sarkar, Srikumar Sastry, Aleksis Pirinen, Nathan Jacobs, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

entry.summary: Proposes DiffVAS, a diffusion-guided visual active search framework for partially observable environments that handles unknown search spaces and multiple target categories simultaneously for UAV-based exploration.

entry.title: DecomPose: Disentangling Cross-Category Optimization Contention for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Yifan Gao, Lu Zou, Zhangjin Huang, Guoping Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DecomPose for category-level 6D object pose estimation that addresses cross-category optimization conflicts through difficulty-aware gradient decoupling and group-specific routing.

entry.title: BiomedAP: A Vision-Informed Dual-Anchor Framework with Gated Cross-Modal Fusion for Robust Medical Vision-Language Adaptation

author.name: Huanyang Tong, Kai Liu, Fangjun Kuang, Huiling Chen

entry.summary: Proposes BiomedAP, a vision-informed dual-anchor framework for medical VLM adaptation that uses gated cross-modal fusion to address fragility to prompt variations in clinical settings.

entry.title: Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for MT: A Seq2Seq Perspective

author.name: Ernesto Garcia-Estrada, Carlos Escolano, Jos\'e A. R. Fonallosa

entry.summary: Applies Group Relative Policy Optimization to encoder-decoder MT models (NLLB-200) with reference-free rewards, achieving improvements across 13 languages without parallel data at fine-tuning time.

entry.title: From Flat Language Labels to Typological Priors: Structured Language Conditioning for Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation

author.name: Yu Pan, Yang Hou, Xiongfei Wu, Liang Zhang, Yves Le Traon, Lei Ma, Jianjun Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes S2ST-Omni 2, a speech-to-speech translation framework replacing flat language labels with structured typological priors from linguistics to improve multilingual adaptation with scarce data.

entry.title: DebiasRAG: A Tuning-Free Path to Fair Generation in Large Language Models through Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Rui Chu, Bingyin Zhao, Thanh Quoc Hung Le, Duy Cao Hoang, Huawei Lin, Ping Li, Weijie Zhao, Khoa D Doan, Yingjie Lao

entry.summary: Proposes DebiasRAG, a tuning-free method to mitigate social biases in LLMs through retrieval-augmented generation with debiasing context, avoiding fine-tuning costs while maintaining model capabilities.

entry.title: LoopQ: Quantization for Recursive Transformers

author.name: Rui Fang, Hsi-Wen Chen, Ming-Syan Chen

entry.summary: First systematic study of quantization in looped (recursive) Transformers, identifying unique challenges and proposing LoopQ framework with loop-aware adaptations.

entry.title: Decision-Aware Proximal Bridge Learning for Optimal Treatment Selection

author.name: Tom\`as Garriga, Alejandro Almod\'ovar, Axel Brando, Gerard Sanz, Eduard Serrahima de Cambra, Juan Parras

entry.summary: Introduces decision-aware proximal bridge learning for optimal treatment selection with continuous actions under hidden confounding, focusing modeling effort on decision-relevant regions rather than the full action space.

entry.title: TriOpt: A Scalable Algorithm for Linear Causal Discovery

author.name: Rafat Ashraf Joy, Elena Zheleva

entry.summary: Introduces TriOpt for scalable linear causal discovery that tightly integrates ordering-based and continuous optimization methods, achieving substantial scalability gains in high-dimensional settings.

entry.title: PFlow-T: A Persistence-Driven Forward Process for Topology-Controlled Generation

author.name: Snigdha Chandan Khilar

entry.summary: Introduces PFlow-T, a generative model where the forward process is based on persistent homology feature destruction rather than Gaussian noise, enabling topology-controlled generation.

entry.title: FedSDR: Federated Self-Distillation with Rectification

author.name: Ziheng Ren, Zhanming Shen, Hao Wang, Ning Liu, You Song

entry.summary: FedSDR proposes federated self-distillation with rectification for fine-tuning LLMs, identifying a 'Rewrite Paradox' where unconstrained self-distillation increases hallucinations, and adding rectification constraints to prevent this.

entry.title: Temporal Task Diversity: Inductive Biases Under Non-Stationarity in Synthetic Sequence Modelling

author.name: Afiq Abdillah Effiezal Aswadi, Oliver Britton, Ross Baker, Matthew Farrugia-Roberts

entry.summary: Studies how temporal diversity in the training task distribution (non-stationary data) affects inductive biases in in-context learning, finding that changing distributions throughout training leads to different generalization patterns than fixed distributions.

entry.title: Data Presentation Over Architecture: Resampling Strategies for Credit Risk Prediction with Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Aditya Tanna, Mitul Solanki, Mohamed Bouadi, Nassim Bouarour, Pratinav Seth, Vinay Kumar Sankarapu

entry.summary: Benchmarks tabular foundation models on credit risk prediction, finding that context construction strategy (sampling method) explains more variance in performance than model family choice, with balanced sampling adding 3-4 AUC points.

entry.title: CADS: Conformal Adaptive Decision System for Cost-Efficient Image Classification

author.name: Turkoglu Mikael, Bary Tim, Thielens Vincent, Dausort Manon, Macq Beno\^it

entry.summary: Proposes CADS, a sequential multi-model system using conformal prediction to route images to appropriately complex models based on estimated difficulty, optimizing cost-accuracy tradeoffs for deployment.

entry.title: SocialMemBench: Are AI Memory Systems Ready for Social Group Settings?

author.name: Olukunle Owolabi

entry.summary: Introduces SocialMemBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI memory systems in multi-party social group settings. Addresses challenges unique to group contexts: shared history, group norms vs individual exceptions, and attribution after member departure.

entry.title: Infini-News: Efficiently Queryable Access to 1.3 Billion Processed Common Crawl News Articles

author.name: Ruggero Marino Lazzaroni, Jana Lasser, Kirill Solovev

entry.summary: Presents Infini-News, a retrieval toolkit and index for the entire CC-News archive (1.35B articles from 2016 to present), enriched with language detection and geographic annotation. Provides efficient queryable access to this massive news corpus.

entry.title: Concepts Worth Having: Refining VLM-Guided Concept Bottleneck Models with Minimal Annotations

author.name: Nicola Debole, Andrea Passerini, Stefano Teso, Andrea Pugnana, Emanuele Marconato

entry.summary: Proposes VH-CBM, a hybrid concept bottleneck model that combines VLM-generated annotations with minimal human annotations using Gaussian Processes to improve concept quality for interpretable classification.

entry.title: Semantic Smoothing via Novel View Synthesis for Robust SAR Image Classification

author.name: Daniel Brignac, Fengwei Tian, Banafsheh Latibari, Abhijit Mahalanobis, Ravi Tandon

entry.summary: Proposes semantic smoothing for SAR adversarial robustness using novel view synthesis to generate plausible radar views conditioned on acquisition geometry, replacing isotropic noise with structured transformations.

entry.title: TRACE: Evidence Grounding-Guided Multi-Video Event Understanding and Claim Generation

author.name: Pengyu Yan, Akhil Gorugantu, Mahesh Bhosale, Abdul Wasi, Vishvesh Trivedi, David Doermann

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE framework for multi-video event understanding that builds searchable timelines using OCR and object detection, then uses LLM-driven evidence grounding before reasoning.

entry.title: RT-Splatting: Joint Reflection-Transmission Modeling with Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Ji Shi, Xianghua Ying, Bowei Xing, Ruohao Guo, Wenzhen Yue

entry.summary: RT-Splatting addresses reflection and transmission modeling in 3D Gaussian Splatting by disentangling geometric occupancy from optical opacity, creating a unified surface-volume representation that handles semi-transparent specular surfaces.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Uncertainty Coresets for Robust Visual In-Context Learning in Histopathology

author.name: Franciskus Xaverius Erick, Johanna Paula M\"uller, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: Proposes GAUC, a training-free coreset selection method for in-context learning in histopathology VLMs that accounts for geometry-aware uncertainty in the joint vision-text embedding space, improving reliability without parameter updates.

entry.title: Resolving Representation Ambiguity in Feedforward Novel View Synthesis Transformer via Semantic-Spatial Decoupling

author.name: Yihang Wu, Yihang Sun, Shaofeng Zhang, Zuxuan Wu, Junchi Yan, Xiaosong Jia, Yu-gang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes semantic-spatial token decoupling for feedforward novel view synthesis transformers, keeping semantic (RGB) and spatial (Plücker rays) information in separate branches with cross-branch attention, resolving representation ambiguity.

entry.title: VoxScene: Anchor-Conditioned Voxel Diffusion for Indoor Scene Arrangement

author.name: Haotian Mao, Yuhan Huang, Jiatao Lin, Yang Zhao, Hui Wang, Yiheng Zhang, Yuwang Wang, Chenliang Zhou, Yan Zhang, Fangcheng Zhong, Xubo Yang

entry.summary: VoxScene presents anchor-conditioned voxel diffusion for 3D scene synthesis that uses explicit object-centric voxel representations to eliminate spatial collisions and structural entanglement in dense indoor environments.

entry.title: MORN: Metacognitive Object-Goal Regulation for Resource-Rational Long-Horizon Navigation

author.name: Xi Lin, Jiayi Li, Kangyi Wu, Jiaqiao Tang, Qingrong He, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: Presents MORN, a metacognitive object-goal navigation framework that injects resource-rationality into VLM-based navigation, preventing robots from exhausting time/battery budgets on infeasible subgoals.

entry.title: SEDualVLN: A Spatially-Enhanced Dual-System for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jingzhi Huang, Junkai Huang, Wenxuan Song, Haoyang Yang, Hailong Huang, Haoang Li, Yi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SEDualVLN, a dual-system framework for vision-language navigation combining a fast VLM-based System 1 with spatial enhancement and a slower MLLM-based System 2 for complex reasoning.

entry.title: Belief Engine: Configurable and Inspectable Stance Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation

author.name: Joshua C. Yang, Maurice Flechtner, Damian Dailisan, Michiel A. Bakker

entry.summary: Belief Engine introduces an auditable belief-update layer for LLM deliberation agents that treats belief as evidential state, using log-odds rules with controllable evidence uptake and prior anchoring parameters.

entry.title: FORGE: Self-Evolving Agent Memory With No Weight Updates via Population Broadcast

author.name: Igor Bogdanov, Chung-Horng Lung, Thomas Kunz, Jie Gao, Adrian Taylor, Marzia Zaman

entry.title: Attention Dispersion in Dynamic Graph Transformers: Diagnosis and a Transferable Fix

author.name: Jinhao Zhang, Kangfei Zhao, Qiuhao Zeng, Long-Kai Huang

entry.title: GenShield: Unified Detection and Artifact Correction for AI-Generated Images

entry.summary: Proposes GenShield, a unified framework that jointly performs AI-generated image detection and artifact correction in an autoregressive architecture, connecting diagnosis with restoration.

entry.title: A Structural Threshold in Decision Capacity Governs Collapse in Self-Play Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Arahan Kujur

entry.title: Federated Learning by Utility-Constrained Stochastic Aggregation for Improving Rational Participation

author.name: M Yashwanth, Arunabh Singh, Ashok Nayak, Sai Kiran Bulusu, Anirban Chakraborty

entry.title: COOPO: Cyclic Offline-Online Policy Optimization Algorithm

author.name: Qisai Liu, Zhanhong Jiang, Joshua Russell Waite, Aditya Balu, Cody Fleming, Soumik Sarkar

entry.summary: Proposes COOPO, a cyclic offline-online RL framework that repeatedly alternates between constrained offline training and online fine-tuning to address distribution drift and catastrophic forgetting in hybrid RL.

entry.title: Prompt Compression in Diffusion Large Language Models: Evaluating LLMLingua-2 on LLaDA

author.name: Sterling Huang, Abigayle Brown, Jiyoo Noh, Jiakang Xu, Wantong Huo, Kaung Myat Kyaw, Jonathan Chan

entry.title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution

author.name: Hongyi Liu, Haoyan Yang, Tao Jiang, Bo Tang, Feiyu Xiong, Zhiyu Li

entry.title: Nonlinear Bipolar Compensation: Handling Outliers in Post-Training Quantization

entry.title: Controlla: Learning Controllability via Graph-Constrained Latent Geometry

author.name: Jamuna S. Murthy, Amin Karimi Monsefi, Rajiv Ramnath

entry.title: 3D Skew Gaussian Splatting with Any Camera Trajectory Visualization Engine

author.name: Beizhen Zhao, Yifan Zhou, Gaochao Song, Ziran Yin, Hao Wang

entry.title: NORM-Nav: Zero-Shot Mobile Robot Navigation with Natural Language Behavioral Constraints

author.name: Dongjie Huo, Junhui Wang, Chao Gao, Yan Qiao, Dong Zhang, Guyue Zhou

entry.title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution

entry.title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents

author.name: Chinmay Savadikar, Mingyu Zhao, Yuanzheng Zhu, Han Li, Shuang Xie, Alberto Castelo, Tianfu Wu, Lingyun Wang

entry.title: Ensuring Logic in the Fog: Sound POMDP Synthesis with LTL Objectives

author.name: Can Zhou, Yulong Gao, Pian Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a sound reward-shaping mechanism for POMDPs with LTL objectives that generates belief-dependent rewards grounded in certified LTL satisfaction, integrated into Monte Carlo Planning.

entry.title: A3D: Agentic AI flow for autonomous Accelerator Design

entry.title: Diagonal Adaptive Non-local Observables on Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Feier Qin, Xiao Li, Yi Zheng, Haibin Huang, Hanyao Wang, Xiaoyu Wang, Yan Lu, Yuan Zhang

author.name: Minseo Kim

entry.title: Decomposed Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

entry.summary: Proposes P2GS for photometrically consistent urban 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction that handles varying exposure and tone mapping in real driving data for autonomous driving simulation.

author.name: Jinjie Shen, Zheng Huang, Yuchen Zhang, Yujiao Wu, Yaxiong Wang, Lechao Cheng, Shengeng Tang, Tianrui Hui, Nan Pu, Zhun Zhong

entry.title: Rethinking the State Update Gate for Long-Sequence Recurrent 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Kejun Ren, Lei Jin, Tianxin Huang, Lianming Xu, Li Wang

entry.title: DreamEdit3D: Personalization of Multi-View Diffusion Models for 3D Editing

author.name: Jinxin Ai, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner, Ziya Erko\c{c}

entry.title: HyperVision: A Channel-Adaptive Ground-Based Hyperspectral Vision Pre-trained Backbone

author.name: Guanyiman Fu, Jingtao Li, Zihang Cheng, Zhuanfeng Li, Diqi Chen, Yan Xu, Fengchao Xiong, Jianfeng Lu, Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes HyperVision, the first ground-based hyperspectral pre-trained backbone with channel-adaptive dynamic embedding for handling varying spectral configurations across sensors.

entry.title: SpecSem-Net: Integrating Spectral and Semantic Features for Robust AI-generated Video Detection

author.name: Zixi Wei, Huixuaun Zhang, Xiaojun Wan

entry.summary: Proposes SpecSem-Net, the first framework combining semantic-guided spectral denoising for detecting high-fidelity AI-generated videos from models like Sora and Veo.

entry.title: VISTA: Triplet-Supervised Video Style Transfer with Diffusion Transformers

entry.title: VoxShield: Protecting 3D Medical Datasets from Unauthorized Training via Frequency-Aware Inter-Slice Disruption

entry.summary: Proposes VoxShield for protecting 3D medical datasets from unauthorized training by disrupting inter-slice continuity and frequency-domain correlations that 3D segmentation networks rely on.

entry.title: DeTrack: A Benchmark and Altitude-Aware Dual World Model for Drone-embodied Tracking

author.name: Guyue Hu, Haoming Liu, Siyuan Song, Chenglong Li, Feng Chen, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Defines drone-embodied tracking task (DeTrack) where drones actively control flight to track targets in 3D environments, with benchmark of 11,368 trajectories and altitude-aware dual world model.

entry.title: GCE-MIL: Faithful and Recoverable Evidence for Multiple Instance Learning in Whole-Slide Imaging

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Ran Su

entry.summary: Proposes GCE-MIL that optimizes evidence quality directly in whole-slide image classification, addressing failures where attention-selected patches are insufficient, unnecessary, and unrecoverable.

entry.title: HL-OutPaint: Coarse-to-Fine Video Outpainting for High-Resolution Long-Range Videos

author.name: Jeongeun Park, Janghyeok Han, Geonung Kim, Hyun-Seung Lee, Kyuha Choi, Youngseok Han, Sunghyun Cho

entry.summary: Proposes HL-OutPaint, a coarse-to-fine video outpainting framework for high-resolution long sequences, using Global Coarse Guidance for spatio-temporal consistency at scale.

entry.title: TouchMap-OR: Multi-View 3D Mapping of Hand-Surface Contacts

author.name: Sophokles Ktistakis, Rui Wang, Bastian Grande, Hugo Sax

entry.title: Towards Universal Physical Adversarial Attacks via a Joint Multi-Objective and Multi-Model Optimization Framework

author.name: Ziyang Liu, Hongyuan Wang, Zijian Wang, Yinxi Lu, Yunzhao Zang, Zhiqiang Yan, Qianhao Ning

entry.summary: Proposes JMOF framework for universal physical adversarial attacks using multi-objective optimization across multiple surrogate models with Orthogonal Gradient Alignment to resolve gradient conflicts.

entry.title: Learning to Balance: Decoupled Siamese Diffusion Transformer for Reference-Based Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Bin Luo, Runmin Dong, Zhaoyang Luo, Jinxiao Zhang, Jiyao Zhao, Fan Wei, Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: Proposes DS-DiT for reference-based remote sensing super-resolution using a Decoupled Siamese Diffusion Transformer that separates LR structural and reference texture interactions at the attention level.

entry.title: DSAA: Dual-Stage Attribute Activation for Fine-grained Open Vocabulary Detection

author.name: Donghong Jiang, Endian Lin, Hanqing Liu, Mingjie Liu, Luoping Cui, Zhao Yang, Chuang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes DSAA, a dual-stage attribute activation framework for fine-grained open-vocabulary detection that strengthens attribute semantics when category signals dominate.

entry.title: DanceHMR: Hand-Aware Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery from Monocular Videos

author.name: Wenhao Shen, Ming Zhou, Hengyuan Zhang, Siyuan Bian, Youjiang Xu, Xi Lin

entry.summary: Presents DanceHMR, a whole-body human mesh recovery framework for monocular videos that unifies body motion and hand articulation through residual body-hand fusion in a temporal architecture.

entry.title: Best Segmentation Buddies for Image-Shape Correspondence

author.name: Itai Lang, Dongwei Lyu, Dale Decatur, Rana Hanocka

entry.summary: Addresses the underexplored task of finding segmentation correspondences between 2D images and untextured 3D shapes by distilling deep visual features from 2D vision models onto 3D surfaces and computing Best Segmentation Buddies for matching.

entry.title: Enhancing Train-Free Infinite-Frame Generation for Consistent Long Videos

author.name: X. Feng, J. Zhu, M. Wu, C. Chen, F. Mao, H. Guo, J. Wu, X. Chu, K. Huang

entry.summary: Proposes MIGA for train-free infinite-frame long video generation with a two-stage alignment mechanism to reduce training-inference gap and maintain long-term consistency in autoregressive frame generation frameworks.

entry.title: Code-as-Room: Generating 3D Rooms from Top-Down View Images via Agentic Code Synthesis

author.name: Yixuan Yang, Zhen Luo, Wanshui Gan, Jinkun Hao, Junru Lu, Jinghao Yan, Zhaoyang Lyu, Xudong Xu

entry.summary: Code-as-Room proposes an MLLM-based agentic framework that generates 3D rooms from top-down view images using Blender code synthesis, with a structured execution harness to prevent instability and infinite looping.

entry.title: Articulation in Prime: Primitive-Based Articulated Object Understanding from a Single Casual Video

author.name: Arslan Artykov, Tom Ravaud, Nicol\'as Violante-Grezzi, Vincent Lepetit

entry.summary: Proposes a category-agnostic optimization framework for articulated object understanding from monocular video using geometric primitives as proxy representations, avoiding reliance on point tracking or category-specific training.

entry.title: Flow Matching with Optimized Subclass Priors for Medical Image Augmentation

author.name: Felix N\"utzel, Mischa Dombrowski, Bernhard Kainz

entry.summary: Proposes flow matching with optimized subclass priors for medical image augmentation of rare diseases, using Gaussian mixture modeling to partition coarse labels into coherent submodes and provide informative source distributions.

entry.title: CATRF: Codec-Adaptive TriPlane Radiance Fields for Volumetric Content Delivery

author.name: Tung-I Chen, Lingdong Wang, Subhransu Maji, Ramesh K. Sitaraman

entry.title: Nori Bot: A Sub-$1,000 Floor-to-Counter Mobile Manipulator

author.name: Antonio Li, Sungjoon Park, Wen Ni Chew

entry.summary: Presents Nori Bot, a $947 17-DoF dual-arm mobile manipulator with a Z-axis lift, proactive agent runtime, and software safety stack. Addresses key limitations of existing sub-$1000 platforms.

entry.title: Beyond Safety Filtering: Control Barrier Function-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles

author.name: Jianye Xu, Bassam Alrifaee

entry.summary: Proposes CBF-informed reward design for multi-agent RL in autonomous driving, converting control barrier function constraint values into reward signals. Outperforms heuristic baselines at a four-way intersection.

entry.title: CosFly-Track: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Dataset for UAV Visual Tracking via Multi-Constraint Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Xiangyue Wang, Hanxuan Chen, Songsheng Cheng, Ruilong Ren, Jie Zheng, Shuai Yuan, Tianle Zeng, Hanzhong Guo, Kangli Wang, Ji Pei

entry.title: TacSE3: Equivariant SE(3) Motion Estimation from Low-Texture Visuotactile Images for In-Gripper Tracking and Compensation

entry.summary: Presents TacSE3, a tactile motion estimation pipeline that converts low-texture visuotactile observations into force fields and estimates SE(3) rigid-body motion for in-gripper tracking and compensation.

entry.title: From Saddle Points Toward Global Minima: A Newton-Type Method on Wasserstein Space

author.name: Razvan-Andrei Lascu, Taiji Suzuki

entry.title: RoPE Distinguishes Neither Positions Nor Tokens in Long Contexts, Provably

author.name: Yufeng Du, Phillip Harris, Minyang Tian, Eliu A Huerta, Srikanth Ronanki, Subendhu Rongali, Aram Galstyan, Hao Peng

entry.summary: As first covered in Research yesterday, Proves that RoPE (Rotary Positional Embeddings) loses both locality bias and token relevance consistency as context length increases, with failure probability approaching 0.5 (random chance). Provides theoretical explanation for long-context degradation.

entry.title: Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure: Proof-Derived Authorization for Sovereign AI Systems

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a proof-derived authorization system for AI agents in cloud/sovereign systems, where agents must submit intents with cryptographic proofs of safety before execution is permitted.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Goal Recognition with Large Language Models

entry.title: PRISM: Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring for Enterprise Conversational AI

author.name: Keshava Chaitanya, Jahnavi Gundakaram

entry.title: Sign-Separated Finite-Time Error Analysis of Q-Learning

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Develops sign-separated finite-time error analysis for Q-learning, decomposing error into positive and negative parts and connecting the asymmetry to overestimation bias.

entry.title: MR2-ByteTrack: CNN and Transformer-based Video Object Detection for AI-augmented Embedded Vision Sensor Nodes

entry.title: Bidirectional Fusion Guided by Cardiac Patterns for Semi-Supervised ECG Segmentation

author.name: Jeonghwa Lim, Minje Park, Sunghoon Joo

author.name: Jianlin Ye, Christos Kyrkou, Panayiotis Kolios

entry.title: XSearch: Explainable Code Search via Concept-to-Code Alignment

entry.title: Federated Nested Learning: Collaborative Training of Self-Referential Memories for Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Seungik Cho, Anqi Li, Wei Qiu

entry.title: S2Aligner: Pair-Efficient and Transferable Pre-Training for Sparse Text-Attributed Graphs

entry.title: VolTA-3D: Self-Supervised Learning for Brain MRI using 3D Volumetric Token Alignment

author.name: Edoardo Caldarelli, Franco Coltraro, Adri\`a Colom\'e, Lorenzo Rosasco, Carme Torras

entry.title: Beyond Morphology: Quantifying the Diagnostic Power of Color Features in Cancer Classification

author.name: Farnaz Kheiri, Shahryar Rahnamayan, Masoud Makrehchi

author.name: Deyan Ginev, Brian Caruso, Bruce Miller, Jeff Sank, Jacob Weiskoff

entry.title: JSPG: Dynamic Dictionary Filtering via Joint Semantic-Pinyin-Glyph Retrieval for Chinese Contextual ASR

author.name: Shilin Zhou, Zhenghua Li

entry.title: NewsLens: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adversarial News Bias Navigation

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Presents NewsLens, a five-agent adversarial pipeline for structured news bias navigation that exposes ideological omissions and framing boundaries rather than just classifying bias labels.

entry.title: From Documents to Segments: A Contextual Reformulation for Topic Assignment

author.name: Hoonsang Yoon, Takyoung Kim, Wonkee Lee, Ilmin Cho, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur, Stanley Jungkyu Choi

entry.title: Recall Isn't Enough: Bounding Commitments in Personalized Language Systems

entry.title: NERVE: A Neuromorphic Vision and Radar Ensemble for Multi-Sensor Fusion Research

entry.title: MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Shuowei Li, Yuming Zhao, Parth Bhalerao, Oana Ignat

entry.summary: Introduces MAVEN, a multi-agent framework for culturally faithful text-to-video generation using specialized agents for person, action, and location dimensions across Chinese, American, and Romanian cultures.

entry.title: Diffeomorphic Cortical Alignment via Direct Warping of Streamline Endpoints

author.name: Yang Xiang, Martin Cole, Zhengwu Zhang

entry.title: NeuroLiDAR: Adaptive Frame Rate Depth Sensing via Neuromorphic Event-LiDAR Fusion

author.name: Darshana Rathnayake, Dulanga Weerakoon, Meera Radhakrishnan, Archan Misra

entry.title: DecoRec: Decomposed 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single-View Images via Object-Level Diffusion

author.name: Yuhan Ping, Yuan Liu, Xiaoxiao Long, Peng Wang, Junhui Hou, Jianyi Zheng, Jia Pan, Xin Li, Cheng Lin

entry.title: Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion for Efficient Document Recognition

author.name: Mingxu Chai, Ziyu Shen, Chenyu Liu, Kaidi Zhang, Jiazheng Zhang, Dingwei Zhu, Zhiheng Xi, Ruoyu Chen, Jun Long, Jihua Kang, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang

entry.title: VGGT-Occ: Geometry-Grounded and Density-Aware Gated Fusion for 3D Occupancy Prediction
