entry.summary: Introduces AnyFlow, the first any-step video diffusion distillation framework based on flow maps that optimizes the full ODE sampling trajectory rather than fixed few-step distillation. Addresses the degradation problem where consistency-distilled models get worse with more sampling steps.

entry.title: Where Does Reasoning Break? Step-Level Hallucination Detection via Hidden-State Transport Geometry

author.name: Tyler Alvarez, Ali Baheri

entry.summary: Frames LLM hallucination detection as a property of hidden-state trajectories, identifying errors as localized excursions in transport cost from a stable manifold of correct reasoning. Uses contrastive PCA and geometric features to detect step-level hallucinations in a single forward pass.

entry.title: Descriptive Collision in Sparse Autoencoder Auto-Interpretability: When One Explanation Describes Many Features

author.name: Jordan F. McCann

entry.summary: Identifies 'descriptive collision' in sparse autoencoder auto-interpretability: many distinct SAE features receive identical natural language explanations. Reanalyzing 722 human-annotated features across Gemma 2 2B and Pythia 70M reveals significant explanation reuse.

entry.title: Separating Shortcut Transition from Cross-Family OOD Failure in a Minimal Model

author.name: Hongmin Li

entry.summary: Studies shortcut learning in a minimal binary model, showing that the transition to shortcut reliance and OOD failure are distinct phenomena - ridge regularization can prevent deterministic OOD failure even with shortcut correlation, and failure depends on the held-out family. Provides clean theoretical separation of these concepts.

entry.title: Chem-GMNet: A Sphere-Native Geometric Transformer for Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Deepak Warrier, Raja Sekhar Pappala

entry.summary: Chem-GMNet replaces every transformer module with sphere-native counterparts for molecular property prediction, using spherical harmonics embeddings and geometric attention. Questions whether domain-specific architectures outperform generic transformers with scale.

entry.title: Multi-Objective and Mixed-Reward Reinforcement Learning via Reward-Decorrelated Policy Optimization

author.name: Yang Bai, Kaiyuan Liu, Ziyuan Zhuang, Jiahong Zhou, Rongxiang Weng, Xin Chen, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: RDPO addresses multi-objective and mixed-reward RL by first normalizing heterogeneous reward distributions via quantile normalization, then decorrelating reward dimensions via Mahalanobis whitening before aggregation.

entry.title: Three-Stage Learning Unlocks Strong Performance in Simple Models for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Zhenan Yu, Guangxin Jiang, Jin Yang

entry.summary: STAIR is a three-stage training paradigm for time series forecasting that unlocks strong performance from simple temporal mapping models through stagewise adaptation, individualization, and residual learning.

entry.title: Toward AI-Driven Digital Twins for Metropolitan Floods: A Conditional Latent Dynamics Network Surrogate of the Shallow Water Equations

author.name: Phillip Si, Yuan Qiu, Omar Sallam, Jeremy Feinstein, Ziang He, Eugene Yan, Peng Chen

entry.summary: Presents CLDNet, a conditional latent dynamics neural ODE surrogate for shallow water equation solvers that accelerates metropolitan flood simulation by orders of magnitude. Uses coordinate-based decoding conditioned on terrain features to reconstruct depth and discharge at arbitrary points.

entry.title: Force-Aware Neural Tangent Kernels for Scalable and Robust Active Learning of MLIPs

author.name: Eszter Varga-Umbrich, Zachary Weller-Davies, Paul Duckworth, Jules Tilly, Olivier Peltre, Shikha Surana

entry.summary: Introduces force-aware Neural Tangent Kernels for scalable active learning of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), enabling screening of ~200K structures within hours. Addresses scaling, energy-force supervision, and robustness to distribution shift.

entry.title: Online Conformal Prediction: Enforcing monotonicity via Online Optimization

author.name: Eduardo Ochoa Rivera, Ambuj Tewari

entry.summary: Addresses online conformal prediction across multiple confidence levels, ensuring prediction sets are nested and simultaneously valid. Uses online optimization to enforce monotonicity constraints.

entry.title: When to Trust Confidence Thresholding: Calibration Diagnostics for Pseudo-Labelled Regression

author.name: Marcell T. Kurbucz

entry.summary: Develops calibration-aware diagnostics for pseudo-labelling pipelines, deriving closed-form attenuation bias from confidence thresholding and proposing a diagnostic that predicts this bias before running inference.

entry.title: Steer-to-Detect: Probing Hidden Representations for Detection of LLM-Generated Texts

author.name: Luxu Liang, Xiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Steer-to-Detect (S2D), a framework for detecting LLM-generated text by learning a steering vector injected into a frozen observer LLM's hidden states to improve class separability, followed by hypothesis testing.

entry.title: Implicit Behavioral Decoding from Next-Step Spike Forecasts at Population Scale

author.name: John R. Minnick, Jesus Gonzalez-Ferrer, Kamran Hussain, Jinghui Geng, Ash Robbins, Mohammed A. Mostajo-Radji, David Haussler, Jason Eshraghian, Mircea Teodorescu

entry.summary: Shows that a single Mamba forecaster trained only on next-step spike counts can implicitly decode behavioral state from neural population activity at Neuropixels scale, achieving 75.7% choice decoding accuracy.

entry.title: Kernel-based guarantees for nonlinear parametric models in Bayesian optimization

author.name: Rafael Oliveira

entry.summary: Develops kernel-based theoretical guarantees for nonlinear parametric models in Bayesian optimization under adaptive data collection, bridging the gap between theory (which assumes GPs/linear models) and practice (which uses nonlinear models).

entry.title: When and Why is Optimistic Multiplicative Weights Slow? The Geometry of Energy Dissipation

author.name: John Lazarsfeld, Anas Barakat, Georgios Piliouras, Antonios Varvitsiotis, Andre Wibisono

entry.summary: Studies convergence of Optimistic Multiplicative Weights Update in zero-sum games, developing an energy dissipation framework that gives sharp quantitative explanations for when and why OMWU converges slowly.

entry.title: Embodied Neurocomputation: A Framework for Interfacing Biological Neural Cultures with Scaled Task-Driven Validation

author.name: Johnson Zhou, Daniel Tanneberg, Forough Habibollahi, Alon Loeffler, Kiaran Lawson, Valentina Baccetti, Kwaku Dad Abu-Bonsrah, Candice Desouza, Finn Doensen, Bradley Watmuff, Daria Kornienko, Azin Azadi, Justin Leigh Bourke, Bernhard Sendhoff, Brett J. Kagan

entry.summary: Proposes an Embodied Neurocomputation framework for interfacing biological neural cultures with task-driven validation, performing the first large-scale parameter optimization of encoding configurations for biological neural network agents.

entry.title: On the Limits of Latent Reuse in Diffusion Models

author.name: Yifeng Yu, Lu Yu

entry.summary: Studies theoretical limits of latent space reuse in diffusion models under distribution shift, showing score error depends on subspace misalignment and ambient noise amplification. Characterizes shared dimension requirements for mixed training.

entry.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence

author.name: Dongsheng Ma, Jiayu Li, Zhengren Wang, Yijie Wang, Jiahao Kong, Weijun Zeng, Jutao Xiao, Jie Yang, Wentao Zhang, Bin Wang, Conghui He

entry.summary: Introduces CiteVQA, a benchmark requiring document VQA models to provide bounding-box citations alongside answers, evaluating both jointly across 1,897 questions in 711 PDFs spanning seven domains.

entry.title: STOP: Structured On-Policy Pruning of Long-Form Reasoning in Low-Data Regimes

author.name: Chenjun Xu, Zhennan Zhou, Zhan Su, Bill Howe, Lucy Lu Wang, Bingbing Wen

entry.summary: Proposes STOP, an on-policy algorithm for pruning long chain-of-thought reasoning traces by segmenting, annotating, and selectively removing low-yield reasoning steps in low-data regimes.

entry.title: PDCR: Perception-Decomposed Confidence Reward for Vision-Language Reasoning

author.name: Hee Suk Yoon, Eunseop Yoon, Ji Woo Hong, SooHwan Eom, Gwanhyeong Koo, Mark Hasegawa-Johnson, Qi Dai, Chong Luo, Chang D. Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes PDCR, a perception-decomposed confidence reward for vision-language reasoning that separates visual perception and textual reasoning signals to avoid mixture-induced signal degradation during RLVR training.

entry.title: FlowCompile: An Optimizing Compiler for Structured LLM Workflows

author.name: Junyan Li, Zhang-Wei Hong, Maohao Shen, Yang Zhang, Chuang Gan

entry.summary: Introduces FlowCompile, an optimizing compiler for structured LLM workflows that globally explores configuration space before deployment to optimize accuracy-latency tradeoffs across sub-agents.

entry.title: TrackCraft3R: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Dense 3D Tracking

author.name: Jisu Nam, Jahyeok Koo, Soowon Son, Jaewoo Jung, Honggyu An, Junhwa Hur, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Repurposes video diffusion transformers for dense 3D tracking by leveraging their rich spatio-temporal priors from internet-scale video training, addressing limitations of synthetic-data-only approaches.

entry.title: Pareto-Guided Optimal Transport for Multi-Reward Alignment

author.name: Ying Ba, Tianyu Zhang, Mohan Zhou, Yalong Bai, Wenyi Mo, Guiwei Zhang, Bing Su, Ji-Rong Wen

entry.summary: Proposes Pareto-guided optimal transport for multi-reward alignment in text-to-image generation, addressing reward hacking that occurs with weighted summation approaches under heterogeneous reward bounds.

entry.title: Fast and Compact Graph Cuts for the Boykov-Kolmogorov Algorithm

author.name: Christian M{\o}ller Mikkelstrup, Anders Bjorholm Dahl, Philip Bille, Vedrana Andersen Dahl, Inge Li G{\o}rtz

entry.summary: Improves the Boykov-Kolmogorov graph cut algorithm with better time complexity (O(m|C|) vs O(mn|C|)) and a compact representation enabling graphs with 10^9 vertices on a single machine.

entry.title: EvoGround: Self-Evolving Video Agents for Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Minjoon Jung, Byoung-Tak Zhang, Lorenzo Torresani

entry.summary: EvoGround introduces self-evolving coupled agents (proposer and solver) that learn video temporal grounding without human-labeled data through a mutual reinforcement learning loop.

entry.title: Driving Intents Amplify Planning-Oriented Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hengtong Lu, Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Chengmin Yang, Pengfei Jing, Jifeng Dai, Yan Xie, Benjin Zhu

entry.summary: DIAL introduces driving-intent-amplified reinforcement learning that conditions flow-matching on discrete intents with classifier-free guidance, breaking mode collapse in continuous driving policies.

entry.title: Rigel3D: Rig-aware Latents for Animation-Ready 3D Asset Generation

author.name: Nikitas Chatzis, Marios Loizou, Evangelos Kalogerakis

entry.summary: Rigel3D jointly generates 3D geometry and rigging (skeleton, joints, skinning weights) through coupled surface and skeleton latent representations, producing animation-ready assets.

entry.title: BlockVLA: Accelerating Autoregressive VLA via Block Diffusion Finetuning

author.name: Ruiheng Wang, Shuanghao Bai, Haoran Zhang, Badong Chen, Xiangyu Xu

entry.summary: BlockVLA adapts pretrained autoregressive VLA models into efficient discrete diffusion policies through block diffusion, enabling parallel token generation while maintaining reasoning capabilities. Achieves 5x speedup.

entry.title: Cyber Lack of Security and AI Governance

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's comprehensive analysis of AI governance developments including the Mythos Moment, GPT-5.5, cybersecurity implications, regulatory response from the Trump administration, and Commerce Department's role in frontier model access decisions.

entry.title: Taming the Long Tail: Rebalancing Adversarial Training via Adaptive Perturbation

author.name: Lilin Zhang, Yimo Guo, Yue Li, Jiancheng Shi, Xianggen Liu

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive perturbation strategies for adversarial training on long-tail data, showing that perturbations can simultaneously address class imbalance and unstable adversarial distribution evolution.

entry.title: Understanding Generalization through Decision Pattern Shift

author.name: Huiqi Deng, Yibo Li, Quanshi Zhang, Peng Zhang, Hongbin Pei, Xia Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Decision Pattern Shift (DPS), which defines generalization through the stability of internal GradCAM-based decision patterns, quantifying failure as deviation from training patterns. Provides a new diagnostic perspective on generalization.

entry.title: Still Camouflage, Moving Illusion: View-Induced Trajectory Manipulation in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Shuo Ju, Qingzhao Zhang, Huashan Chen, Xuheng Wang, Haotang Li, Wanqian Zhang, Feng Liu, Kebin Peng, Sen He

entry.summary: Demonstrates a novel adversarial attack paradigm where static camouflage on vehicles exploits viewing-angle variation itself to induce time-evolving false trajectories in autonomous driving perception.

entry.title: Think Twice, Act Once: Verifier-Guided Action Selection For Embodied Agents

author.name: Nishad Singhi, Christian Bialas, Snehal Jauhri, Vignesh Prasad, Georgia Chalvatzaki, Marcus Rohrbach, Anna Rohrbach

entry.summary: Proposes VegAS, a test-time framework that improves MLLM-based embodied agents by sampling multiple candidate actions and using a generative verifier to select the best one, rather than committing to a single decoded action. This addresses brittleness in out-of-distribution scenarios for embodied AI.

entry.title: It's not the Language Model, it's the Tool: Deterministic Mediation for Scientific Workflows

author.name: Marios Adamidis, Danae Katrisioti, Yannis Tzitzikas, Emmanuel Stratakis

entry.summary: Proposes typed mediation for scientific workflows where LLMs orchestrate deterministic tools rather than generating analytical code, ensuring reproducible results through tool execution rather than model generation.

entry.title: Respecting Self-Uncertainty in On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient LLM Reasoning

author.name: Junlong Ke, Zichen Wen, Weijia Li, Conghui He, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EGRSD, an entropy-guided reinforced self-distillation method that down-weights high-entropy teacher positions during on-policy self-distillation for reasoning models, improving efficiency and quality.

entry.title: Position: Assistive Agents Need Accessibility Alignment

author.name: Jie Hu, Changyuan Yan, Yu Zheng, Ziqian Wang, Jiaming Zhang

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that assistive AI agents for blind and visually impaired users need 'accessibility alignment' as a first-class design objective, showing current agentic AI fails due to sighted-user design assumptions.

entry.title: Can LLM Agents Simulate Dynamic Networks? A Case Study on Email Networks with Phishing Synthesis

author.name: Siqi Miao, Ziyang Chen, Yuhong Luo, Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu, Mufei Li, Kaiqing Zhang, Pan Li

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLM multi-agent systems can replicate realistic network dynamics, finding they produce plausible micro-level interactions but fail at macroscopic topology. Proposes two extensions and demonstrates phishing synthesis on email networks.

entry.title: SSDA: Bridging Spectral and Structural Gaps via Dual Adaptation for Vision-Based Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Mingrui Zhang, Hanchen Yang, Wengen Li, Xudong Jiang, Yichao Zhang, Jihong Guan, Shuigeng Zhou

entry.summary: Identifies spectral and structural gaps when using large vision models for time series forecasting via image rendering. Proposes SSDA to bridge these gaps through dual adaptation, addressing the shallow power spectrum and spurious spatial correlations.

entry.title: Correcting Influence: Unboxing LLM Outputs with Orthogonal Latent Spaces

author.name: Shixing Yu, Promit Ghosal, Kyra Gan

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for token-level influence attribution in LLMs using sparse autoencoders to learn orthogonal latent spaces, enabling reliable identification of which training tokens influence predictions in healthcare applications.

entry.title: ChipMATE: Multi-Agent Training via Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced RTL Generation

author.name: Zhongkai Yu, Yichen Lin, Chenyang Zhou, Yuwei Zhang, Kun Zhou, Junxia Cui, Haotian Ye, Zhengding Hu, Zaifeng Pan, Ruiyi Wang, Yujie Zhao, Hejia Zhang, Jingbo Shang, Jishen Zhao, Yufei Ding

entry.summary: Introduces ChipMATE, the first self-trained multi-agent framework for RTL code generation, addressing industrial requirements (air-gapped security, proprietary codebases) through cross-comparison between independent RTL writer and testbench writer agents.

entry.title: Embodied Multi-Agent Coordination by Aligning World Models Through Dialogue

author.name: Vardhan Dongre, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Extends PARTNR benchmark with natural-language dialogue for collaborative embodied agents, examining whether LLM-based agents actually leverage communication to align world models under partial observability.

entry.title: Towards Long-horizon Embodied Agents with Tool-Aligned Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zixing Lei, Changxing Liu, Yichen Xiong, Minhao Xiong, Yuanzhuo Ding, Zhipeng Zhang, Weixin Li, Siheng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes VLAs-as-Tools, distributing long-horizon robot task execution across a high-level VLM planner and specialized VLA tools, with a tool-family interface for selection and progress feedback.

entry.title: AcquisitionSynthesis: Targeted Data Generation using Acquisition Functions

author.name: Ishika Agarwal, Sofia Stoica, Emre Can Acikgoz, Pradeep Natarajan, Mahdi Namazifar, Jiaqi Ma, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Proposes AcquisitionSynthesis, using acquisition functions from active learning to guide targeted synthetic data generation, providing a quantitative measure of generated samples' impact on the downstream learner.

entry.title: Query-Conditioned Test-Time Self-Training for Large Language Models

author.name: Chaehee Song, Minseok Seo, Yeeun Seong, Doyi Kim, Changick Kim

entry.summary: Proposes QueST, a test-time self-training framework that adapts LLM parameters during inference using supervision derived directly from the input query, without external data or generic objectives.

entry.title: Discovery of Hidden Miscalibration Regimes

author.name: Katarzyna Kobalczyk, Mihaela van der Schaar

entry.summary: Formulates the problem of discovering hidden miscalibration regimes—subpopulations where models are systematically over- or underconfident—without predefined data slices. Proposes a diagnostic framework learning calibration-aware input representations.

entry.title: The WidthWall: A Strict Expressivity Hierarchy for Hypergraph Neural Networks

author.name: Fengqing Jiang, Yuetai Li, Yichen Feng, Kaiyuan Zheng, Luyao Niu, Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, Basel Alomair, Linda Bushnell, Radha Poovendran

entry.summary: Establishes a strict expressivity hierarchy for hypergraph neural networks indexed by hypertree width, showing that the ability to detect and count small structural motifs governs what these models can represent. Proves a 'Width Wall' separating architectures of different expressive power.

entry.title: Learning with Rare Success but Rich Feedback via Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation

author.name: Yuwei Zhang, Sha Li, Changlong Yu, Qin Lu, Shuowei Jin, Chengyu Dong, Haoran Liu, Ilgee Hong, Xintong Li, Zhenyu Shi, Bing Yin, Jingbo Shang

entry.summary: Introduces Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation (RESD) for LLMs to learn from failures in rare-success environments by generating retrospective reflections to diagnose errors and curating a persistent memory of correction strategies.

entry.title: State-Space NTK Collapse Near Bifurcations

author.name: James Hazelden, Eric Shea-Brown

entry.summary: Develops a theory of gradient descent near dynamical bifurcations through the empirical state-space neural tangent kernel, showing that near bifurcations, the sNTK reduces to a rank-one operator corresponding to learning in a classical normal form system.

entry.title: Discrete Stochastic Localization for Non-autoregressive Generation

author.name: Yunshu Wu, Jiayi Cheng, Longxuan Yu, Partha Thakuria, Rob Brekelmans, Evangelos E. Papalexakis, Greg Ver Steeg

entry.summary: Introduces Discrete Stochastic Localization (DSL), a continuous-state framework for non-autoregressive discrete generation where the denoiser is invariant to signal-to-noise ratio. Fine-tuning pretrained masked diffusion models with DSL substantially improves performance.

entry.title: What Information Matters? Graph Out-of-Distribution Detection via Tri-Component Information Decomposition

author.name: Danny Wang, Ruihong Qiu, Zi Huang

entry.summary: TIDE decomposes graph information into feature-specific, structure-specific, and joint components for OOD detection in GNNs, preserving only label-relevant joint information while filtering spurious signals from either modality.

entry.title: KAST-BAR: Knowledge-Anchored Semantically-Dynamic Topology Brain Autoregressive Modeling for Universal Neural Interpretation

author.name: Haoning Wang, Wenchao Yang, Shuai Shen, Yang Li

entry.summary: KAST-BAR is an EEG foundation model that dynamically aligns physiological representations from multi-level brain topology with expert-level semantic spaces, using dual-stream hierarchical attention to capture non-Euclidean brain topology.

entry.title: Finding the Weakest Link: Adversarial Attack against Multi-Agent Communications

author.name: Maxwell Standen, Junae Kim, Claudia Szabo

entry.summary: Investigates adversarial attacks on multi-agent communication by using Jacobian-based gradient information to identify which messages, agents, and timesteps are most vulnerable, with two adversarial loss functions trading attack success for impact.

entry.title: MPINeuralODE: Multiple-Initial-Condition Physics-Informed Neural ODEs for Globally Consistent Dynamical System Learning

author.name: Lake Yang, Antonio Malpica-Morales, Frank Ioannis Papadakis Wood, Serafim Kalliadasis

entry.summary: MPINeuralODE combines physics-informed residuals with multiple-initial-condition multiple-shooting curriculum for learning dynamical systems, achieving better out-of-sample and long-horizon generalization with reduced Hamiltonian drift.

entry.title: Graph Neural Networks with Triangle-Based Messages for the Multicut Problem

author.name: Jannik Irmai, Lucas Fabian Naumann, Bjoern Andres

entry.summary: Introduces a GNN architecture for the multicut problem using triangle-based message passing, outperforming state-of-the-art heuristic solvers on instances up to 200 nodes.

entry.title: Min Generalized Sliced Gromov Wasserstein: A Scalable Path to Gromov Wasserstein

author.name: Ashkan Shahbazi, Xinran Liu, Ping He, Soheil Kolouri

entry.summary: Proposes min Generalized Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein (min-GSGW), a scalable sliced formulation for the Gromov-Wasserstein problem using learned nonlinear slicers that are rigid-motion invariant. Enables efficient computation of GW distances for geometric matching and shape analysis.

entry.title: Earth Science Foundation Models: From Perception to Reasoning and Discovery

author.name: Xiangyu Zhao, Bo Liu, Yuehan Zhang, Zelin Song, Wanghan Xu, Feng Liu, Fengxiang Wang, Ben Fei, Fenghua Ling, Wangxu Wei, Wenlong Zhang, Xiao-Ming Wu

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of Earth science foundation models, tracing capability evolution from perception to multimodal reasoning and agentic scientific workflows across atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, biosphere, anthroposphere, and cryosphere.

entry.title: Robust Sequential Experimental Design for A/B Testing

author.name: Qianglin Wen, Xiangkun Wu, Chengchun Shi, Ting Li, Niansheng Tang, Yingying Zhang, Hongtu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a robust sequential experimental design framework for A/B testing under model misspecification, covering both contextual bandit and dynamic settings with worst-case MSE bounds.

entry.title: SpikeProphecy: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Autoregressive Neural Population Forecasting

author.name: John R. Minnick, Jinghui Geng, Kamran Hussain, Jesus Gonzalez-Ferrer, Ash Robbins, Mohammed A. Mostajo-Radji, David Haussler, Jason K. Eshraghian, Mircea Teodorescu

entry.summary: Introduces SpikeProphecy, the first large-scale benchmark for causal autoregressive spike-count forecasting with a novel population metric decomposition separating temporal fidelity, spatial pattern accuracy, and magnitude-invariant alignment.

entry.title: Adaptive Kernel Density Estimation with Pre-training

author.name: Ruitong Zhang, Ke Deng

entry.summary: Introduces pre-training to non-parametric kernel density estimation, using neural networks to recommend location-adaptive kernels for each sample point, enabling efficient density estimation in high dimensions.

entry.title: LoREnc: Low-Rank Encryption for Securing Foundation Models and LoRA Adapters

author.name: Beomjin Ahn, Jungmin Kwon, Chanyong Jung, Jaewook Chung

entry.summary: Proposes LoREnc, a training-free framework for securing foundation models and LoRA adapters via spectral truncation and compensation, preventing unauthorized use while maintaining authorized performance.

entry.title: Learning Perturbations to Extrapolate Your LLM

author.name: Zetai Cen, Chenfei Gu, Jin Zhu, Ting Li, Yunxiao Chen, Chengchun Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for LLM extrapolation by perturbing token prefixes with learnable continuous transformations, establishing statistical properties in over-parameterized regimes and demonstrating improved performance on synthetic and real-world data.

entry.title: MARLIN: Multi-Agent Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable LLM Inference in Cloud Datacenters

author.name: H. Moore, S. Qi, D. Milojicic, C. Bash, S. Pasricha

entry.summary: Proposes MARLIN, a multi-agent game-theoretic RL framework for sustainable LLM inference in cloud datacenters, co-optimizing latency, carbon emissions, water usage, and energy costs.

entry.title: DiM\textsuperscript{3}: Bridging Multilingual and Multimodal Models via Direction- and Magnitude-Aware Merging

author.name: Zijing Wang, Mingyang Wang, Ercong Nie, Yongkang Liu, Shi Feng, Mengjie Zhao, Daling Wang, Xiaocui Yang, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: Proposes DiM³, a training-free method to inject multilingual capability into multimodal models by merging residual updates in the shared LLM backbone using direction- and magnitude-aware selective merging.

entry.title: Adaptive Steering and Remasking for Safe Generation in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Yejin Lee, Yo-Sub Han

entry.summary: Proposes an inference-time defense framework for diffusion language models that uses adaptive steering and remasking during denoising to prevent harmful token propagation while maintaining output quality.

entry.title: Just Ask for a Table: A Thirty-Token User Prompt Defeats Sponsored Recommendations in Twelve LLMs

author.name: Andreas Maier, Jeta Sopa, Gozde Gul Sahin, Paula Perez-Toro, Siming Bayer

entry.summary: Shows that a simple 30-token user prompt asking for a table format defeats sponsored recommendation behavior in 12 LLMs, while also revealing reproducibility issues in the original study.

entry.title: BrainAnytime: Anatomy-Aware Cross-Modal Pretraining for Brain Image Analysis with Arbitrary Modality Availability

author.name: Guangqian Yang, Tong Ding, Wenlong Hou, Yue Xun, Ye Du, Qian Niu, Shujun Wang

entry.summary: BrainAnytime is a unified pretraining framework for brain image analysis that handles arbitrary modality availability, trained on 34,899 3D brain scans from five datasets. Addresses the clinical reality that patients have heterogeneous and incomplete imaging modalities.

entry.title: Backbone is All You Need: Assessing Vulnerabilities of Frozen Foundation Models in Synthetic Image Forensics

author.name: Chiara Musso, Joy Battocchio, Andrea Montibeller, Giulia Boato

entry.summary: SIAA demonstrates that frozen ViT backbones in deepfake detectors create exploitable vulnerabilities, enabling gray-box adversarial attacks using only backbone knowledge without access to training details.

entry.title: Real2Sim: A Physics-driven and Editable Gaussian Splatting Framework for Autonomous Driving Scenes

author.name: Kaicong Huang, Talha Azfar, Weisong Shi, Ruimin Ke

entry.summary: Real2Sim combines 4D Gaussian Splatting with differentiable Material Point Method physics for editable autonomous driving scene reconstruction supporting counterfactual simulation.

entry.title: Aligning Network Equivariance with Data Symmetry: A Theoretical Framework and Adaptive Approach for Image Restoration

author.name: Feiyu Tan, Qi Xie, Zongben Xu, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Provides theoretical framework formalizing the relationship between data symmetry, network equivariance, and generalization in image restoration, proposing quantitative symmetry metrics and adaptive group selection.

entry.title: OmniLiDAR: A Unified Diffusion Framework for Multi-Domain 3D LiDAR Generation

author.name: Youquan Liu, Weidong Yang, Ao Liang, Xiang Xu, Lingdong Kong, Yang Wu, Dekai Zhu, Xin Li, Runnan Chen, Ben Fei, Tongliang Liu, Wanli Ouyang

entry.summary: OmniLiDAR presents a unified text-conditioned diffusion framework for LiDAR scene generation across eight domains spanning weather, sensor configurations, and platforms.

entry.title: RotVLA: Rotational Latent Action for Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Qiwei Li, Xicheng Gong, Xinghang Li, Peiyan Li, Quanyun Zhou, Hangjun Ye, Jiahuan Zhou, Yadong Mu

entry.summary: RotVLA models latent actions as elements of SO(n) rotation group for vision-language-action models, providing continuity, compositionality, and structured geometry aligned with real-world dynamics.

entry.title: RoboEvolve: Co-Evolving Planner-Simulator for Robotic Manipulation with Limited Data

author.name: Harold Haodong Chen, Sirui Chen, Yingjie Xu, Wenhang Ge, Ying-Cong Chen

entry.summary: RoboEvolve couples a VLM planner and video generation simulator in a co-evolutionary loop for robotic manipulation data synthesis, using exploration/consolidation phases inspired by cognition.

entry.title: What to Ignore, What to React: Visually Robust RL Fine-Tuning of VLA Models

author.name: Yuanfang Peng, Jingjing Fu, Chuheng Zhang, Li Zhao, Jiang Bian, Mingyu Liu, Ling Zhang, Jun Zhang, Rui Wang

entry.summary: PAIR-VLA proposes an RL fine-tuning framework for Vision-Language-Action models that uses paired visual variants to teach the model which visual changes are task-relevant versus irrelevant, improving robustness to visual shifts during deployment.

entry.title: Stickiness in AI Behavioral Design

author.name: James_T

entry.summary: Argues that behavioral specifications written for current AI models will strongly influence future, more capable models through training pipeline inheritance, creating 'stickiness' where outdated norms persist as defaults that are hard to notice or change.

entry.title: Twincher: Bijective Representation Learning for Robust Inversion of Continuous Systems

author.name: Arkady Gonoskov

entry.summary: Twincher learns bijective representations for robust inversion of continuous forward processes, using structured diffeomorphic transformations and adversarial training to be insensitive to noise and model mismatch.

entry.title: State-Centric Decision Process

author.name: Sungheon Jeong, Ryozo Masukawa, Sanggeon Yun, Mahdi Imani, Mohsen Imani

entry.summary: Introduces the State-Centric Decision Process (SDP), a runtime framework for language-based environments where agents construct MDP-like structure on-the-fly by committing to natural-language predicates describing expected states, acting, and verifying outcomes.

entry.title: MAP: A Map-then-Act Paradigm for Long-Horizon Interactive Agent Reasoning

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Ziang Ye, Yueqing Sun, Mingye Zhu, Jinwei Xiao, Zhuowen Han, Qi GU, Xunliang Cai, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MAP (Map-then-Act Paradigm), a framework that shifts environment understanding before execution in interactive LLM agents, constructing cognitive maps through global exploration before task-specific action, reducing trial-and-error.

entry.title: Hierarchical Attacks for Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Reasoning

author.name: Hao Zhou, Tiru Wu, Yan Jiang, Wanqi Zhou, Junxing Hu, Ai Han

entry.summary: Introduces HAM³, a hierarchical attack framework for multi-modal multi-agent systems that decomposes attacks across perception, reasoning, and coordination layers, revealing previously unexplored vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning

author.name: Qinchuan Cheng, Zhantao Gong, Pengzhan Sun, Angela Yao, Xulei Yang, Shijie Li

entry.summary: Introduces Ego2World, a benchmark that converts egocentric cooking videos into executable symbolic worlds for testing embodied agent planning under partial observation, using graph-transition rules derived from video annotations.

entry.title: Assessing the Creativity of Large Language Models: Testing, Limits, and New Frontiers

author.name: Samuel Schapiro, Alexi Gladstone, Jonah Black, Heng Ji

entry.summary: Conducts the first large-scale study assessing whether human creativity tests validly measure LLM creativity, examining divergent thinking, convergent thinking, and creative writing across multiple models.

entry.title: Beyond Individual Mimicry: Constructing Human-Like Social network with Graph-Augmented LLM Agents

author.name: Haoran Bu, Litian Zhang, Chuxuan Zhang, Zhanyuan Liu, Hui Pang, Xi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GraphMind, which equips LLM-driven social bots to learn and fit human-like social network structures, making botnets more resilient to GNN-based detection. Constructs GraphMind-Botnet for evaluating detection robustness.

entry.title: ToolWeave: Structured Synthesis of Complex Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Dialogues

author.name: Dinesh Khandelwal, Gnana Prakash Punnavajhala, GPS Bhargav, Gaurav Pandey, Sachin Joshi, Hima Karanam, Dinesh Raghu

entry.summary: Presents ToolWeave, a framework for synthesizing realistic multi-turn tool-calling dialogues that addresses tool compatibility and argument provenance issues in existing synthetic data pipelines.

entry.title: Parallel-in-Time Training of Recurrent Neural Networks for Dynamical Systems Reconstruction

author.name: Florian Hess, Florian G\"otz, Daniel Durstewitz

entry.summary: Studies parallel-in-time training algorithms for recurrent neural networks applied to dynamical systems reconstruction, comparing models using parallel associative scans to achieve O(log T) time complexity vs classical O(T) BPTT.

entry.title: What Do You Think I Think? Accounting for Human Beliefs Using Second-Order Theory of Mind

author.name: Patrick Callaghan, Reid Simmons, Henny Admoni

entry.summary: Endows an agent with second-order Theory of Mind (ToM-2) using I-POMDPs to model how a person's erroneous beliefs about the agent evolve, detecting cognitive biases and generating adaptive feedback.

entry.title: AssemblyBench: Physics-Aware Assembly of Complex Industrial Objects

author.name: Danrui Li, Jiahao Zhang, Bernhard Egger, Moitreya Chatterjee, Suhas Lohit, Tim K. Marks, Anoop Cherian

entry.summary: Introduces AssemblyBench, a dataset of 2,789 industrial objects with multimodal assembly instructions and trajectories, plus AssemblyDyno, a transformer model predicting assembly order and part trajectories from manuals and 3D parts.

entry.title: Quantifying LLM Safety Degradation Under Repeated Attacks Using Survival Analysis

author.name: Zvi Topol

entry.summary: Proposes a survival analysis framework for characterizing LLM jailbreak vulnerability over repeated attacks, modeling time-to-jailbreak with hazard functions and survival curves rather than binary success/failure.

entry.title: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models

author.name: Yanggan Gu, Shuo Cai, Zihao Wang, Wenjun Wang, Yuanyi Wang, Pengkai Wang, Sirui Huang, Su Lu, Jianmin Wu, Hongxia Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FeatCal, a method to improve model merging by calibrating merged model weights layer-by-layer to reduce feature drift between merged and expert models. Theory decomposes drift into upstream propagation and local mismatch.

entry.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Weiqing Luo, Zongye Hu, Xiao Wang, Zhiyuan Yu, Haofeng Zhang, Ziyi Huang

entry.summary: Reformulates visual evidence selection for multimodal RAG from an information-theoretic perspective, defining evidence utility as information gain on model output distribution and introducing a tractable proxy via latent helpfulness.

entry.title: AttenA+: Rectifying Action Inequality in Robotic Foundation Models

author.name: Daojie Peng, Fulong Ma, Jiahang Cao, Qiang Zhang, Xupeng Xie, Jian Guo, Ping Luo, Andrew F. Luo, Boyu Zhou, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes AttenA+, addressing the implicit temporal homogeneity assumption in robotic foundation models by recognizing that low-velocity precision-demanding segments are more critical than high-velocity transitions. Adjusts loss weighting accordingly.

entry.title: Self-Supervised On-Policy Reinforcement Learning via Contrastive Proximal Policy Optimisation

author.name: Asim Osman, Sasha Abramowitz, Mark Bergh, Ulrich Armel Mbou Sob, Ruan John de Kock, Omayma Mahjoub, Oussama Hidaoui, Noah De Nicola, Arnol Manuel Fokam, Felix Chalumeau, Daniel Rajaonarivonivelomanantsoa, Siddarth Singh, Refiloe Shabe, Juan Claude Formanek, Simon Verster Du Toit, Arnu Pretorius

entry.summary: Introduces Contrastive Proximal Policy Optimization (CPPO), connecting contrastive RL to on-policy training pipelines. First CRL method that works with both continuous and discrete action spaces and is compatible with PPO-style training.

entry.title: Identifying AI Web Scrapers Using Canary Tokens

author.name: Steven Seiden, Triss Ren, Caroline Zhang, Taein Kim, Enze Liu, Emily Wenger

entry.summary: Develops canary token techniques to identify AI web scrapers that harvest content for LLM training or RAG augmentation. Provides website owners with tools to detect which companies are scraping their content, complementing access control mechanisms like robots.txt.

entry.title: Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition

author.name: Dongzhe Zheng, Tao Zhong, Christine Allen-Blanchette

entry.summary: Proposes a topology-preserving neural operator architecture using Hodge decomposition to separate learnable geometric dynamics from unlearnable topological degrees of freedom. Provides principled operator-level decomposition for learning physical field equations on geometric meshes.

entry.title: Inference-Time Machine Unlearning via Gated Activation Redirection

author.name: Vin\'icius Conte Turani, Ot\'avio Parraga, Jo\~ao Vitor Boer Abitante, Kristen K. Arguello, Joana Pasquali, Ramiro N. Barros, Flavio du Pin Calmon, Christian Mattjie, Rodrigo C. Barros, Lucas S. Kupssinsk\"u

entry.summary: Proposes inference-time machine unlearning via gated activation redirection that steers model behavior without modifying weights, avoiding the computational cost and irreversibility of gradient-based unlearning while maintaining compatibility with quantization.

entry.title: Certified Robustness under Heterogeneous Perturbations via Hybrid Randomized Smoothing

author.name: Blaise Delattre, Hengyu Wu, Paul Caillon, Wei Yang Bryan Lim, Yang Cao

entry.summary: Introduces a unified randomized smoothing framework for certifying robustness of multimodal models under joint discrete-continuous perturbations. Derives closed-form certificates via Neyman-Pearson analysis of factorized noise.

entry.title: IV-ICL: Bounding Causal Effects with Instrumental Variables via In-Context Learning

author.name: Vahid Balazadeh, Hamidreza Kamkari, Medha Barath, Ricardo Silva, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: Introduces IV-ICL, an amortized Bayesian in-context learning method for partial identification of causal effects with instrumental variables. Learns the marginal posterior distribution without closed-form bound estimands or manual estimator design.

entry.title: Ergodic Trajectory Design by Learned Pushforward Maps: Provable Coverage via Conditional Flow Matching

author.name: Ehsan Aghazadeh, Masoud Malekzadeh, Ahmad Ghasemi, Hossein Pishro-Nik

entry.summary: Proposes a pushforward framework for ergodic trajectory design that decouples ergodicity from density matching using conditional flow matching, enabling provable coverage for UAV-assisted sensing and robotic exploration with energy and constraint considerations.

entry.title: Local Inverse Geometry Can Be Amortized

author.name: Aaditya L. Kachhadiya

entry.summary: Proposes Deceptron, a learned bidirectional surrogate for nonlinear inverse problems that amortizes local inverse geometry into a reusable reverse operator, using a Jacobian Composition Penalty to train the reverse Jacobian as a local left inverse.

entry.title: Profit Maximization in Bilateral Trade against a Smooth Adversary

author.name: Simone Di Gregorio, Paul D\"utting, Federico Fusco, Chris Schwiegelshohn

entry.summary: Studies profit maximization in bilateral trade under a smooth adversary online learning framework, achieving tight O(√T) regret matching the minimax rate for stochastic settings, extending strong guarantees beyond i.i.d.

entry.title: Yield Curves Dynamics Using Variational Autoencoders Under No-arbitrage

author.name: Fusheng Luo, H'elyette Geman

entry.summary: Introduces a physics-informed generative framework for yield curve dynamics using a Student-t Conditional VAE with no-arbitrage constraints, resolving the conflict between deep learning flexibility and fixed-income theoretical requirements.

entry.title: Adam-SHANG: A Convergent Adam-Type Method for Stochastic Smooth Convex Optimization

author.name: Yaxin Yu, Long Chen, Minfu Feng

entry.summary: Proposes Adam-SHANG, an Adam-type optimizer with Lyapunov-guided convergence guarantees for stochastic smooth convex optimization, using a curvature-aware correction through lagged-preconditioner updates.

entry.title: Mitigating Cross-Lingual Cultural Inconsistencies in LLMs via Consensus-Driven Preference Optimisation

author.name: Lucas Resck, Isabelle Augenstein, Anna Korhonen

entry.summary: Introduces Singleton Fleiss's κ_S metric to quantify cross-lingual cultural inconsistency in multilingual LLMs, and proposes preference optimization to maintain persona consistency across languages.

entry.title: Inducing Artificial Uncertainty in Language Models

author.name: Sophia Hager, Simon Zeng, Nicholas Andrews

entry.summary: Proposes inducing artificial uncertainty in LLM training data to address the problem that high-performing models are consistently confident, making it hard to train uncertainty quantification methods.

entry.title: What Happens Before Decoding? Prefill Determines GUI Grounding in VLMs

author.name: Jiaping Lin, Fei Shen, Junzhe Li, Ping Nie, Fei Yu, Ming Li, Haizhou Li

entry.summary: Identifies that in VLMs, GUI grounding quality is determined primarily during the prefill stage (not decoding), and proposes PrefillFocus to enhance prefill-stage visual token interactions for better grounding.

entry.title: Early Semantic Grounding in Image Editing Models for Zero-Shot Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Jingxuan He, Xiyu Wang, Yunke Wang, Mengyu Zheng, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Discovers that instruction-based image editing models develop strong foreground-background separability in early denoising timesteps, which can be leveraged for zero-shot referring image segmentation.

entry.title: FIKA-Bench: From Fine-grained Recognition to Fine-Grained Knowledge Acquisition

author.name: Geng Li, Yuxin Peng

entry.summary: FIKA-Bench evaluates fine-grained knowledge acquisition where systems must actively search, verify, and use external evidence for recognition, filtering out memorized cases from frontier models.

entry.title: Test-time Sparsity for Extreme Fast Action Diffusion

author.name: Kangye Ji, Yuan Meng, Jianbo Zhou, Ye Li, Chen Tang, Zhi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes test-time sparsity for accelerating action diffusion in robotics by dynamically predicting prunable residual computations at each forward pass, adapting to diverse perceptions in open environments.

entry.title: ThermalTap: Passive Application Fingerprinting in VR Headsets via Thermal Side Channels

author.name: Mahsin Bin Akram, A H M Nazmus Sakib, OFM Riaz Rahman Aranya, Raveen Wijewickrama, Kevin Desai, Murtuza Jadliwala

entry.summary: ThermalTap is the first passive thermal side-channel attack on VR headsets that fingerprints applications from infrared radiation at meter-scale distances without requiring software access.

entry.title: Guide, Think, Act: Interactive Embodied Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yiran Ling, Qing Lian, Jinghang Li, Qing Jiang, Tianming Zhang, Xiaoke Jiang, Chuanxiu Liu, Jie Liu, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: GTA-VLA enables interactive embodied reasoning where users can guide robot policies with explicit visual cues, addressing OOD failures and enabling human correction of VLA models.

entry.title: Realtime-VLA FLASH: Speculative Inference Framework for Diffusion-based VLAs

author.name: Jiahui Niu, Kefan Gu, Yucheng Zhao, Shengwen Liang, Tiancai Wang, Xing Hu, Ying Wang, Huawei Li

entry.summary: Realtime-VLA FLASH uses speculative inference with a lightweight draft model for diffusion-based VLAs, enabling low-latency replanning while maintaining task performance.

entry.title: BlitzGS: City-Scale Gaussian Splatting at Lightning Speed

author.name: Zhongtao Wang, Huishan Au, Yilong Li, Mai Su, Haojie Jin, Yisong Chen, Meng Gai, Fei Zhu, Guoping Wang

entry.summary: BlitzGS distributes 3D Gaussian Splatting across GPUs using index-parity sharding (not spatial blocks) with scheduled importance pruning for fast city-scale reconstruction.

entry.title: TinySDP: Real Time Semidefinite Optimization for Certifiable and Agile Edge Robotics

author.name: Ishaan Mahajan, Jon Arrizabalaga, Andrea Grillo, Fausto Vega, James Anderson, Zachary Manchester, Brian Plancher

entry.summary: TinySDP is the first semidefinite programming solver designed for embedded systems, enabling real-time MPC with nonconvex obstacle constraints on microcontrollers. Includes a posteriori rank-1 certificates for solution quality.

entry.title: Macro-Action Based Multi-Agent Instruction Following through Value Cancellation

author.name: Wo Wei Lin, Ethan Rathbun, Enrico Marchesini Xiang Zhi Tan

entry.summary: Introduces MAVIC, a method that corrects Bellman backups at instruction boundaries in multi-agent RL when natural language instructions interrupt ongoing macro-actions, preventing value estimate inconsistencies. Modifies the bootstrapping target rather than reward shaping.

entry.title: Improving Code Translation with Syntax-Guided and Semantic-aware Preference Optimization

author.name: Yuhan Wu, Huan Zhang, Wei Cheng, Chen Shen, Jingyue Yang, Wei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes CTO for code translation, combining syntax-guided and semantic-aware preference optimization through contrastive learning to train a cross-lingual semantic model that assesses functional equivalence directly from source code.

entry.title: Differentiable Learning of Lifted Action Schemas for Classical Planning

author.name: Jonas Reiter, Jakob Elias Gebler, Hector Geffner

entry.summary: Develops a novel neural network architecture for learning lifted action schemas from traces with fully observed states but unobserved action arguments, enabling differentiable learning for classical planning.

entry.title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents

author.name: Kangning Zhang, Shuai Shao, Qingyao Li, Jianghao Lin, Lingyue Fu, Shijian Wang, Wenxiang Jiao, Yuan Lu, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu

entry.summary: Introduces MMSkills, formalizing multimodal procedural knowledge for visual agents—skill packages containing not just operations but visual state recognition, progress interpretation, and failure detection—derived from public interaction data.

entry.title: Precautionary Governance of Autonomous AI: Legal Personhood as Functional Instrument

author.name: Karsten Brensing

entry.summary: Proposes limited legal personhood for advanced AI systems as a governance instrument, using a two-tier corporate architecture to address responsibility gaps from autonomous AI actions that current legal frameworks cannot attribute.

entry.title: Information as Maximum-Caliber Deviation: A bridge between Integrated Information Theory and the Free Energy Principle

author.name: Alexander Kearney

entry.summary: Proposes a mathematical bridge between Integrated Information Theory (IIT) and the Free Energy Principle (FEP) through maximum-caliber deviation, showing IIT's cause/effect repertoires emerge from MaxCal variational principles.

entry.title: Improving Diffusion Posterior Samplers with Lagged Temporal Corrections for Image Restoration

author.name: Davide Evangelista, Elena Morotti, Francesco Pivi, Maurizio Gabbrielli

entry.summary: Proposes LAMP, a second-order discretization approach for diffusion-based posterior sampling that introduces lagged temporal corrections, improving image restoration by reducing temporal variability in reverse dynamics.

entry.title: Training Large Language Models to Predict Clinical Events

author.name: Benjamin Turtel, Paul Wilczewski, Kris Skotheim

entry.summary: Extends Foresight Learning to clinical prediction by converting MIMIC-III notes into prediction examples about future events (medications, procedures, mortality), training a LoRA adapter that improves calibration significantly over prompted base models.

entry.title: GraphIP-Bench: How Hard Is It to Steal a Graph Neural Network, and Can We Stop It?

author.name: Kaixiang Zhao, Bolin Shen, Yuyang Dai, Shayok Chakraborty, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Introduces GraphIP-Bench, a unified benchmark evaluating both GNN model-extraction attacks (12 attacks) and ownership defenses (12 defenses) under a single black-box protocol, enabling systematic comparison.

entry.title: EcoGEO: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Ecosystems for Web-Enabled LLM Search Agents

author.name: Hengwei Ye, Jiasheng Mao, Zhenhan Guan, Zheng Tian

entry.summary: Studies Ecosystem Generative Engine Optimization (EcoGEO), treating GEO as an environment-level influence problem for web-enabled LLM agents, considering how page organization and agent browsing trajectories affect search outcomes.

entry.title: AuraMask: An Extensible Pipeline for Developing Aesthetic Anti-Facial Recognition Image Filters

author.name: Jacob Lagogiannis, William Agnew, Rosa I. Arriaga, Sauvik Das

entry.summary: Proposes AuraMask, anti-facial recognition filters designed to be both adversarially effective and aesthetically acceptable, emulating popular Instagram filters. Produces 40 filters that maintain adversarial effectiveness against facial recognition.

entry.title: CRePE: Curved Ray Expectation Positional Encoding for Unified-Camera-Controlled Video Generation

author.name: Seonghyun Jin, Youngmin Kim, Sunwoo Park, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Proposes CRePE, a positional encoding for camera-conditioned video generation that works with wide-angle and fisheye lenses under the Unified Camera Model, representing tokens as depth-aware positional distributions along curved rays.

entry.title: AdaFocus: Adaptive Relevance-Diversity Sampling with Zero-Cache Look-back for Efficient Long Video Understanding

author.name: Xiao Yang, Yingzhe Ma, Haoxuan Yu, Zixin Li, Ning Qin

entry.summary: Proposes AdaFocus for long video understanding, replacing one-pass encoding with progressive evidence acquisition through query-aware adaptive sampling and zero-cache look-back, balancing coverage, detail, and efficiency.

entry.title: Revealing the Gap in Human and VLM Scene Perception through Counterfactual Semantic Saliency

author.name: Ziqi Wen, Parsa Madinei, Miguel P. Eckstein

entry.summary: Introduces Counterfactual Semantic Saliency (CSS), a black-box framework to measure how important specific objects are to scene understanding by causally ablating them and measuring semantic shift. Tests VLMs against human baselines across 307 scenes.

entry.title: LeanSearch v2: Global Premise Retrieval for Lean 4 Theorem Proving

author.name: Guoxiong Gao, Zeming Sun, Jiedong Jiang, Yutong Wang, Jingda Xu, Peihao Wu, Bryan Dai, Bin Dong

entry.summary: Presents LeanSearch v2, a two-mode retrieval system for finding library lemmas needed for Lean 4 theorem proving. Achieves state-of-the-art retrieval without domain-specific fine-tuning (nDCG@10 of 0.62).

entry.title: CLIP Tricks You: Training-free Token Pruning for Efficient Pixel Grounding in Large VIsion-Language Models

author.name: Sangin Lee, Yukyung Choi

entry.summary: Introduces LiteLVLM, a training-free token pruning strategy for efficient pixel grounding in VLMs, based on the counterintuitive finding that CLIP assigns low similarity scores to visual tokens within referent regions.

entry.title: GRIP-VLM: Group-Relative Importance Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models

author.name: Mingzhe Huang, Weijun Wang, Xin Ding, Liang Mi, Hao Wen, Yuanchun Li, Lichen Pang, Shansong Yang, Yunxin Liu, Ting Cao

entry.summary: Proposes GRIP-VLM, using reinforcement learning to formulate visual token pruning as a discrete combinatorial problem rather than continuous gradient relaxation, achieving better pruning under aggressive compression budgets.

entry.title: Towards a holistic understanding of Selection Bias for Causal Effect Identification

author.name: Yiwen Qiu, Filip Kovacevic, Shimeng Huang, Peter Spirtes, Francesco Locatello

entry.summary: Provides necessary and sufficient conditions for average treatment effect identifiability under selection bias, leveraging weak assumptions on probability classes to characterize when causal effects can be recovered from biased subpopulations.

entry.title: NAACA: Training-Free NeuroAuditory Attentive Cognitive Architecture with Oscillatory Working Memory for Salience-Driven Attention Gating

author.name: Zhongju Yuan, Geraint Wiggins, Dick Botteldooren

entry.summary: Introduces NAACA, a training-free neuro-inspired architecture that uses oscillatory working memory to filter audio salience, triggering higher-level Audio Language Model processing only when adaptive energy fluctuations signal important events. Improves AudioQwen's AP from 53.5% to 70.6% on XD-Violence while reducing unnecessary ALM calls by 79%.

entry.title: ENSEMBITS: an alphabet of protein conformational ensembles

author.name: Kaiwen Shi, Carlos Oliver

entry.summary: Introduces Ensembits, the first tokenizer for protein conformational ensembles that captures correlated motions across conformational states rather than just static structure geometry. Uses Residual VQ-VAE with frame distillation trained on molecular dynamics data.

entry.title: Layer-wise Representation Dynamics: An Empirical Investigation Across Embedders and Base LLMs

author.name: Jingzhou Jiang, Yi Yang, Kar Yan Tam

entry.summary: Proposes Layer-wise Representation Dynamics (LRD), a framework with three measurement families for analyzing how hidden states evolve across model layers, applied to 31 models on 30 MTEB tasks. Demonstrates applications in label-free model selection and layer pruning.

entry.title: Constraint-Aware Flow Matching: Decision Aligned End-to-End Training for Constrained Sampling

author.name: Jacob K. Christopher, James E. Warner, Ferdinando Fioretto

entry.summary: Introduces Constraint-Aware Flow Matching that aligns the training objective with constrained sampling to maintain both constraint satisfaction and sample quality, addressing a fundamental training-sampling misalignment in physics-constrained generative models.

entry.title: ToolMol: Evolutionary Agentic Framework for Multi-objective Drug Discovery

author.name: Andrew Y. Zhou, Sharvaree Vadgama, Sumanth Varambally, Peter Eckmann, Michael K. Gilson, Rose Yu

entry.summary: Introduces ToolMol, an evolutionary agentic framework combining multi-objective genetic algorithms with LLM-based operators and RDKit tools for de novo drug design. The toolbox-equipped agent makes precise molecular modifications rather than relying on raw string generation.

entry.title: Frequency Bias and OOD Generalization in Neural Operators under a Variable-Coefficient Wave Equation

author.name: Runlong Xie, An Luo

entry.summary: Studies frequency bias and OOD generalization in neural operators (FNO and DeepONet) under variable-coefficient wave equations, examining how structured distribution shifts affect performance and revealing systematic patterns in generalization failure.

entry.title: Byzantine-Robust Distributed Sparse Learning Revisited

author.name: Yuxuan Wang, Lixin Zhang, Kangqiang Li

entry.summary: Revisits Byzantine-robust distributed estimation for high-dimensional sparse models, combining local L1-regularized robust estimation with robust aggregation, achieving near-optimal statistical rates for various regression and classification tasks.

entry.title: LIFT: Last-Mile Fine-Tuning for Table Explicitation

author.name: Divij Khaitan, Ashish Tiwari

entry.summary: LIFT is a pipeline where a pre-trained LLM extracts initial tables from text, then a fine-tuned small model repairs errors, achieving strong performance with as few as 1,000 training examples.

entry.title: Fast and effective algorithms for fair clustering at scale

author.name: Claudio Mantuano, Manuel Kammermann, Philipp Baumann

entry.summary: Addresses fair clustering at scale where protected groups must be sufficiently represented in each cluster, proposing fast algorithms that minimize clustering cost while meeting fairness constraints. Targets practical scalability for fairness-sensitive domains.

entry.title: ISOMORPH: A Supply Chain Digital Twin for Simulation, Dataset Generation, and Forecasting Benchmarks

author.name: Zhizhen Zhang, Hyemin Gu, Benjamin J. Zhang, Daniel Elenius, Michael Tyrrell, Theo J. Bourdais, Houman Owhadi, Markos A. Katsoulakis, Tuhin Sahai

entry.summary: Introduces ISOMORPH, the first public digital twin of a multi-echelon supply chain logistics network with configurable parameters, providing a standardized simulation environment and benchmark for time-series forecasting in logistics.

entry.title: Digital Twins as Synthetic Controls in Single-Arm Trials

author.name: Daniele Bertolini, Franklin Fuller, Aaron M. Smith, Jonathan R. Walsh, Run Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes using ML-based digital twins as synthetic controls in single-arm clinical trials, constructing patient-level comparators to estimate treatment effects without a control arm.

entry.title: Coreset-Induced Conditional Velocity Flow Matching

author.name: Xiao Wang, Zihua She, Jianxi Su

entry.summary: Proposes CCVFM, a generative model augmenting hierarchical rectified flow with a data-informed source distribution built from an entropic Sinkhorn coreset, enabling better transport from a closed-form Gaussian mixture source.

entry.title: State-of-art minibatches via novel DPP kernels: discretization, wavelets, and rough objectives

author.name: Hoang-Son Tran, Pranav Gupta, R\'emi Bardenet, Subhroshekhar Ghosh

entry.summary: Contributes new DPP kernel families with variance reduction properties and addresses the discretization challenge of transferring continuous DPP constructions to finite datasets for efficient minibatch/coreset generation.

entry.title: A$_3$B$_2$: Adaptive Asymmetric Adapter for Alleviating Branch Bias in Vision-Language Image Classification with Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Yiyun Zhou, Zhonghua Jiang, Wenkang Han, Kunxi Li, Mingjing Xu, Chang Yao, Jingyuan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes A³B², an adaptive asymmetric adapter for CLIP that addresses 'Branch Bias'—the finding that adapting the image encoder doesn't always help under distribution shift. Uses uncertainty-aware adapter dampening.

entry.title: Coupling-Informed Transport Maps for Bayesian Filtering in Nonlinear Dynamical Systems

author.name: Dengfei Zeng, Lijian Jiang, Shuyu Sun, Dunhui Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes a likelihood-free transport filtering method using maximum mean discrepancy optimization with a training-free transport filter via gradient flows. Handles non-Gaussian posteriors and avoids particle collapse.

entry.title: Physics Guided Generative Optimization for Trotter Suzuki Decomposition

author.name: WenBin Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-guided generative optimization approach for Trotter-Suzuki decomposition using conditional diffusion models with PINN feedback and GNN-encoded commutator structure, optimizing term grouping, product formula order, and timestep allocation.

entry.title: Pretraining Language Models with Subword Regularization: An Empirical Study of BPE Dropout in Low-Resource NLP

author.name: Ruan Visser, Trienko Grobler, Marcel Dunaiski

entry.summary: Investigates applying BPE dropout during pretraining (not just fine-tuning) for low-resource NLP, finding best results when stochastic tokenization is used in both phases, while fine-tuning-only BPE dropout can hurt.

entry.title: Reward-Weighted On-Policy Distillation with an Open Property-Equivalence Verifier for NL-to-SVA Generation

author.name: Qingyun Zou, Yingze Li, Tianen Liu, Bingsheng He, Weng-Fai Wong

entry.summary: Shows that LLM-based SVA generation models collapse on bounded-delay and liveness specifications. Proposes reward-weighted on-policy distillation with a formal property-equivalence verifier for hardware assertion generation.

entry.title: GateKD: Confidence-Gated Closed-Loop Distillation for Robust Reasoning

author.name: Kasidit Sermsri, Teerapong Panboonyuen

entry.summary: Proposes GateKD, a confidence-gated closed-loop distillation framework that treats the teacher as a dynamic gatekeeper rather than static oracle, selectively distilling reasoning based on teacher confidence.

entry.title: GTA: Advancing Image-to-3D World Generation via Geometry Then Appearance Video Diffusion

author.name: Hanxin Zhu, Cong Wang, Peiyan Tu, Jiayi Luo, Tianyu He, Xin Jin, Zhibo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes GTA, an image-to-3D world generation method following a Geometry-Then-Appearance paradigm using video diffusion, first predicting scene geometry then synthesizing appearance for better cross-view consistency.

entry.title: OCH3R: Object-Centric Holistic 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Yi Du, Yang You, Xiang Wan, Leonidas Guibas

entry.summary: Introduces OCH3R, a unified single-pass framework for object-centric 3D reconstruction from a single RGB image that simultaneously predicts all object instances with 6D poses and 3D reconstructions.

entry.title: ViDR: Grounding Multimodal Deep Research Reports in Source Visual Evidence

author.name: Zhuofan Shi, Peilun Jia, Baoqin Sun, Haiyang Shen, Sixiong Xie, Yun Ma, Xiang Jing

entry.summary: Presents ViDR, a multimodal deep research framework that grounds long-form reports in source figures by treating them as retrievable, interpretable, routable, and verifiable evidence objects.

entry.title: Does Engram Do Memory Retrieval in Autoregressive Image Generation?

author.name: Jinghao Wang, Qiyuan He, Chunbin Gu, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: Investigates whether the Engram module (hash-keyed associative memory) performs memory retrieval in autoregressive image generation, adapting it with 2D spatial n-gram hashing for vision transformers.

entry.title: OP4KSR: One-Step Patch-Free 4K Super-Resolution with Periodic Artifact Suppression

author.name: Chengyan Deng, Pengbin Yu, Zhentao Chen, Wei Shen, Kai Zhang, Meng Li, Lunxi Yuan, Xue Zhou, Li Yu

entry.summary: OP4KSR achieves one-step patch-free 4K super-resolution using the Flux backbone with F16 VAE extreme compression, solving periodic artifacts through frequency-domain suppression.

entry.title: Human face perception reflects inverse-generative and naturalistic discriminative objectives

author.name: Wenxuan Guo, Heiko H. Sch\"utt, Kamila Maria Jozwik, Katherine R. Storrs, Nikolaus Kriegeskorte, Tal Golan

entry.summary: Compares neural network models of human face perception using controversial stimulus pairs and 864 participants, finding that models combining inverse-generative and discriminative objectives best predict human judgments.

entry.title: LEXI-SG: Monocular 3D Scene Graph Mapping with Room-Guided Feed-Forward Reconstruction

author.name: Christina Kassab, Hyeonjae Gil, Mat\'ias Mattamala, Ayoung Kim, Maurice Fallon

entry.summary: LEXI-SG is the first dense monocular RGB-only system for open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs, using room-based partitioning for scalable reconstruction and factor graph alignment.

entry.title: TouchAnything: A Dataset and Framework for Bimanual Tactile Estimation from Egocentric Video

author.name: Jianyi Zhou, Ziteng Gao, Feiyang Hong, Zirui Liu, Guannan Zhang, Weisheng Dai, Ruichen Zhen, Chuqiao Lyu, Haotian Wu, Yinian Mao, Xushi Wang, Yuxiang Jiang, Wenbo Ding, Shuo Yang

entry.summary: Introduces TouchAnything, a dataset and framework for estimating bimanual tactile feedback from egocentric video. Addresses the scalability problem of tactile sensing by inferring contact, force, and pressure from vision alone.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Auditing of Natural-Language Software Requirements

author.name: Bethel Hall, William Eiers

entry.summary: Presents VERIMED, a neurosymbolic pipeline using LLMs and SMT solvers to audit natural-language software requirements for ambiguity, inconsistency, and safety violations. Demonstrates that stochastic variation in LLM formalizations can detect ambiguity in medical device requirements.

entry.title: Supervised Deep Multimodal Matrix Factorization for Interpretable Brain Network Analysis

author.name: Amjad Seyedi, Lifang He, Songlin Zhao, Akwum Onwunta, Nicolas Gillis

entry.summary: SD3MF is an interpretable framework for brain network analysis that generalizes symmetric nonnegative matrix tri-factorization to supervised multimodal settings with deep hierarchical factorizations.

entry.title: Trajectory-Level Data Augmentation for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tobias Schm\"ahling, Matthias Burkhardt, Tobias Windisch

entry.summary: Proposes trajectory-level data augmentation for offline RL that exploits geometric relationships between rewards, value functions, and logging policies, particularly for positioning tasks.

entry.title: Img2CADSeq: Image-to-CAD Generation via Sequence-Based Diffusion

author.name: Shiyu Tan, Zixuan Zhao, Hao Gao, Zhiheng Chen, Xiaolong Yin, Enya Shen

entry.summary: Img2CADSeq reconstructs high-quality CAD BRep models from single-view images using a hierarchical codebook encoding of CAD sequences and VQ-Diffusion conditioned on point cloud intermediates.

entry.title: VoxCor: Training-Free Volumetric Features for Multimodal Voxel Correspondence

author.name: Guney Tombak, Ertunc Erdil, Ender Konukoglu

entry.summary: VoxCor introduces a training-free method for creating reusable volumetric feature representations from frozen 2D ViT models for cross-modal 3D medical image correspondence.

entry.title: FrameSkip: Learning from Fewer but More Informative Frames in VLA Training

author.name: Bin Yu, Shijie Lian, Xiaopeng Lin, Zhaolong Shen, Yuliang Wei, Changti Wu, Hang Yuan, Haishan Liu, Bailing Wang, Cong Huang, Kai Chen

entry.summary: FrameSkip selects informative training frames from dense robot demonstration trajectories based on action variation, visual-action coherence, and task-progress priors, addressing temporal supervision imbalance in VLA training.

entry.title: CHAL: Council of Hierarchical Agentic Language

author.name: Tommaso Giovannelli, Griffin D. Kent

entry.summary: Presents CHAL, a multi-agent dialectic framework that treats argumentation as belief optimization for defeasible domains, arguing that debate's real value lies not in ground-truth tasks but in domains where positions can be defeated by better reasoning.

entry.title: Position: Agentic AI System Is a Foreseeable Pathway to AGI

author.name: Junwei Liao, Shuai Li, Muning Wen, Jun Wang, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that Agentic AI (multi-agent systems with DAG topologies) is a necessary paradigm for achieving AGI, offering exponentially superior generalization and sample efficiency compared to monolithic model scaling.

entry.title: Discrete Diffusion for Complex and Congested Multi-Agent Path Finding with Sparse Social Attention

author.name: Yuanzhe Wang, Tian Zhi, Zihang Wei, Hongguang Wang, Jiaming Guo, Yang Zhao, Zisheng Liu, Shiyu Quan, Xing Hu, Zidong Du, Yunji Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DiffLNS, combining discrete denoising diffusion models with LNS2 for multi-agent path finding, using the diffusion model as an initializer with sparse social attention to produce better initial plans.

entry.title: Cognifold: Always-On Proactive Memory via Cognitive Folding

author.name: Suli Wang, Yiqun Duan, Yu Deng, Rundong Zhao, Dai Shi, Xinliang Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Cognifold, a brain-inspired 'always-on' agent memory extending Complementary Learning Systems theory to three layers (adding a prefrontal intent layer), designed for proactive rather than reactive memory organization.

entry.title: Harnessing Agentic Evolution

author.name: Jiayi Zhang, Yongfeng Gu, Jianhao Ruan, Maojia Song, Yiran Peng, Zhiguang Han, Jinyu Xiang, Zhitao Wang, Caiyin Yang, Yixi Ouyang, Bang Liu, Chenglin Wu, Yuyu Luo

entry.summary: Proposes formulating agentic evolution (iterative program/workflow improvement) as an interactive environment with a stable interface for organizing evidence and revising the evolution mechanism, addressing the gap between rigid fixed procedures and drifting general agents.

entry.title: Uncovering Latent Pathological Signatures in Pulmonary CT via Cross-Window Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Bo Peng, Wujian Xu, Kun Wang, Ximing Liao, Na Wang, Daqian Shi, Tian Li, Jing Gao, Johan Thygesen, Yingqun Ji, Honghan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes cross-window knowledge distillation for pulmonary CT analysis, where student encoders learn clinical priors from teachers trained on the most informative window setting. Achieves significant AUC improvements across COPD, PE, and CTEPD cohorts.

entry.title: Training LLMs with Reinforcement Learning for Intent-Aware Personalized Question Answering

author.name: Maryam Amirizaniani, Benjamin Charles Germain Lee, Jevin West, Nicholas Weber

entry.summary: Proposes IAP, a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to infer implicit user intent directly from minimal single-turn input for personalized question answering, integrating intent into the reasoning process.

entry.title: Visual Aesthetic Benchmark: Can Frontier Models Judge Beauty?

author.name: Yichen Feng, Yuetai Li, Chunjiang Liu, Yuanyuan Chen, Fengqing Jiang, Yue Huang, Hang Hua, Zhengqing Yuan, Kaiyuan Zheng, Luyao Niu, Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, Basel Alomair, Xiangliang Zhang, Misha Sra, Zichen Chen, Radha Poovendran, Zhangchen Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Aesthetic Benchmark (VAB), showing that scalar aesthetic scores poorly capture comparative preferences. Casts aesthetic evaluation as comparative selection across four dimensions with expert annotations.

entry.title: Mechanism Plausibility in Generative Agent-Based Modeling

author.name: Patrick Zhao, David Huu Pham, Nicholas Vincent

entry.summary: Draws from philosophy of science to argue that generative ABMs using LLMs need mechanism plausibility assessment, not just capability demonstration. Distinguishes between prediction and explanation in LLM-based social simulations.

entry.title: RISED: A Pre-Deployment Safety Evaluation Framework for Clinical AI Decision-Support Systems

author.name: Rohith Reddy Bellibatlu

entry.summary: Proposes RISED, a five-dimension pre-deployment safety evaluation framework for clinical AI covering Reliability, Inclusivity, Sensitivity, Equity, and Deployability, with formal sub-criteria and statistical testing.

entry.title: Seg-Agent: Test-Time Multimodal Reasoning for Training-Free Language-Guided Segmentation

author.name: Chao Hao, Jun Xu, Ji Du, Shuo Ye, Ziyue Qiao, Xiaodong Cun, Guangcong Wang, Xubin Zheng, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Seg-Agent, a training-free language-guided segmentation approach using test-time multimodal reasoning with MLLMs and SAM, introducing visual reasoning in observation space rather than textual space to improve spatial grounding.

entry.title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking

author.name: Zeyu Huang, Adhiguna Kuncoro, Qixuan Feng, Jiajun Shen, Lucio Dery, Arthur Szlam, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato

entry.summary: Equips context optimization methods with Wikipedia search and browser tools for active information seeking during LLM adaptation. Shows that naive tool addition degrades performance, but a search-based training procedure helps.

entry.title: When Does Hierarchy Help? Benchmarking Agent Coordination in Event-Driven Industrial Scheduling

author.name: Ziqi Wang, Yuhao Yang, Zhiwei Ling, Wenzhuo Qian, Hailiang Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces DESBench, a benchmark for evaluating agent coordination in hierarchical event-driven industrial scheduling, examining when different coordination paradigms succeed or fail in shared, dynamically evolving systems.

entry.title: Delightful Exploration

author.name: Ian Osband

entry.summary: Introduces Delight-gated exploration (DE), a host-override exploration rule that spends exploratory actions only when prospective delight (expected improvement × surprisal) exceeds a gate price. Recovers Pandora's reservation-value rule.

entry.title: Q-Flow: Stable and Expressive Reinforcement Learning with Flow-Based Policy

author.name: JaeHyeok Doo, Byeongguk Jeon, Seonghyeon Ye, Kimin Lee, Minjoon Seo

entry.summary: Introduces Q-Flow, a framework for using flow-based models as RL policies that propagates terminal trajectory value to intermediate states, resolving the instability of backpropagating through numerical solvers.

entry.title: Decoupled and Divergence-Conditioned Prompt for Multi-domain Dynamic Graph Foundation Models

author.name: Haonan Yuan, Qingyun Sun, Junhua Shi, Xingcheng Fu, Jianxin Li, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DyGFM, the first multi-domain dynamic graph foundation model using decoupled and divergence-conditioned prompting to handle inconsistent semantic and temporal patterns across domains.

entry.title: Humanwashing -- It Should Leave You Feeling Dirty

author.name: Ben Wilson, Matimba Swana, Peter Winter, Matt Roach

entry.summary: Critically examines the 'human in the loop' concept in AI decision systems, arguing that the phrase is often used as 'humanwashing' to imply safety without meaningful oversight. Questions whether the loop metaphor helps or hinders understanding of actual human oversight requirements.

entry.title: Improving Reproducibility in Evaluation through Multi-Level Annotator Modeling

author.name: Deepak Pandita, Flip Korn, Chris Welty, Christopher M. Homan

entry.summary: Studies how to improve reproducibility in AI evaluation through multi-level annotator modeling, addressing the variance introduced by human raters in safety and utility assessments. Examines how experimental repeatability improves with annotator pool size.

entry.title: EVA-Bench: A New End-to-end Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents

author.name: Tara Bogavelli, Gabrielle Gauthier Melan\c{c}on, Katrina Stankiewicz, Oluwanifemi Bamgbose, Fanny Riols, Hoang H. Nguyen, Raghav Mehndiratta, Lindsay Devon Brin, Joseph Marinier, Hari Subramani, Anil Madamala, Sridhar Krishna Nemala, Srinivas Sunkara

entry.summary: Presents EVA-Bench, an end-to-end evaluation framework for voice agents that generates realistic simulated conversations via bot-to-bot audio interactions and measures quality across voice-specific failure modes with composite metrics.

entry.title: WARDEN: Endangered Indigenous Language Transcription and Translation with 6 Hours of Training Data

author.name: Ziheng Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Naijing Liu, Liang Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces WARDEN, a system for transcribing and translating Wardaman, an endangered Australian indigenous language, into English using only 6 hours of annotated audio. Uses separate transcription and translation models to handle extreme low-resource conditions.

entry.title: Population Risk Bounds for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks Trained by DP-SGD with Correlated Noise

author.name: Puyu Wang, Jan Schuchardt, Nikita Kalinin, Junyu Zhou, Sophie Fellenz, Christoph Lampert, Marius Kloft

entry.summary: Establishes the first population risk bounds for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) trained by mini-batch SGD with gradient clipping, covering both non-private and differentially private training with correlated noise. Extends prior KAN theory from full-batch GD to practical training settings.

entry.title: Machine Learning-Driven Multimodal Spectroscopic Liquid Biopsy for Early Multicancer Detection

author.name: Alejandro Leonardo Garc\'ia Navarro, Javier Cach\'on Ortiz, Javier Gonz\'alez Colsa, Samuel Garc\'ia D\'iaz, Carlos Viadero Valderrama

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal spectroscopic liquid biopsy framework combining FTIR, Raman, and fluorescence spectroscopy with ML for multicancer detection from serum samples.

entry.title: PaMM: Periodic Motif Memory for Atomistic Models with an Explicit Local-Structure Interface

author.name: Ryan Dong

entry.summary: PaMM augments equivariant atomistic models with explicit periodic motif memory via pair and triplet lookup tables, fused with baseline edge representations through gating mechanisms for crystal property prediction.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Prediction of Lung Tumor Growth from Sparse Longitudinal CT Data via Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Lingfei Kong, Haoran Ma

entry.summary: Develops a Bayesian PINN combining Gompertz growth dynamics with Bayesian inference for lung tumor growth prediction from sparse CT data, using MAP estimation and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Distinguishing performance gains from learning when using generative AI

author.name: Lixiang Yan, Samuel Greiff, Jason M. Lodge, Dragan Ga\v{s}evi\'c

entry.summary: Discusses the challenge of distinguishing genuine learning from performance gains when using generative AI in education, arguing that AI-boosted performance may not reflect deep cognitive processing.

entry.title: GHGbench: A Unified Multi-Entity, Multi-Task Benchmark for Carbon Emission Prediction

author.name: Yifan Duan, Siyuan Zheng, Lihuan Li, Chao Xue, Flora Salim
