entry.summary: Analyzes the 'extrapolation cliff' in on-policy distillation where pushing past a critical reward-extrapolation threshold causes format collapse in structured outputs. Derives closed-form safety thresholds.

entry.title: Controlling Transient Amplification Improves Long-horizon Rollouts

author.name: Adeel Pervez, Francesco Locatello

entry.summary: Identifies transient amplification from non-normal Jacobians as a structural mechanism driving error accumulation in autoregressive neural simulators. Proposes commutativity regularization to control this.

entry.title: LBI: Parallel Scan Backpropagation via Latent Bounded Interfaces

author.name: Shaun Christopher Lee, Sangeetha Abdu Jyothi

entry.summary: Introduces Latent Bounded Interfaces (LBI) for parallel-scan backpropagation, reducing inter-region communication to low-dimensional latent interfaces. Cuts per-combine cost from O(d³) to O(r³) where r << d, making scan-based parallel training tractable.

entry.title: fmxcoders: Factorized Masked Crosscoders for Cross-Layer Feature Discovery

author.name: Andreas D. Demou, Panagiotis Koromilas, James Oldfield, Yannis Panagakis, Mihalis A. Nicolaou

entry.summary: Shows that standard crosscoders largely fail at discovering true cross-layer features, with most latents being layer-localized. Introduces factorized masked crosscoders (fmxcoders) with a functional coherence metric to better discover cross-layer features in transformers.

entry.title: Tensor Product Representation Probes Reveal Shared Structure Across Linear Directions

author.name: Andrew Lee, Fernanda Vi\'egas, Martin Wattenberg

entry.summary: Discovers tensor product representations (TPRs) in an Othello-playing model that reveal shared structure among linear probes, factorizing into square-embeddings, color-embeddings, and a binding matrix.

entry.title: Rebellious Student: Reversing Teacher Signals for Reasoning Exploration with Self-Distilled RLVR

author.name: Jeonghye Kim, Jiwon Jeon, Dongsheng Li, Yuqing Yang

entry.summary: Proposes RLRT, which reverses the self-distillation signal during post-training: when the student succeeds where the teacher wouldn't have predicted, those tokens are reinforced as self-driven reasoning. Augments GRPO with reversed teacher signals to enhance exploration in RLVR.

entry.title: Beyond Red-Teaming: Formal Guarantees of LLM Guardrail Classifiers

author.name: Nikita Kezins, Urbas Ekka, Pascal Berrang, Luca Arnaboldi

entry.summary: Proposes formal verification of LLM guardrail classifiers by shifting verification from discrete input space to the pre-activation space, defining harmful regions as convex shapes enclosing known harmful prompt representations. Uses monotonicity of sigmoid to certify entire regions.

entry.title: Not All Thoughts Need HBM: Semantics-Aware Memory Hierarchy for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Aojie Yuan, Tianqi Shen, Dajun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a semantics-aware memory hierarchy for LLM reasoning that moves low-importance KV cache tokens to CPU memory rather than evicting them, achieving zero-loss accuracy while reducing HBM usage.

entry.title: A Single-Layer Model Can Do Language Modeling

author.name: Zanmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Grounded Prediction Networks (GPN), a single-layer recurrent model that revisits one state vector through a single recurrent block. At 130M parameters, achieves perplexity within 13% of a 12-layer Transformer++.

entry.title: Reformulating KV Cache Eviction Problem for Long-Context LLM Inference

author.name: Tho Mai, Joo-Young Kim

entry.summary: Reformulates KV cache eviction as an output-aware, layer-wise matrix multiplication approximation problem rather than head-wise weight averaging. Introduces LaProx, which models multiplicative interaction between attention maps and projected value states to better quantify token contributions.

entry.title: MedAction: Towards Active Multi-turn Clinical Diagnostic LLMs

author.name: Hsin-Ling Hsu, Zizheng Wang, Donghua Zhang, Nai-Chia Chen, Jerry Wang, Jun-En Ding, Chia-Hsuan Hsu, Guoan Wang, Feng Liu, Fang-Ming Hung, Chenwei Wu, Liyue Shen

entry.summary: Addresses active diagnosis in clinical settings where LLMs must iteratively gather information rather than reason from complete data. Identifies three failure modes (ungrounded test ordering, unreliable diagnostic update, degraded multi-turn coherence) and proposes a framework to address them.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer: Decoupling Compute from Memory in Looped Language Models

author.name: Victor Conchello Vendrell, Arnau Padres Masdemont, Niccol\`o Grillo, Jordi Ros-Giralt, Arash Behboodi, Fabio Valerio Massoli

entry.summary: Proposes MELT (Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer) that decouples reasoning depth from memory consumption in recurrent LLM architectures by replacing standard KV cache with a compressed memory mechanism.

entry.title: GLiGuard: Schema-Conditioned Classification for LLM Safeguard

author.name: Urchade Zaratiana, Mary Newhauser, George Hurn-Maloney, Ash Lewis

entry.summary: Introduces GLiGuard, a 0.3B-parameter schema-conditioned bidirectional encoder for LLM content moderation that achieves competitive performance to 7-27B autoregressive guardrail models at much lower latency by treating moderation as classification rather than generation.

entry.title: More Thinking, More Bias: Length-Driven Position Bias in Reasoning Models

author.name: Xiao Wang

entry.summary: Finds that within reasoning models, position bias in multiple-choice QA scales with CoT trajectory length - longer reasoning leads to more position bias. Observed across 13 reasoning configurations on MMLU, ARC-Challenge, and GPQA.

entry.title: LKV: End-to-End Learning of Head-wise Budgets and Token Selection for LLM KV Cache Eviction

author.name: Enshuai Zhou, Yifan Hao, Chao Wang, Rui Zhang, Di Huang, Jiaming Guo, Xing Hu, Zidong Du, Qi Guo, Yunji Chen

entry.summary: Introduces LKV (Learned KV Eviction) which formulates KV cache compression as end-to-end differentiable optimization, learning both global budgets per head and intrinsic KV importance without materializing attention matrices.

entry.title: Topic Is Not Agenda: A Citation-Community Audit of Text Embeddings

author.name: Junseon Yoo

entry.summary: Audits text embeddings using a citation-community approach, finding that while embeddings work at sub-field level (45-52% top-10 same-rate), they fail at research-agenda level (15-21%). Shows 8 of 10 retrieved papers are off-agenda across all tested models.

entry.title: Is Your Driving World Model an All-Around Player?

author.name: Lingdong Kong, Ao Liang, Tianyi Yan, Hongsi Liu, Wesley Yang, Ziqi Huang, Xian Sun, Wei Yin, Jialong Zuo, Yixuan Hu, Dekai Zhu, Dongyue Lu, Youquan Liu, Guangfeng Jiang, Linfeng Li, Xiangtai Li, Long Zhuo, Lai Xing Ng, Benoit R. Cottereau, Changxin Gao, Liang Pan, Wei Tsang Ooi, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: WorldLens is a unified benchmark measuring driving world model fidelity across pixel quality, 4D geometry, closed-loop driving, and human alignment through 24 standardized dimensions, revealing no model excels universally.

entry.title: DocScope: Benchmarking Verifiable Reasoning for Trustworthy Long-Document Understanding

author.name: Xiang Feng, Jiawei Zhou, Zhangfeng Huang, Kewei Wang, Shanshan Ye, Jinxin Hu, Zulong Chen, Yong Luo, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: DocScope benchmarks verifiable reasoning for long-document understanding by formulating QA as structured reasoning trajectory prediction with four evaluation stages: page localization, region grounding, fact extraction, and answer verification. Enables auditing each reasoning level independently.

entry.title: Re$^2$Math: Benchmarking Theorem Retrieval in Research-Level Mathematics

author.name: Zicheng Lyu, Wenjie Yang, Shengzhong Zhang, Zengfeng Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Re²Math, a benchmark for theorem retrieval from partial mathematical proofs, requiring models to identify whether a needed lemma exists in the literature and verify assumption alignment with the current proof context.

entry.title: CoCoDA: Co-evolving Compositional DAG for Tool-Augmented Agents

author.name: Ziyang Yu, Qiyue Li, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes CoCoDA, a framework that co-evolves an LLM planner and tool library through a compositional code DAG, where nodes are tools and edges encode invocation dependencies. Keeps retrieval costs constant as the library grows.

entry.title: Human-Inspired Memory Architecture for LLM Agents

author.name: Doga Kerestecioglu, Alexei Robsky, Clemens Vasters, Anshul Sharma, Yitzhak Kesselman

entry.summary: Presents a biologically-grounded memory architecture for LLM agents with six cognitive mechanisms including sleep-phase consolidation, interference-based forgetting, and engram maturation. Includes synthetic calibration methodology.

entry.title: Mirror, Mirror on the Wall: Can VLM Agents Tell Who They Are at All?

author.name: Filippo Ziliotto, Ciro Beneduce, Bruno Lepri, Luciano Serafini, Massimiliano Luca, Tommaso Campari

entry.summary: Introduces a 3D benchmark testing whether embodied VLM agents can recognize themselves in mirrors, probing functional self-recognition through controlled experiments with mirror removal, misleading cues, and occluded reflections.

entry.title: Mental Health AI Safety Claims Must Preserve Temporal Evidence

author.name: Srimonti Dutta, Ratna Kandala

entry.summary: Argues that mental health AI safety claims are invalid when they discard temporal evidence, introducing 'Temporal Safety Non-Identifiability' showing that sequence-dependent safety properties cannot be certified by protocols ignoring ordering.

entry.title: OPT-BENCH: Evaluating the Iterative Self-Optimization of LLM Agents in Large-Scale Search Spaces

author.name: Xiaozhe Li, Jixuan Chen, Xinyu Fang, Shengyuan Ding, Haodong Duan, Qingwen Liu, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Introduces OPT-BENCH for evaluating LLM self-improvement capabilities in large-scale search spaces, combining 20 ML tasks with 10 optimization profiles to test continuous solution refinement from environmental feedback.

entry.title: Constant-Target Energy Matching: A Unified Framework for Continuous and Discrete Density Estimation

author.name: Zhijun Zeng, Yixuan Jiang, Pipi Hu, Zuoqiang Shi

entry.summary: Introduces Constant-Target Energy Matching (CTEM), a unified energy-based framework for density estimation across continuous, discrete, and mixed-variable domains with a bounded energy-difference transform and constant target of 1.

entry.title: When (and How) to Trust the Expert: Diagnosing Query-Time Expert-Guided Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yann Berthelot, Philippe Preux, Riad Akrour

entry.summary: Provides a rigorous comparison of methods that use suboptimal expert controllers during RL training, identifying three failure modes missed by single-paper evaluations. Uses 100/50 seeds per configuration on a shared SAC backbone with degradation sweeps.

entry.title: Do Linear Probes Generalize Better in Persona Coordinates?

author.name: Prasad Mahadik, Adrians Skapars

entry.summary: Studies whether linear probes generalize better in persona coordinate spaces for detecting harmful behaviors in LLMs. Motivated by strategic deception and sandbagging where text monitoring fails.

entry.title: SimWorld Studio: Automatic Environment Generation with Evolving Coding Agent for Embodied Agent Learning

author.name: Haoqiang Kang, Xiaokang Ye, Yuhan Liu, Siddhant Hitesh Mantri, Lingjun Mao, James Fleming, Drishti Regmi, Lianhui Qin

entry.summary: Introduces SimWorld Studio, an open-source platform built on Unreal Engine 5 for generating diverse 3D embodied learning environments. Features SimCoder, a tool-augmented coding agent for automatic environment creation.

entry.title: Medical Model Synthesis Architectures: A Case Study

author.name: Katherine M. Collins, Marlene Berke, Ilia Sucholutsky, Ayman Ali, Adrian Weller, Timothy J. O'Donnell, Tyler Brooke-Wilson, Lionel Wong, Joshua B. Tenenbaum

entry.summary: Proposes MedMSA framework for medical AI that combines LLM knowledge retrieval with formally transparent probabilistic model synthesis for clinical predictions under uncertainty. Emphasizes interpretable reasoning.

entry.title: The Gordian Knot for VLMs: Diagrammatic Knot Reasoning as a Hard Benchmark

author.name: Hao Liu, Jicheng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces KnotBench with 858K images from 1,951 prime knot prototypes to evaluate VLM spatial reasoning. Tests Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5 on 14 tasks; most models perform at or near random baseline.

entry.title: Active Testing of Large Language Models via Approximate Neyman Allocation

author.name: Zeli Liu, Jiancheng Zhang, Cong Liu, Yinglun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes an active testing algorithm for evaluating generative LLMs efficiently by using semantic entropy from surrogate models to stratify evaluation pools, then applying approximate Neyman allocation to select informative subsets.

entry.title: Agent-ValueBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Agent Values

author.name: Haonan Dong, Qiguan Feng, Kehan Jiang, Haoran Ye, Xin Zhang, Guojie Song

entry.summary: Introduces Agent-ValueBench, the first benchmark for evaluating agent values (distinct from underlying LLM values). Shows that agents' values diverge from their LLM backbone values and introduces 394 executable environments across 16 domains.

entry.title: The First Drop of Ink: Nonlinear Impact of Misleading Information in Long-Context Reasoning

author.name: Muhan Gao, Zih-Ching Chen, Kuan-Hao Huang

entry.summary: Reveals a nonlinear relationship between hard-distractor proportion and LLM performance in long contexts: performance drops sharply with the first small fraction of distractors, then declines marginally with additional ones.

entry.title: Delulu: A Verified Multi-Lingual Benchmark for Code Hallucination Detection in Fill-in-the-Middle Tasks

author.name: Mahdi Erfanian, Nelson Daniel Troncoso, Aashna Garg, Amabel Gale, Xiaoyu Liu, Pareesa Ameneh Golnari, Shengyu Fu

entry.summary: Introduces Delulu, a benchmark of 1,951 Fill-in-the-Middle code samples across 7 languages and 4 hallucination types for detecting code generation hallucinations. Uses adversarial pipeline with Docker verification to ensure correctness.

entry.title: Rethinking Entropy Minimization in Test-Time Adaptation for Autoregressive Models

author.name: Wei-Ping Huang, Chee-En Yu, Guan-Ting Lin, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Derives a rigorous entropy minimization formulation for test-time adaptation of autoregressive models, showing it decomposes into token-level policy gradient and entropy losses. Unifies prior heuristic approaches under one framework.

entry.title: ReplaySCM: A Benchmark for Executable Causal Mechanism Induction from Interventions

author.name: Serafim Batzoglou

entry.summary: Introduces ReplaySCM, a 1,300-item benchmark for executable causal mechanism induction from interventional evidence. Systems must output Boolean mechanisms that are evaluated by replay behavior rather than string matching.

entry.title: Can LLMs Predict Polymer Physics Just by Reading Synthesis and Processing Prose?

author.name: Yuchu Liu, Rui Zhu, Jingwei Xiong, Haixu Tang

entry.summary: Introduces PolyLM, a natural-language-only framework that predicts polymer properties from full-text literature including synthesis routes and processing conditions, bypassing structure-only representations like SMILES.

entry.title: Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts with Two-Stage Optimization

author.name: Gleb Molodtsov, Alexander Miasnikov, Aleksandr Beznosikov

entry.summary: Proposes Hi-MoE, a grouped Mixture-of-Experts framework that decomposes routing into inter-group balancing and intra-group specialization, addressing the fundamental trade-off between load balancing and expert specialization.

entry.title: Seed Hijacking of LLM Sampling and Quantum Random Number Defense

author.name: Ziyang You, Xiaoke Yang, Zhanling Fan, Feng Guo, Xiaogen Zhou, Xuxing Lu

entry.summary: Presents SeedHijack, a backdoor attack that manipulates PRNG seeds to force specific token selection in LLM sampling without altering logits, achieving 99.6%+ success. Proposes quantum RNG as defense.

entry.title: DUET: Optimize Token-Budget Allocation for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Haoyu Hu, Xuandong Zhao, Xuhai "Orson'' Xu, Nori Jacoby

entry.summary: Proposes DUET, which jointly optimizes prompt allocation and rollout length under a shared compute budget for RLVR training, improving reasoning quality and wall-clock time compared to controlling only one dimension.

entry.title: Continuity Laws for Sequential Models

author.name: Annan Yu, Dongwei Lyu, N. Benjamin Erichson

entry.summary: Studies continuity in time as an inductive bias for sequential models, formalizing it as convergence under temporal refinement. Shows S4 is stable under refinement while Mamba (S6) can be sensitive, with implications for tasks with continuous temporal structure.

entry.title: VeriContest: A Competitive-Programming Benchmark for Verifiable Code Generation

author.name: Zichen Xie, Mrigank Pawagi, Yuxin Liu, Aaditi Rai, Lize Shao, John Berberian Jr., Sicong Che, Wenxi Wang

entry.summary: Presents VeriContest, a 946-problem benchmark for verifiable code generation in Rust with Verus, requiring models to produce executable code, formal specifications, and machine-checkable proofs.

entry.title: Sketch-and-Verify: Structured Inference-Time Scaling via Program Sketching

author.name: Shan Jiang, Zijian Yi, Chenguang Zhu

entry.summary: SKETCHVERIFY is a test-time compute strategy for small code models that factorizes search: the LLM enumerates K algorithmic strategies as program sketches with holes, fills each M times, and verifies by execution and fingerprint clustering. Designed as a cost-performance policy for budget-constrained deployment.

entry.title: Structure-Centric Graph Foundation Model via Geometric Bases

author.name: Xiaodong He, Haolan He, Ruiyi Fang, Ming Sun, Zhao Kang

entry.summary: SCGFM proposes a structure-centric graph foundation model that treats graph topology as the primary transferable knowledge source. Uses learnable geometric bases with Gromov-Wasserstein alignment to create a shared structural coordinate system across heterogeneous graphs.

entry.title: Generating Leakage-Free Benchmarks for Robust RAG Evaluation

author.name: Jiayi Liu, Jiaxing Zhang, Bowen Jin, Jennifer Neville

entry.summary: SeedRG is a semi-synthetic benchmark generation pipeline for RAG evaluation that mitigates knowledge leakage—where questions can be answered from parametric memory without retrieval. Addresses benchmark aging as training data absorbs benchmark content.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Sequential Decision-Making: Improving In-Context Learning via Supervised Fine-Tuning

author.name: Minmin Zhang, Sina Aghaei, Soroush Saghafian

entry.summary: Studies in-context learning capabilities of LLMs for sequential decision-making (MDPs, POMDPs, APOMDPs) through supervised fine-tuning on oracle trajectories. Provides theoretical interpretation of fine-tuned attention as implicit Q-function estimation.

entry.title: A Communication-Theoretic Framework for LLM Agents: Cost-Aware Adaptive Reliability

author.name: Hamed Omidvar, Vahideh Akhlaghi

entry.summary: Maps LLM reliability techniques (retry, voting, self-consistency) to classical communication theory operators, providing a unified framework via Shannon's coding theory where an LLM is treated as a discrete stochastic channel.

entry.title: Internal vs. External: Comparing Deliberation and Evolution for Multi-Agent Constitutional Design

author.name: Hershraj Niranjani, Ujwal Kumar, Phan Xuan Tan

entry.summary: First controlled comparison of internal deliberation vs. external evolution for multi-agent constitutional design across three social environments. Finds evolution outperforms deliberation in collective-action settings but neither helps in bilateral trading.

entry.title: Prediction Bottlenecks Don't Discover Causal Structure (But Here's What They Actually Do)

author.name: Ankit Hemant Lade, Sai Krishna Jasti, Indar Kumar, Aman Chadha

entry.summary: Systematically falsifies the claim that Mamba state-space models discover Granger-causal structure through next-step prediction. Shows a plain linear bottleneck does as well, and the original claim doesn't survive controlled benchmarking.

entry.title: The Pok\'emon Theorem and other Fairness Impossibility Results

author.name: Daniel Matsui Smola, Alex Smola

entry.summary: Unifies several fairness impossibility results under RKHS geometry, showing that fairness criteria are linear constraints on conditional mean embeddings. Introduces the 'Pokémon theorem' showing residual violations between group pairs satisfying linear fairness criteria.

entry.title: Intrinsic Muon: Spectral Optimization on Riemannian Matrix Manifolds

author.name: Yibang Li, Bihari Lal Pandey, Ravi Sah, Andi Han, Cyrus Mostajeran, Pratik Jawanpuria, Bamdev Mishra

entry.summary: Proposes Intrinsic Muon, extending the Muon optimizer to Riemannian matrix manifolds. Resolves issues with naively restricting the LMO to tangent spaces by using spectral structure of Riemannian metrics, enabling closed-form solutions for various manifold constraints.

entry.title: MC$^2$: Monte Carlo Correction for Fast Elliptic PDE Solving

author.name: Ethan Hsu, Hong Meng Yam, Ivan Ge

entry.summary: MC² combines low-budget Walk-on-Spheres Monte Carlo solutions with a learned neural correction to achieve high-fidelity PDE solutions. Matches accuracy of 1000x more Monte Carlo compute while outperforming classical, denoising, and neural-operator baselines.

entry.title: LEAD: Length-Efficient Adaptive and Dynamic Reasoning for Large Language Models

author.name: Songtao Wei, Yi Li, Zhikai Li, Xu Hu, Yuede Ji, Guanpeng Li, Feng Chen, Carl Yang, Zhichun Guo, Bingzhe Li

entry.summary: Proposes LEAD, addressing verbose Chain-of-Thought in reasoning models by dynamically adjusting the balance between correctness and efficiency rewards during RL training, with problem-specific length constraints.

entry.title: Flag Varieties: A Geometric Framework for Deep Network Alignment

author.name: Jingchuan Xiao, Xinyi Sui, Cihan Ruan

entry.summary: Develops a geometric framework using flag varieties to provide unified theoretical treatment of alignment phenomena in deep networks (gradient flow, Neural Collapse, representation similarity). Uses geometric invariant theory to prove canonical structure.

entry.title: Attention Drift: What Autoregressive Speculative Decoding Models Learn

author.name: Do\u{g}a\c{c} Eldenk, Payal Mohapatra, Yigitcan Comlek, Kaan Oktay, Hongyang Zhang, Stephen Xia

entry.summary: Identifies 'attention drift' in speculative decoding drafters (EAGLE3, MTP heads) where attention progressively shifts from prompt to self-generated tokens, caused by growing hidden state magnitudes in un-normalized residual paths.

entry.title: Scaling Vision Models Does Not Consistently Improve Localisation-Based Explanation Quality

author.name: Mateusz Cedro, Marcin Chlebus

entry.summary: Evaluates whether scaling vision models improves post-hoc explanation quality, finding that larger models don't consistently produce better localization-based explanations. Proposes Dual-Polarity Precision metric.

entry.title: ProteinOPD: Towards Effective and Efficient Preference Alignment for Protein Design

author.name: Yulin Zhang, He Cao, Zihao Jiang, Chenyi Zi, Zhipeng Zhou, Zijing Liu, Yu Li, Jia Li, Ziqi Gao

entry.summary: Proposes ProteinOPD, applying on-policy distillation for preference alignment of protein language models to design proteins with desired properties while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on Medical Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Peiru Yang, Haoran Zheng, Tong Ju, Shiting Wang, Wanchun Ni, Jiajun Liu, Shangguang Wang, Yongfeng Huang, Tao Qi

entry.summary: Proposes M³Att, a knowledge poisoning attack on medical multimodal RAG systems that doesn't require prior knowledge of user queries, demonstrating realistic adversarial threats to medical AI.

entry.title: StereoTales: A Multilingual Framework for Open-Ended Stereotype Discovery in LLMs

author.name: Pierre Le Jeune, \'Etienne Duchesne, Weixuan Xiao, Stefano Palminteri, Bazire Houssin, Beno\^it Mal\'ezieux, Matteo Dora

entry.summary: Introduces StereoTales, a multilingual dataset of 650K+ LLM-generated stories across 10 languages for studying social bias, discovering 1,500+ over-represented associations rated for harmfulness by humans and LLMs.

entry.title: Towards Understanding Continual Factual Knowledge Acquisition of Language Models: From Theory to Algorithm

author.name: Haoyu Wang, Yifan Shang, Zhongxiang Sun, Weijie Yu, Xiao Zhang, Jun Xu

entry.summary: Provides theoretical framework characterizing training dynamics of continual factual knowledge acquisition in language models, explaining why replay works and regularization doesn't fundamentally prevent forgetting.

entry.title: PhyGround: Benchmarking Physical Reasoning in Generative World Models

author.name: Juyi Lin, Arash Akbari, Yumei He, Lin Zhao, Haichao Zhang, Arman Akbari, Xingchen Xu, Zoe Y. Lu, Enfu Nan, Hokin Deng, Edmund Yeh, Sarah Ostadabbas, Yun Fu, Jennifer Dy, Pu Zhao, Yanzhi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PhyGround, a benchmark for evaluating physical reasoning in video generation models with criteria-grounded evaluation addressing coarse frameworks, annotation biases, and physics-awareness gaps in existing benchmarks.

entry.title: Policy Gradient Methods for Non-Markovian Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Avik Kar, Siddharth Chandak, Rahul Singh, Soumitra Sinhahajari, Eric Moulines, Shalabh Bhatnagar, Nicholas Bambos

entry.summary: Studies policy gradient methods for non-Markovian decision processes with internal agent states, proposing a reward-centric formulation that jointly optimizes agent state dynamics and control policy with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: LoKA: Low-precision Kernel Applications for Recommendation Models At Scale

author.name: Liang Luo, Yinbin Ma, Quanyu Zhu, Vasiliy Kuznetsov, Yuxin Chen, Jian Jiao, Jiecao Yu, Buyun Zhang, Tongyi Tang, Xiaohan Wei, Yanli Zhao, Zeliang Chen, Yuchen Hao, Venkatesh Ranganathan, Sandeep Parab, Yantao Yao, Maxim Naumov, Chunzhi Yang, Shen Li, Ellie Wen, Wenlin Chen, Santanu Kolay, Chunqiang Tang

entry.summary: Presents LoKA, a system-model co-design approach for applying FP8 low-precision arithmetic to large recommendation models, addressing numerical sensitivity and small GEMM challenges specific to LRM workloads.

entry.title: Retrieval Mechanisms Surpass Long-Context Scaling in Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Rishi Ahuja, Kumar Prateek, Simranjit Singh, Vijay Kumar

entry.summary: Shows an inverse scaling law in time series forecasting where longer context windows degrade performance, and proposes retrieval-augmented approaches as an alternative to context scaling.

entry.title: Convergence Analysis of Newton's Method for Neural Networks in the Overparameterized Limit

author.name: Konstantin Riedl, Konstantinos Spiliopoulos, Justin Sirignano

entry.summary: Develops convergence analysis for regularized Newton's method in overparameterized neural networks, proving exponential convergence in the infinite-width limit. Introduces a 'Newton NTK' that avoids the spectral bias of gradient descent by maintaining uniform convergence across frequencies.

entry.title: Queryable LoRA: Instruction-Regularized Routing Over Shared Low-Rank Update Atoms

author.name: Omatharv Bharat Vaidya, Connor T. Jerzak, Nhat Ho, Chandrajit Bajaj

entry.summary: Presents Queryable LoRA, replacing static low-rank adapters with a shared memory of low-rank update atoms that are dynamically retrieved via attention based on input content and layer context.

entry.title: A Call to Lagrangian Action: Learning Population Mechanics from Temporal Snapshots

author.name: Vincent Guan, Lazar Atanackovic, Kirill Neklyudov

entry.summary: Proposes Wasserstein Lagrangian Mechanics for modeling population dynamics from temporal snapshots, going beyond gradient flows to capture periodicity and second-order dynamics. First algorithm to learn these dynamics from unpaired snapshots.

entry.title: PAAC: Privacy-Aware Agentic Device-Cloud Collaboration

author.name: Liangqi Yuan, Wenzhi Fang, Shiqiang Wang, Christopher G. Brinton

entry.summary: Proposes PAAC, a privacy-aware agentic framework that aligns planner-executor decomposition with the device-cloud boundary, using typed placeholder tokens to preserve reasoning role while hiding sensitive data.

entry.title: AgentSlimming: Towards Efficient and Cost-Aware Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yulang Chen, Haoxuan Peng, Jinyan Liu, Zichen Wen, Dongrui Liu, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces AgentSlimming, a compression framework for multi-agent systems that prunes redundant agents or replaces them with lower-cost ones, inspired by neural network pruning and quantization.

entry.title: When and Why Grouping Attention Heads Accelerates Muon Optimization

author.name: Hongtao Zhang, Wenjie Zhou, Wei Chen, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Analyzes the granularity mismatch between Muon optimizer and multi-head attention, proposing Group Muon that treats head group size as an optimizer hyperparameter based on a whitening-gain vs norm-cost tradeoff.

entry.title: PMCTS: Particle Monte Carlo Tree Search for Principled Parallelized Inference Time Scaling

author.name: Yaniv Oren, Viliam Vadocz, Joery A. de Vries, Wendelin B\"ohmer, Matthijs T. J. Spaan, Hendrik Baier

entry.summary: Introduces Particle MCTS (PMCTS), a principled parallel MCTS algorithm that preserves formal policy improvement guarantees while scaling well with parallel compute. Addresses a major practical limitation of sequential MCTS for neural network evaluation.

entry.title: Spherical Boltzmann machines: a solvable theory of learning and generation in energy-based models

author.name: Thomas Tulinski, Simona Cocco, R\'emi Monasson, Jorge Fernandez-De-Cossio-Diaz

entry.summary: Analyzes the spherical Boltzmann machine in the high-dimensional limit using random matrix theory and dynamical mean-field theory, uncovering cascades of phase transitions during training related to successive alignment of coupling matrix modes.

entry.title: SMIXAE: Towards Unsupervised Manifold Discovery in Language Models

author.name: Collin Francel

entry.summary: Introduces SMIXAE, a Sparse Mixture of Autoencoders architecture for discovering multidimensional manifold features in transformer language model activations, addressing SAEs' limitation of only finding one-dimensional features.

entry.title: Modeling Atomic Conformational Ensembles of Proteins via Test-Time Supervision of Boltz-2 on Cryo-EM Density Maps

author.name: Jay Shenoy, Miro Astore, Axel Levy, Fr\'ed\'eric Poitevin, Sonya M. Hanson, Gordon Wetzstein

entry.summary: Uses test-time supervision of Boltz-2 on cryo-EM density maps to model atomic conformational ensembles of proteins, bypassing the traditional two-stage pipeline of map-to-structure then structure-to-model training.

entry.title: Task-Aware Calibration: Provably Optimal Decoding in LLMs

author.name: Tim Tomov, Dominik Fuchsgruber, Rajeev Verma, Stephan G\"unnemann

entry.summary: Introduces task calibration for LLMs that calibrates predictive distributions in task-induced latent spaces (class labels, integers, sets) rather than the intractable full token space, with decision-theoretic optimality guarantees.

entry.title: The Benefits of Temporal Correlations: SGD Learns k-Juntas from Random Walks Efficiently

author.name: Elisabetta Cornacchia, Dan Mikulincer, Elchanan Mossel

entry.summary: Proves that SGD can learn k-juntas efficiently from random walk (temporally correlated) data on the hypercube, while independent samples require much more data. Shows temporal correlations can fundamentally help gradient-based learning.

entry.title: DANCE: Detect and Classify Events in EEG

author.name: Jarod L\'evy, Hubert Banville, J\'er\'emy Rapin, Jean-Remi King, Thomas Moreau, St\'ephane d'Ascoli

entry.summary: Introduces DANCE, a deep learning pipeline that jointly detects and classifies events in continuous EEG recordings without requiring known event onsets, framing neural decoding as a set-prediction problem. Outperforms existing methods across ten datasets spanning cognitive, clinical, and BCI tasks.

entry.title: Mistake-Bounded Language Generation

author.name: Jon Kleinberg, Charlotte Peale, Omer Reingold

entry.summary: Introduces 'mistake-bounded generation' for language generation in the limit, shifting focus from eventual consistency to minimizing total invalid outputs. Establishes formal reductions and algorithms with mistake bounds for finite and countably infinite classes.

entry.title: Compute Where it Counts: Self Optimizing Language Models

author.name: Yash Akhauri, Mohamed S. Abdelfattah

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Optimizing Language Models (SOL) that use a lightweight policy network to dynamically allocate computation per token during autoregressive decoding, jointly controlling attention sparsity and other efficiency actions based on token difficulty.

entry.title: Learning Theory of Transformers: Local-to-Global Approximation via Softmax Partition of Unity

author.name: Zhongjie Shi, Wenjing Liao

entry.summary: Develops learning theory for Transformers showing that a two-block encoder can approximate smooth functions on compact domains via a softmax partition of unity construction, achieving near-optimal minimax rates.

entry.title: Test-Time Speculation

author.name: Avinash Kumar, Sujay Sanghavi, Poulami Das

entry.summary: Introduces Test-Time Speculation, addressing the degradation of speculative decoding acceptance rates over long generations by adapting the draft model at inference time to maintain speedups beyond short sequences.

entry.title: Factual recall in linear associative memories: sharp asymptotics and mechanistic insights

author.name: Alessio Giorlandino, Sebastian Goldt, Antoine Maillard

entry.summary: Provides precise characterization of storage capacity in linear associative memories for factual recall, deriving sharp asymptotics and phase transitions. Connects to how transformers store and retrieve factual associations.

entry.title: Hallucination Detection via Activations of Open-Weight Proxy Analyzers

author.name: Akshita Singh, Prabesh Paudel, Siddhartha Roy

entry.summary: Introduces a proxy-analyzer framework for hallucination detection that uses a small open-weight model to read generated text and detect hallucinations via internal activations, making it applicable to closed-API models like GPT-4. Uses 18 features from transformer internals and a stacking ensemble trained on 72K+ samples.

entry.title: SpecBlock: Block-Iterative Speculative Decoding with Dynamic Tree Drafting

author.name: Weijie Shi, Qiang Xu, Fan Deng, Yaguang Wu, Jiarun Liu, Yehong Xu, Hao Chen, Jia Zhu, Jiajie Xu, Xiangjun Huang, Jian Yang, Xiaofang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes SpecBlock, a block-iterative speculative decoding approach that combines the path dependence of autoregressive drafters with the efficiency of parallel drafters. Each drafter forward produces K dependent positions, reducing latency while maintaining quality.

entry.title: Understanding Performance Collapse in Layer-Pruned Large Language Models via Decision Representation Transitions

author.name: Boyu Shi, Chang Liu, ChuanBao Gao, Xu Yang, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Studies performance collapse in layer-pruned LLMs through 'decision representation', introducing Decision Margin and Option Frequency metrics. Reveals a sharp transition partitioning networks into Silent Phase (critical) and Decisive Phase (pruning-resilient).

entry.title: The Moltbook Files: A Harmless Slopocalypse or Humanity's Last Experiment

author.name: William Brach, Federico Torrielli, Stine Lyngs{\o} Beltoft, Annemette Brok Pirchert, Peter Schneider-Kamp, Lukas Galke Poech

entry.summary: Analyzes Moltbook, a Reddit-like platform populated entirely by AI agents (OpenClaw), releasing a dataset of 232K posts and 2.2M comments. Studies emergent behavior, community structure, and safety implications of AI-generated social media content.

entry.title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation

author.name: Jie Sun, Mao Zheng, Mingyang Song, Qiyong Zhong, Yilin Cheng, Bichuan Feng, Pengfei Liu, Junfeng Fang, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: Addresses cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation where teacher-student vocabulary mismatch causes loss of supervision signal. Proposes SimCT which recovers lost signal by comparing over short multi-token continuations both tokenizers can realize.

entry.title: How Value Induction Reshapes LLM Behaviour

author.name: Arnav Arora, Natalie Schluter, Katherine Metcalf, Maartje ter Hoeve

entry.summary: Studies unintended effects of value induction in LLMs, finding that inducing certain values can modify behavior on other values and potentially make models more addictive or sycophantic. Reveals complex inter-relationships between different induced values.

entry.title: How to Train Your Latent Diffusion Language Model Jointly With the Latent Space

author.name: Viacheslav Meshchaninov, Alexander Shabalin, Egor Chimbulatov, Nikita Gushchin, Ilya Koziev, Alexander Korotin, Dmitry Vetrov

entry.summary: Proposes jointly training the latent encoder, diffusion model, and decoder for latent diffusion language models (LDLM). Shows naive joint training fails and proposes a training recipe combining representation alignment with a frozen LM.

entry.title: CASCADE: Case-Based Continual Adaptation for Large Language Models During Deployment

author.name: Siyuan Guo, Yali Du, Hechang Chen, Yi Chang, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Formalizes deployment-time learning (DTL) as a third stage in the LLM lifecycle and presents CASCADE, a case-based continual adaptation framework that equips agents with evolving episodic memory without modifying model parameters.

entry.title: Benchmarked Yet Not Measured -- Generative AI Should be Evaluated Against Real-World Utility

author.name: Ishani Mondal, Shweta Bhardwaj

entry.summary: Identifies a 'benchmark-utility gap' across 28 deployment cases where GenAI systems perform well on benchmarks but fail to deliver real-world utility. Proposes a paradigm shift from static benchmarks toward stakeholder-conditioned utility transparency grounded in human outcome trajectories.

entry.title: KL for a KL: On-Policy Distillation with Control Variate Baseline

author.name: Minjae Oh, Sangjun Song, Gyubin Choi, Yunho Choi, Yohan Jo

entry.summary: Proposes vOPD for stabilizing on-policy distillation by deriving a closed-form control variate baseline as per-token negative reverse KL divergence, available directly from the forward pass with no additional cost.

entry.title: The Alpha Blending Hypothesis: Compositing Shortcut in Deepfake Detection

author.name: Andrii Yermakov, Jan Cech, Mario Fritz, Jiri Matas

entry.summary: This paper introduces the Alpha Blending Hypothesis: that deepfake detectors primarily function as alpha blending searchers detecting compositing artifacts rather than learning semantic anomalies or neural fingerprints.

entry.title: WorldReasonBench: Human-Aligned Stress Testing of Video Generators as Future World-State Predictors

author.name: Keming Wu, Yijing Cui, Wenhan Xue, Qijie Wang, Xuan Luo, Zhiyuan Feng, Zuhao Yang, Sudong Wang, Sicong Jiang, Haowei Zhu, Zihan Wang, Ping Nie, Wenhu Chen, Bin Wang

entry.summary: WorldReasonBench evaluates video generators as world-state predictors by testing physical, social, logical, and informational consistency of generated futures, with 436 curated test cases across 22 subcategories.

entry.title: Counterfactual Stress Testing for Image Classification Models

author.name: Moritz Stammel, Fabio De Sousa Ribeiro, Raghav Mehta, M\'elanie Roschewitz, Ben Glocker

entry.summary: Proposes counterfactual stress testing for medical imaging classifiers using causal generative models to create realistic 'what if' images by intervening on attributes like demographics and scanner hardware. Addresses the underspecification problem where models with similar validation performance fail differently in deployment.

entry.title: Transforming the Use of Earth Observation Data: Exascale Training of a Generative Compression Model with Historical Priors for up to 10,000x Data Reduction

author.name: Jinxiao Zhang, Runmin Dong, Xiyong Wu, Xihan Huang, Shenggan Cheng, Yunkai Yang, Zheng Zhou, Yunpu Xu, Zhaoyang Luo, Miao Yang, Fan Wei, Mengxuan Chen, Yang You, Juepeng Zheng, Weijia Li, Yutong Lu, Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: Presents a generative compression framework for Earth observation data that learns from historical archives to enable 100x-10,000x data reduction. Trained at exascale on the LineShine Armv9 CPU supercomputer with co-optimization across model design, kernels, and runtime.

entry.title: Vocabulary Hijacking in LVLMs: Unveiling Critical Attention Heads by Excluding Inert Tokens to Mitigate Hallucination

author.name: Yangneng Chen, Junlin Li, Weijun Yao, Xilai Ma, Guodong Du, Wenya Wang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Identifies 'Vocabulary Hijacking' in LVLMs where specific inert visual tokens disproportionately attract attention and decode to fixed unrelated words, contributing to hallucinations. Proposes a targeted intervention to mitigate this phenomenon.

entry.title: Emergent introspection does not replicate on Llama-3.1-405B

author.name: Nick Merrill

entry.summary: Reports failure to replicate Lindsey (2026)'s emergent introspection finding on Llama-3.1-405B, suggesting introspective capability may be specific to Anthropic's post-training rather than a generic property of large post-trained LLMs.

entry.title: SkillMaster: Toward Autonomous Skill Mastery in LLM Agents

author.name: Min Yang, Jinghua Piao, Xu Xia, Xiaochong Lan, Jiaju Chen, Yongshun Gong, Yong Li

entry.summary: Proposes SkillMaster, a training framework that teaches LLM agents to autonomously create, refine, and select skills during task solving through trajectory-informed skill review, rather than relying on external teachers.

entry.title: CATO: Charted Attention for Neural PDE Operators

author.name: Chun-Wun Cheng, Sifan Wang, Carola-Bibiane Sch\"onlieb, Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero

entry.summary: Introduces CATO, a geometry-adaptive transformer operator for PDEs that applies attention in learned chart coordinates rather than physical coordinates, with derivative-aware tokenization for complex geometries.

entry.title: expo: Exploration-prioritized policy optimization via adaptive kl regulation and gaussian curriculum sampling

author.name: Mingxiong Lin, Zhangquan Gong, Maowen Tang, Qian Li, Chuangchuang Wang, Jian Ma, Sutian Huang, Kai Tang, Haonan Lu

entry.summary: Proposes EXPO with two modules for RLVR: Accuracy-Conditioned KL Scaling that dynamically adjusts exploration constraints, and Gaussian Curriculum Sampling that focuses on moderately difficult problems.

entry.title: VT-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Visual-Tabular Multi-Modal Learning

author.name: Zi-Yi Jia, Zi-Jian Cheng, Xin-Yue Zhang, Kun-Yang Yu, Zhi Zhou, Yu-Feng Li, Lan-Zhe Guo

entry.summary: Introduces VT-Bench, the first unified benchmark for visual-tabular multi-modal learning with 14 datasets across 9 domains and 756K+ samples. Evaluates 23 models including unimodal experts and VLMs.

entry.title: Evading Visual Aphasia: Contrastive Adaptive Semantic Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jie Ma, Yihang Liu, Zhike Qiu, Jiayi Ji, Xiaoshuai Sun

entry.summary: COAST introduces training-free adaptive semantic token pruning for vision-language models that avoids 'Visual Aphasia' - a failure mode where premature pruning causes models to lose visual grounding. Uses contrastive adaptive routing instead of shallow attention-based pruning.

entry.title: Classification-Head Bias in Class-Level Machine Unlearning: Diagnosis, Mitigation, and Evaluation

author.name: Weidong Zheng, Kongyang Chen, Yuanwei Guo, Yatie Xiao

entry.summary: Reveals a bias-dominated shortcut in class-level machine unlearning where forgetting is achieved by simply decreasing classification head bias terms rather than truly removing learned representations.

entry.title: Discrete Flow Matching: Convergence Guarantees Under Minimal Assumptions

author.name: Le-Tuyet-Nhi Pham, Giovanni Conforti, Zhenjie Ren, Alain Durmus

entry.summary: Provides convergence guarantees for Discrete Flow Matching under minimal assumptions, analyzing the theoretical properties of this framework for discrete source and target distributions.

entry.title: Make Each Token Count: Towards Improving Long-Context Performance with KV Cache Eviction

author.name: Ngoc Bui, Hieu Trung Nguyen, Arman Cohan, Rex Ying

entry.summary: Proposes learnable KV cache eviction that can improve generation quality over full-cache inference by removing irrelevant tokens. Uses global retention gates to assign utility scores to cached entries.

entry.title: DynaMiCS: Fine-tuning LLMs with Performance Constraints using Dynamic Mixtures

author.name: Eleonora Gualdoni, Sonia Laguna, Louis Bethune, Joao Monteiro, Pierre Ablin, Marco Cuturi

entry.summary: Proposes DynaMiCS, a dynamic mixture optimizer for multi-domain LLM fine-tuning that casts the problem as constrained optimization, using probing runs to estimate cross-domain effects and computing optimal mixture weights. Preserves performance on constrained domains like safety while improving target domains.

entry.title: RubricEM: Meta-RL with Rubric-guided Policy Decomposition beyond Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Gaotang Li, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Zifeng Wang, Jun Yan, Yanfei Chen, Chun-Liang Li, Long T. Le, Rujun Han, George Lee, Hanghang Tong, Chen-Yu Lee, Tomas Pfister

entry.summary: Introduces RubricEM, a rubric-guided RL framework for training deep research agents that decomposes policy execution into stages, uses rubrics as shared interfaces for execution/feedback/memory, and combines with reflection-based meta-policy evolution.

entry.title: Tracing Uncertainty in Language Model "Reasoning"

author.name: Nils Gr\"unefeld, Bertram H{\o}jer, Philipp Mondorf, Barbara Plank, Anna Rogers, Christian Hardmeier, Stefan Heinrich, Jes Frellsen

entry.summary: Studies reasoning dynamics through uncertainty quantification, treating CoT traces as evolving model states. Finds that uncertainty trace profiles (shape features like slope and linearity) predict correct final answers with AUROC up to 0.807.

entry.title: Thinking with Novel Views: A Systematic Analysis of Generative-Augmented Spatial Intelligence

author.name: Yanbing Zhang, Bo Wang, Jianhui Liu, Nan Jiang, Jiaxiu Jiang, Haoze Sun, Yijun Yang, Shenghe Zheng, Lin Song, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Wenbo Li

entry.summary: Thinking with Novel Views (TwNV) integrates generative novel-view synthesis into the reasoning loop of LMMs to resolve spatial ambiguity by generating alternative viewpoints for re-examination.

entry.title: Iterative Critique-and-Routing Controller for Multi-Agent Systems with Heterogeneous LLMs

author.name: Wenzhi Fang, Liangqi Yuan, Guangchen Lan, Dong-Jun Han, Christopher G. Brinton

entry.summary: Proposes a critique-and-routing controller for multi-agent LLM systems that iteratively evaluates drafts, decides whether to continue, and selects the next agent. Formulated as a finite-horizon MDP with explicit agent quality models.

entry.title: SeePhys Pro: Diagnosing Modality Transfer and Blind-Training Effects in Multimodal RLVR for Physics Reasoning

author.name: Kun Xiang, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Zirong Liu, Bokai Zhou, Yueling Tang, Junjie Yu, Jiacong Lu, Shangrui Huang, Heng Li, Likui Zhang, Kunkun Liu, Changzheng Zhang, Yangle Fang, Boqiang Guo, Hui-Ling Zhen, Dandan Tu, Yinya Huang, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: Introduces SeePhys Pro benchmark studying whether models preserve reasoning when information progressively moves from text to image. Finds current frontier models degrade as information shifts to visual modality, with visual variable grounding as key bottleneck.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Monte Carlo Tree Search over Knowledge Graphs: Composing Mechanistic Explanations for Drug-Disease Pairs

author.name: Rishabh Jakhar, Michel Dumontier, Remzi Celebi

entry.summary: Presents TESSERA, a neuro-symbolic framework using LLMs for local discriminative judgment within MCTS over knowledge graphs to compose mechanistic explanations for drug-disease pairs. LLMs provide heuristics while KG enforces structural constraints.

entry.title: Self-Captioning Multimodal Interaction Tuning: Amplifying Exploitable Redundancies for Robust Vision Language Models

author.name: Yuriel Ryan, Hei Man Ip, Adriel Kuek, Paul Pu Liang, Roy Ka-Wei Lee

entry.summary: Proposes self-captioning multimodal interaction tuning to amplify redundant information between modalities in vision-language models, addressing hallucination by exploiting shared cross-modal information to compensate for corrupted inputs.

entry.title: Semantic Voting: Execution-Grounded Consensus for LLM Code Generation

author.name: Shan Jiang, Zijian Yi, Chenguang Zhu

entry.summary: Studies 18 configurations of LLM code generation selection strategies, comparing output-pattern voting, weighted voting, MBR-Exec, and SemanticVote (clustering by execution fingerprints). Finds execution-based selectors exceed output-pattern majority voting by 19-52 percentage points.

entry.title: PPU-Bench:Real World Benchmark for Personalized Partial Unlearning in Vision Language Models

author.name: Jiahui Guang, Zexun Zhan, Zhenlin Xu, Cuiyun Gao, Haiyan Wang, Jing Li, Zhaoquan Gu, Yanchun Zhang

entry.summary: PPU-Bench benchmarks personalized partial unlearning in multimodal LLMs with 24K samples across 500 public figures under three challenge levels. Addresses the gap between synthetic unlearning benchmarks and realistic fine-grained deletion requests.

entry.title: Single-Configuration Attack Success Rate Is Not Enough: Jailbreak Evaluations Should Report Distributional Attack Success

author.name: Carsten Maple, Abhishek Kumar, Riya Tapwal

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that jailbreak evaluations should report distributional attack success across parameter configurations rather than single best-case results. Shows ASR varies substantially across attack parameters.

entry.title: Your Simulation Runs but Solves the Wrong Physics: PDE-Grounded Intent Verification for LLM-Generated Multiphysics Simulation Code

author.name: Zhenghan Song, Yulong Liu, Cheng Wan, Chenjun Li, Lingfu Liu, Yunyi Li, Congcong Yuan

entry.summary: Identifies the 'comprehension-generation gap' in LLM-generated simulation code where code runs but encodes wrong physics. Proposes Intent Fidelity Score (IFS) for MOOSE simulations by reconstructing the encoded PDE and comparing against intended contracts.

entry.title: Generalized Wasserstein Flow Matching: Transport Plans, Everywhere, All at Once

author.name: Moritz Piening, Richard Duong, Gabriele Steidl

entry.summary: Extends flow matching to the space of probability measures over probability measures (Wasserstein-on-Wasserstein), enabling generative modeling of distributions of distributions with scalable approximations.

entry.title: A Spectral Framework for Closed-Form Relative Density Estimation

author.name: Francis Bach (SIERRA)

entry.summary: Proposes a closed-form spectral framework for relative log-density estimation by representing KL divergence as an integral of weighted chi-squared divergences, converting estimation into least-squares problems. Extends to f-divergences and can be combined with kernels or neural networks.

entry.title: Muown: Row-Norm Control for Muon Optimization

author.name: Kai Lion, Florian H\"ubler, Bingcong Li, Antonio Orvieto, Niao He

entry.summary: Introduces Muown, a variant of the Muon optimizer that addresses spectral norm drift by decomposing it into row-magnitude and row-coherence factors, treating the row-magnitude vector as an explicit optimizer variable. Drop-in replacement for Muon in LLM pre-training.

entry.title: Quantifying Concentration Phenomena of Mean-Field Transformers in the Low-Temperature Regime

author.name: Albert Alcalde, Leon Bungert, Konstantin Riedl, Tim Roith

entry.summary: Proves that token distributions in deep mean-field transformers rapidly concentrate onto a projection induced by key/query/value matrices and remain metastable. Quantifies concentration using Wasserstein distance bounds.

entry.title: LaTER: Efficient Test-Time Reasoning via Latent Exploration and Explicit Verification

author.name: Xuan Li, Yining Wang, Yuchen Liu, Guanjun Liu, Delai Qiu, Shengping Liu, Jiaen Liang, Wei Huang, Jun Yu, Junnan Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes LaTER, a two-stage paradigm combining bounded exploration in continuous latent space followed by explicit CoT for verification. Offers a training-free approach that projects hidden states back to embedding space while preserving latent KV cache.

entry.title: ExpThink: Experience-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Chain-of-Thought Compression

author.name: Tingcheng Bian, Yuzhe Zhang, Jing Jin, Jinchang Luo, MingQuan Cheng, Haiwei Wang, Wenyuan Jiang, Miaohui Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ExpThink, an RL framework for adaptive chain-of-thought compression that uses experience-guided reward shaping tracking shortest correct solutions and difficulty-based length budgets, addressing limitations of static length penalties.

entry.title: Trajectory as the Teacher: Few-Step Discrete Flow Matching via Energy-Navigated Distillation

author.name: Amin Karimi Monsefi, Dominic Culver, Nikhil Bhendawade, Manuel R. Ciosici, Yizhe Zhang, Irina Belousova

entry.summary: Argues that trajectory quality, not student capacity, is the bottleneck in discrete flow matching distillation. Proposes TS-DFM which replaces blind stochastic jumps with energy-navigated guided navigation for better training trajectories.

entry.title: Power Reinforcement Post-Training of Text-to-Image Models with Super-Linear Advantage Shaping

author.name: Haoyuan Sun, Jing Wang, Yuxin Song, Yu Lu, Bo Fang, Yifu Luo, Jun Yin, Pengyu Zeng, Miao Zhang, Tiantian Zhang, Xueqian Wang, Shijian Lu

entry.summary: Identifies that standard normalization in GRPO-based RL post-training for text-to-image models leads to miscalibration and reward hacking. Proposes Super-Linear Advantage Shaping (SLAS) to better separate genuine performance signals from noise in T2I model alignment.

entry.title: Failing Forward: Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Meng Zheng, Samhita Marri, Anwesa Choudhuri, Benjamin Planche, Zhongpai Gao, Van Nguyen Nguyen, Terrence Chen, Girish Chowdhary, Ziyan Wu

entry.summary: AFIL proposes using failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion-based VLA policies, generating failure rollouts online and training dual action generators for success and failure to improve robustness against compounding errors.

entry.title: Behavioral Determinants of Deployed AI Agents in Social Networks: A Multi-Factor Study of Personality, Model, and Guardrail Specification

author.name: Sarah Wilson, Diem Linh Dang, Usman Ali Moazzam, Shan Ye, Gail Kaiser

entry.summary: Studies how personality specification, LLM backbone, and operational rules affect autonomous AI agent behavior on a Reddit-like social network. Multi-factor empirical study with 13 agents over 400 sessions each.

entry.title: MIND-Skill: Quality-Guaranteed Skill Generation via Multi-Agent Induction and Deduction

author.name: Yixuan Li, Mingshu Cai, Ziyang Xiao, Wanyuan Wang, Yanchen Deng, Bo An

entry.summary: Introduces MIND-Skill, a multi-agent framework that automatically induces generalizable skills from successful agent trajectories through induction and deduction, with quality guarantees for the generated skills.

entry.title: EvoMAS: Learning Execution-Time Workflows for Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Chengdong Xu, Kaiqiang Ke, Ziheng Liu, Jiaqi Wei, Zibo Shao, Weile Guo, Chao Yu

entry.summary: Proposes EvoMAS, a framework for execution-time multi-agent workflow construction that adapts workflows dynamically during task execution rather than optimizing them statically beforehand.

entry.title: CIVeX: Causal Intervention Verification for Language Agents

author.name: Fabio Rovai

entry.summary: Introduces CIVeX, a causal intervention verifier for language agents that maps proposed actions to structural causal queries, checks identifiability, and returns auditable verdicts (EXECUTE, REJECT, EXPERIMENT, ABSTAIN).

entry.title: Emergent Semantic Role Understanding in Language Models

author.name: Carla Griffiths, Mirco Musolesi

entry.summary: Studies whether semantic role understanding ('who did what to whom') emerges during pre-training or requires fine-tuning. Uses frozen decoder-only transformers with linear probes, finding role information is already encoded during pre-training.

entry.title: How Much is Brain Data Worth for Machine Learning?

author.name: Lane Lewis, Zhixin Wang, David Schwab, Xaq Pitkow

entry.summary: Addresses whether brain recording data can help train ML models, deriving scaling laws for how performance scales with brain and task samples in a linear Gaussian model. Provides theoretical framework for when neural data adds value.

entry.title: PiCA: Pivot-Based Credit Assignment for Search Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dongyi Liu, Yifan Niu, Qinwen Wang, Han Xiao, Jia Li

entry.summary: Proposes PiCA, a pivot-based credit assignment method for search agents trained with RL. Addresses reward sparsity, isolated credit, and distributional shift in long-horizon search tasks.

entry.title: CodeClinic: Evaluating Automation of Coding Skills for Clinical Reasoning Agents

author.name: Timothy Ossowski, Xinchi Liu, Danyal Maqbool, Vaibhav Dhanuka, Sheng Zhang, Hoifung Poon, Majid Afshar, Tyler Bradshaw, Junjie Hu

entry.summary: Introduces CodeClinic benchmark on MIMIC-IV for evaluating whether LLM agents can synthesize reusable clinical skills for ICU monitoring and patient tracking from EHRs, rather than relying on manually curated tools.

entry.title: Fairness of Explanations in Artificial Intelligence (AI): A Unifying Framework, Axioms, and Future Direction toward Responsible AI

author.name: Gideon Popoola, John Sheppard

entry.summary: Identifies a blind spot at the intersection of algorithmic fairness and explainable AI: models can satisfy fairness criteria in outputs while being unfair in reasoning process (procedural bias). Provides unifying framework and axioms.

entry.title: M2A: Synergizing Mathematical and Agentic Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Junjian Wang, Xin Zhou, Qiran Xu, Kun Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes M2A paradigm synergizing mathematical and agentic reasoning via model merging, addressing the misalignment between closed-world single-response math reasoning and multi-turn environment interaction.

entry.title: LoopVLA: Learning Sufficiency in Recurrent Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Boyang Shen, Kaixiang Yang, Hao Wang, Qiuyu Yu, Qiang Xie, Qiang Li, Zhiwei Wang

entry.summary: Presents LoopVLA, a recurrent VLA architecture that jointly learns representation refinement, action prediction, and sufficiency judgment to determine when a representation is adequate for action, avoiding excessive computation.

entry.title: Prospective Compression in Human Abstraction Learning

author.name: Leonardo Hernandez Cano, Ivan Zareski, Luisa El Amouri, Pinzhe Zhao, Max Mascini, Emanuele Sansone, Yewen Pu, Bonan Zhao, Marta Kryven

entry.summary: Studies how humans learn reusable abstractions in non-stationary domains, testing whether library learning is prospective (targeting future tasks) rather than retrospective (compressing past tasks). Uses Pattern Builder visual program synthesis task.

entry.title: Strategic Exploitation in LLM Agent Markets: A Simulation Framework for E-Commerce Trust

author.name: Shijun Lei, Quang Nguyen, Swapneel S Mehta, Zeping Li, Huichuan Fu, Xiaolong Zheng, Siki Chen, Yunji Liang, Philip Torr, Zhenfei Yin

entry.summary: Introduces TruthMarketTwin, a simulation framework studying LLM agent behavior in e-commerce markets with information asymmetry. Finds that LLM agents develop strategic deception behaviors including quality misrepresentation and rating manipulation.

entry.title: Benchmarking Safety Risks of Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning under Malicious Knowledge Editing

author.name: Qinghua Mao, Xi Lin, Jinze Gu, Jun Wu, Siyuan Li, Yuliang Chen

entry.summary: Presents EditRisk-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating safety risks when malicious knowledge is injected into LLMs through knowledge editing. Shows that edited knowledge can corrupt downstream reasoning in safety-critical ways.

entry.title: TMAS: Scaling Test-Time Compute via Multi-Agent Synergy

author.name: George Wu, Nan Jing, Qing Yi, Chuan Hao, Ming Yang, Feng Chang, Yuan Wei, Jian Yang, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai

entry.summary: Proposes TMAS, a multi-agent framework for scaling test-time compute that organizes inference as collaborative multi-agent synergy with explicit mechanisms for balancing exploration and exploitation across reasoning trajectories.

entry.title: Agent-X: Full Pipeline Acceleration of On-device AI Agents

author.name: Jinha Chung, Byeongjun Shin, Jiin Kim, Minsoo Rhu

entry.summary: Introduces Agent-X, a software-only framework that accelerates on-device LLM agents by rewriting prompts for prefix caching and enabling LLM-free speculative decoding. Achieves 1.61x end-to-end speedup with no accuracy loss.

entry.title: Consistency as a Testable Property: Statistical Methods to Evaluate AI Agent Reliability

author.name: Harsh Raj, Niranjan Orkat, Suvrorup Mukherjee, Aritra Guha, Cheryl Flynn, Subhabrata Majumdar

entry.summary: Establishes a rigorous measurement framework for AI agent reliability using U-statistics for output consistency and kernel-based metrics for trajectory stability. Shows minor task variations can cause complete strategy breakdowns.

entry.title: PRISM: Generation-Time Detection and Mitigation of Secret Leakage in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines

author.name: Riya Tapwal, Abhishek Kumar, Carsten Maple

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM for detecting and mitigating secret leakage in multi-agent LLM pipelines during generation time. Formalizes 'propagation amplification' where sensitive information spreads across agent boundaries.

entry.title: ComplexMCP: Evaluation of LLM Agents in Dynamic, Interdependent, and Large-Scale Tool Sandbox

author.name: Yuanyang Li, Xue Yang, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Hongyang Chen

entry.summary: Introduces ComplexMCP, a benchmark evaluating LLM agents with 300+ tools across 7 stateful sandboxes that simulate interdependent tools, dynamic states, and API failures. Built on Model Context Protocol.

entry.title: The Generalized Turing Test: A Foundation for Comparing Intelligence

author.name: Daniel Mitropolsky, Susan S. Hong, Riccardo Neumarker, Emanuele Rimoldi, Tomaso Poggio

entry.summary: Introduces the Generalized Turing Test (GTT), a formal framework for comparing agent capabilities via indistinguishability. Defines a Turing comparator and studies conditions for transitivity to induce orderings over agents.

entry.title: MedThink: Enhancing Diagnostic Accuracy in Small Models via Teacher-Guided Reasoning Correction

author.name: Xinchun Su, Chunxu Luo, Lipeng Ma, Yixuan Li, Weidong Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MedThink, a two-stage knowledge distillation framework that transfers structured clinical reasoning from large LLMs to small language models for medical diagnosis. Goes beyond transferring answer patterns to preserve reasoning chains.

entry.title: Towards Universal Gene Regulatory Network Inference: Unlocking Generalizable Regulatory Knowledge in Single-cell Foundation Models

author.name: Jiaxin Qi, Hang Li, Yan Cui, Yuhua Zheng, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: Introduces a GRN generalization benchmark for evaluating gene regulatory network predictions on unseen genes/datasets, and proposes a regulatory-aware pre-training strategy for single-cell foundation models to better capture latent regulatory signals.

entry.title: HoReN: Normalized Hopfield Retrieval for Large-Scale Sequential Model Editing

author.name: Yuan Fang, Yi Xie, Xuming Ran

entry.summary: Proposes HoReN, a codebook-based model editing method using normalized Hopfield retrieval for improved routing in large-scale sequential editing of LLMs. Addresses performance degradation at scale.

entry.title: HY-Himmel Technical Report: Hierarchical Interleaved Multi-stream Motion Encoding for Long Video Understanding

author.name: Haopeng Jin, Hongzhu Yi, Wenlong Zhao, Jinwen Luo, Shani Ye, Zhenyu Guan, Shiquan Dong, Tiankun Yang, Tao Yu

entry.summary: Presents HY-Himmel, a hierarchical video-language framework that uses sparse anchor frames for a ViT and a lightweight compressed-domain tri-stream adapter for motion encoding, addressing the cost-quality tradeoff in long video understanding.

entry.title: A Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection Framework via Synergistic Smoothing

author.name: Maria Stoica, Abdelrahman Hekal, Alessio Lomuscio

entry.summary: Proposes ROSS, a robust OOD detection framework using median smoothing that repurposes noise samples to quantify local score instability. OOD samples show higher instability under perturbation.

entry.title: NoisyCoconut: Counterfactual Consensus via Latent Space Reasoning

author.name: Michael Jerge, David Evans

entry.summary: Proposes NoisyCoconut, an inference-time method that injects controlled noise into LLM latent trajectories to generate diverse reasoning paths, using agreement among paths as a confidence signal for selective abstention.

entry.title: When Does Value-Aware KV Eviction Help? A Fixed-Contract Diagnostic for Non-Monotone Cache Compression

author.name: Ruijie Zhang, Haozhe Liang, Da Chang, Li Hu, Fanqi Kong, Huaxiao Yin, Yu Li

entry.summary: Introduces a fixed-contract diagnostic for KV cache compression that changes one decision slot at a time to understand why value-aware eviction selectors succeed or fail in long-context LLM inference.

entry.title: Why Do DiT Editors Drift? Plug-and-Play Low Frequency Alignment in VAE Latent Space

author.name: Xiaoce Wang, Sifan Zhou, Kaifei Wang, Leli Xu, Xuerui Qiu, Tao He, Ming Li

entry.summary: Analyzes why DiT-based image editors drift during multi-turn editing from a latent-space frequency perspective, finding DiT introduces dominant low-frequency drift. Proposes VAE-LFA, a training-free plug-and-play fix.

entry.title: HyperTransport: Amortized Conditioning of T2I Generative Models

author.name: Valentino Maiorca, Eleonora Gualdoni, Xavier Suau, Marco Cuturi, Luca Zappella, Pau Rodr\'iguez

entry.summary: Proposes HyperTransport for amortized activation steering of T2I generative models, enabling control over new concepts without per-concept optimization using a hypernetwork approach.

entry.title: Bridging Modalities, Spanning Time: Structured Memory for Ultra-Long Agentic Video Reasoning

author.name: Jiazheng Li, Chi-Hao Wu, Yunze Liu, Kaize Ding, Jundong Li, Chuxu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MAGIC-Video, a training-free framework for ultra-long video understanding using a multimodal memory graph with interleaved narrative chains, supporting cross-modal retrieval and long-range temporal reasoning.

entry.title: Multi-Armed Bandits With Best-Action Queries

author.name: Francesco Bacchiocchi, Matteo Castiglioni, Alberto Marchesi, Francesco Emanuele Stradi

entry.summary: Studies multi-armed bandits augmented with best-action oracle queries under bandit feedback (not full feedback), resolving an open problem about whether query benefits extend to the more realistic partial-information setting.

entry.title: LLMSYS-HPOBench: Hyperparameter Optimization Benchmark Suite for Real-World LLM Systems

author.name: Siyu Wu, Yulong Ye, Zezhen Xiang, Pengzhou Chen, Gangda Xiong, Tao Chen

entry.summary: Presents LLMSYS-HPOBench, the first hyperparameter optimization benchmark for real-world LLM systems, covering the compound configuration space of both AI and non-AI components with profiled inference objectives.

entry.title: The Reciprocity Gradient

author.name: Yue Lin, Pascal Poupart, Shuhui Zhu, Dan Qiao, Wenhao Li, Yuan Liu, Hongyuan Zha, Baoxiang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces the reciprocity gradient for multi-agent strategic interactions, which backpropagates reward gradients through private estimators of opponents' policies to enable cooperation through reputation channels.

entry.title: AIPO: : Learning to Reason from Active Interaction

author.name: Junnan Liu, Linhao Luo, Thuy-Trang Vu, Gholamreza Haffari

entry.summary: Introduces AIPO, an RL framework that improves LLM reasoning through active interaction with an expert model during rollouts, rather than relying solely on complete trajectory-level guidance.

entry.title: Sink vs. diagonal patterns as mechanisms for attention switch and oversmoothing prevention

author.name: Peter S\'uken\'ik, Cristina L\'opez Amado, Christoph H. Lampert, Marco Mondelli

entry.summary: Analyzes sink tokens and diagonal patterns in attention as mechanisms for attention switching and oversmoothing prevention, proving geometric conditions and equivalences between sinks and hard attention switch.

entry.title: Kaczmarz Linear Attention

author.name: Jiaxuan Zou, Ruifeng Ren, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Kaczmarz Linear Attention, deriving linear attention update rules from the Kaczmarz algorithm for online regression, replacing the learned coefficient in GDN with a principled derivation.

entry.title: Causal Stories from Sensor Traces: Auditing Epistemic Overreach in LLM-Generated Personal Sensing Explanations

author.name: Shanshan Zhu, Han Zhang, J. Doris Chi, Subigya Nepal, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Introduces epistemic overreach (EO) as a measure for when LLM explanations of personal sensing data imply more than available evidence justifies, auditing 14,922 explanations across three sensing datasets.

entry.title: Reasoning-Aware Training for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Md Atik Ahamed, Mihir Parmar, Palash Goyal, Chun-Liang Li, Qiang Cheng, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes STRIDE, a framework integrating LLM reasoning into time series foundation models by distilling reasoning traces into the continuous embedding space, bridging the modality gap between text and temporal data.

entry.title: Event Fields: Learning Latent Event Structure for Waveform Foundation Models

author.name: Li Na, Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li

entry.summary: Proposes a new class of waveform foundation models that model physiological time series as realizations of latent event processes rather than token sequences. Uses self-supervised learning with consistency across stochastic segmentations and time-frequency projections.

entry.title: Gate-and-Merge: Zero-shot Compositional Personalization of Vision Language Models

author.name: Guodong Ding, Angela Yao

entry.summary: Gate-and-Merge enables zero-shot compositional personalization of vision-language models by learning independent LoRA adapters per concept and merging them at inference via a gating mechanism. No co-occurrence training required.

entry.title: Debugging the Debuggers: Failure-Anchored Structured Recovery for Software Engineering Agents

author.name: Chenyu Zhao, Shenglin Zhang, Yihang Lin, Wenwei Gu, Zhimin Chen, Yongqian Sun, Dan Pei, Chetan Bansal, Saravan Rajmohan, Minghua Ma

entry.summary: PROBE is a failure-anchored recovery framework for software engineering agents that converts failed-run telemetry into structured diagnosis and bounded recovery guidance through three layers. Aims to make post-failure recovery systematic rather than ad hoc.

entry.title: Communicating Sound Through Natural Language

author.name: Emanuele Rossi, Emanuele Rodol\`a

entry.summary: Introduces lexical acoustic coding (LAC), where LLM agents transmit sound through natural language by writing their own analysis/synthesis code. Sender analyzes waveforms into descriptors, verbalizes as English; receiver parses and reconstructs.

entry.title: Deterministic Decomposition of Stochastic Generative Dynamics

author.name: Xingyu Song, Yuan Mei, Naoya Takeishi

entry.summary: Shows that the deterministic velocity field of stochastic generative processes admits a transport-osmotic decomposition separating deterministic transport from stochastic fluctuation. Provides theoretical clarity on the relationship between deterministic and stochastic generative models.

entry.title: FraudBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Fraudulent Refund Evidence

author.name: Xinyu Yan, Boyang Chen, Jiaming Zhang, Tiantong Wu, Hong Xi Tae, Yichen He, Tiantong Wang, Yachun Mi, Yurong Hao, Yilei Zhao, Lei Xiao, Longtao Huang, Pengjun Xie, Wei Liu, Wei Yang Bryan Lim

entry.summary: FraudBench is a multimodal benchmark for detecting AI-generated fraudulent refund evidence, where manipulated images are used to support fake damage/defect claims. Addresses the gap between generic AI-image detection and claim-conditioned fraud detection.

entry.title: MolWorld: Molecule World Models for Actionable Molecular Optimization

author.name: Yang Qiao, Bo Pan, Hao-Wei Pang, Peter Zhiping Zhang, Liying Zhang, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: MolWorld formulates actionable molecular optimization as sequential expansion of a molecule-transfer graph, where candidates must be reachable from known molecules through valid local transformations, making suggestions practically useful for drug discovery.

entry.title: Octopus Protocol: One-Shot Hardware Discovery and Control for AI Agents via Infrastructure-as-Prompts

author.name: Quilee Simeon, Justin M. Wei, Yile Fan

entry.summary: Octopus Protocol enables one-shot hardware discovery and control for AI agents via a five-stage pipeline that automatically generates MCP servers for newly connected devices, collapsing hardware bring-up to a single command.

entry.title: Fast Rates for Offline Contextual Bandits with Forward-KL Regularization under Single-Policy Concentrability

author.name: Qingyue Zhao, Kaixuan Ji, Heyang Zhao, Quanquan Gu

entry.summary: Establishes first O(ε⁻¹) fast rates for forward-KL-regularized offline contextual bandits under single-policy concentrability, bridging a gap where only reverse-KL had been shown to achieve fast rates. Results hold in both tabular and function approximation settings.

entry.title: Flame3D: Zero-shot Compositional Reasoning of 3D Scenes with Agentic Language Models

author.name: Sagar Bharadwaj, Ziyong Ma, Anurag Ghosh, Srinivasan Seshan, Anthony Rowe

entry.summary: Flame3D is a training-free framework for zero-shot 3D scene understanding that represents scenes as editable visual-textual 3D memories and exposes them to off-the-shelf MLLMs through composable spatial tools. It handles complex reasoning including free space, object grounding, and hypothetical insertions without 3D-specific training.

entry.title: Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models

author.name: Kai Zhao, Dongliang Nie, Yuchen Lin, Zhehan Luo, Yixiao Gu, Deng-Ping Fan, Dan Zeng

entry.summary: Sub-JEPA improves JEPA-based world models by replacing the isotropic Gaussian prior (used in LeWM) with a subspace Gaussian regularization that respects the low-dimensional manifold structure of latent representations, addressing the bias-variance tradeoff in JEPA training.

entry.title: RePO-VLA: Recovery-Driven Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Weijia Liufu, Xiaoyu Guo, Ruiyi Chen, Jingzhi Liu, Kaidong Zhang, Xiwen Liang, Jianqi Lin, Dawei Sun, Yuze Wang, Rongtao Xu, Bingqian Lin, Bowen Yang, Tongtong Cao, Bowen Peng, Dongyu Zhang, Guangrun Wang, Min Wang, Liang Lin, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: RePO-VLA introduces recovery-driven policy optimization for Vision-Language-Action models, leveraging failed and recovery trajectories rather than discarding them. Uses Progress-Aware Semantic Value Function for learning from diverse trajectory types.

entry.title: TAD: Temporal-Aware Trajectory Self-Distillation for Fast and Accurate Diffusion LLM

author.name: Haoyang Zhou, Li Kong, Shijie Ren, Xiting Wang, Shuang Liang, Guowei Wang, Zhenxuan Pan

entry.summary: TAD proposes temporal-aware trajectory self-distillation for diffusion language models, partitioning masked positions into near/distant subsets based on remaining decoding steps. Addresses the accuracy-parallelism tradeoff in parallel text generation.

entry.title: Biosignal Fingerprinting: A Cross-Modal PPG-ECG Foundation Model

author.name: Zhangdaihong Liu, Chang Liu, Fenglin Liu, Yixuan Chen, Yang Yang, David A. Clifton, Xiao Gu

entry.summary: Introduces biosignal fingerprints via a cross-modal foundation model (M2AE) trained on 3.4 million paired ECG-PPG signals. Creates compact transferable representations bridging diagnostic ECG with ubiquitous wearable PPG.

entry.title: One for All: A Non-Linear Transformer can Enable Cross-Domain Generalization for In-Context Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Bowen He, Juncheng Dong, Lin Lin, Xiang Cheng

entry.summary: Establishes a connection between non-linear transformers and reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces to enable cross-domain generalization for in-context reinforcement learning, showing a single transformer can generalize across different task domains.

entry.title: Entropy-informed Decoding: Adaptive Information-Driven Branching

author.name: Benjamin Patrick Evans, Sumitra Ganesh, Leo Ardon

entry.summary: Introduces EDEN, a model-agnostic decoding framework that adaptively allocates computation based on model uncertainty (entropy), approximating beam search with fewer expansions by branching only at high-uncertainty steps.

entry.title: LEVI: Stronger Search Architectures Can Substitute for Larger LLMs in Evolutionary Search

author.name: Temoor Tanveer

entry.summary: Introduces LEVI, an evolutionary framework arguing that stronger search architectures can substitute for larger LLMs in evolutionary search, improving on AlphaEvolve-style approaches by better archive diversity and model allocation.

entry.title: EgoMemReason: A Memory-Driven Reasoning Benchmark for Long-Horizon Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Ziyang Wang, Yue Zhang, Shoubin Yu, Ce Zhang, Zengqi Zhao, Jaehong Yoon, Hyunji Lee, Gedas Bertasius, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Introduces EgoMemReason, a benchmark for long-horizon egocentric video understanding requiring memory-driven reasoning over multiple days, with tasks testing temporal accumulation, recall, ordering, and pattern abstraction.

entry.title: Rethinking Random Transformers as Adaptive Sequence Smoothers for Sleep Staging

author.name: Guisong Liu, Xin Gao, Martin Dresler, Jiansong Zhang, Pengfei Wei
