entry.summary: Introduces ACWM-Phys, a benchmark for evaluating action-conditioned world models under diverse physical dynamics including rigid-body, kinematics, deformable objects, and particles in controllable simulation.

entry.title: EditSleuth: A Dataset of Grounded Reasoning Chains for Image-Edit Forensics

author.name: Van-Loc Nguyen, AprilPyone MaungMaung, Minh-Triet Tran, Isao Echizen

entry.summary: Introduces EditSleuth, a dataset of 257,725 image-edit triplets for grounded forensic reasoning, including edit masks, taxonomy labels, difficulty scores, and human-verified reasoning chains.

entry.title: LLaVA-UHD v4: What Makes Efficient Visual Encoding in MLLMs?

author.name: Kechen Fang, Yihua Qin, Chongyi Wang, Wenshuo Ma, Tianyu Yu, Yuan Yao

entry.summary: LLaVA-UHD v4 revisits visual encoding in MLLMs, showing that slice-based encoding outperforms global encoding and proposing efficient compression techniques that reduce the computational bottleneck for high-resolution inputs.

entry.title: Attention Sinks in Diffusion Transformers: A Causal Analysis

author.name: Fangzheng Wu, Brian Summa

entry.summary: Causal analysis of attention sinks in diffusion transformers reveals that removing dominant attention recipients does not degrade text-image alignment metrics, suggesting these sinks may be less functionally important than assumed.

entry.title: SpaceMind++: Toward Allocentric Cognitive Maps for Spatially Grounded Video MLLMs

author.name: Bo Gu, Zhikang Zhang, Zizhuang Wei, Zhenyuan Chen, Lingyun Li, Zhuoyi Song

entry.summary: SpaceMind++ proposes a video MLLM that explicitly builds voxelized allocentric cognitive maps from RGB videos, inspired by mammalian dual-stream processing, enabling persistent spatial reasoning across viewpoints.

entry.title: ERASE: Eliminating Redundant Visual Tokens via Adaptive Two-Stage Token Pruning

author.name: Yuna Lee, Kyoungho Min, Yulhwa Kim

entry.summary: ERASE proposes a two-stage vision token pruning framework for Vision-Language Models that adaptively identifies and retains salient tokens based on image complexity, reducing computational overhead from high-resolution image processing.

entry.title: SocialDirector: Training-Free Social Interaction Control for Multi-Person Video Generation

author.name: Liangyang Ouyang, Ruicong Liu, Caixin Kang, Yifei Huang, Yoichi Sato

entry.summary: SocialDirector is a training-free controller for multi-person video generation that modulates cross-attention maps to specify who performs which action, when, and toward whom, addressing actor-action mismatch problems.

entry.title: 3DReflecNet: A Large-Scale Dataset for 3D Reconstruction of Reflective, Transparent, and Low-Texture Objects

author.name: Zhicheng Liang, Haoyi Yu, Boyan Li, Dayou Zhang, Zijian Cao, Tianyi Gong, Junhua Liu, Shuguang Cui, Fangxin Wang

entry.summary: 3DReflecNet is a 22TB+ hybrid dataset specifically designed for benchmarking 3D reconstruction of reflective, transparent, and low-texture objects with 120,000+ synthetic instances and real scans.

entry.title: Position: Life-Logging Video Streams Make the Privacy-Utility Trade-off Inevitable

author.name: Tianyuan Zou, Liang Yue, Yang Liu, Ya-Qin Zhang, Sijie Cheng

entry.summary: This position paper argues that life-logging video streams from always-on devices make the privacy-utility trade-off inevitable for next-generation AI systems, analyzing risks beyond isolated images.

entry.title: Uni-Synergy: Bridging Understanding and Generation for Personalized Reasoning via Co-operative Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zijun Shen, Sihan Yang, Ruichuan An, Ziyu Guo, Hao Liang, Ming Lu, Renrui Zhang, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: Sync-R1 proposes cooperative reinforcement learning to jointly optimize personalized understanding and generation in Unified Multimodal Models, creating mutual feedback between comprehension and creation.

entry.title: RadThinking: A Dataset for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning in Radiology

author.name: Wenxuan Li, Pedro R. A. S. Bassi, Xinze Zhou, Jakob Wasserthal, Alan L. Yuille, Zongwei Zhou

entry.summary: RadThinking presents a VQA dataset for radiology that makes clinical reasoning explicit and trainable, with multi-step chain-of-thought structured by clinical reporting standards like LI-RADS.

entry.title: Count Anything at Any Granularity

author.name: Chang Liu, Haoning Wu, Weidi Xie

entry.summary: Redefines open-world object counting as a multi-grained problem across five explicit semantic granularity levels, from specific identity to abstract concept. Introduces methods to handle the data bottleneck exposed by making granularity explicit in vision-language counting.

entry.title: SABER: A Scalable Action-Based Embodied Dataset for Real-World VLA Adaptation

author.name: Narsimha Menga, Parikshit Sakurikar, Amirreza Rouhi, Satya Sai Reddy, Anirudh Govil, Sri Harsha Chittajallu, Rajat Aggarwal, Anoop Namboodiri, Sashi Reddi

entry.summary: SABER provides a large-scale retail robotics action dataset from 100+ hours of natural in-store capture across real grocery environments, addressing the data gap for VLA model adaptation to retail domains.

entry.title: StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception

author.name: Evans Han, Yunfan Jiang, Yingke Wang, Haoyue Xiao, Huang Huang, Jianwen Xie, Jiajun Wu, Li Fei-Fei, Ruohan Zhang

entry.summary: StereoPolicy introduces a visuomotor policy learning framework that leverages synchronized stereo image pairs for improved geometric reasoning in manipulation, without requiring explicit 3D reconstruction or camera calibration.

entry.title: Preserving Foundational Capabilities in Flow-Matching VLAs through Conservative SFT

author.name: Tianyi Zhang, Shaopeng Zhai, Haoran Zhang, Fuxian Huang, Qi Zhang

entry.summary: ConSFT introduces conservative supervised fine-tuning for flow-matching VLA models that prevents catastrophic forgetting by dynamically scaling learning signals based on model confidence, inspired by RL trust-region methods.

entry.title: Beyond Isolation: A Unified Benchmark for General-Purpose Navigation

author.name: Samson Sun, Tianyi Yang, Tengyue Wang, Yikai Xue, Zhengjie Xu, Lingming Zhang, Qichen Zhang, Chao Liang, Zhipeng Zhang

entry.summary: OmniNavBench introduces a unified navigation benchmark with compositional multi-skill instructions, cross-embodiment evaluation, and dynamic social challenges, addressing fragmentation in current navigation evaluation.

entry.title: Empowerment, corrigibility, etc. are simple abstractions (of a messed-up ontology)

author.name: Steven Byrnes

entry.summary: Steven Byrnes argues that concepts like empowerment, corrigibility, and manipulation-avoidance rest on incoherent human intuitions about free will, making it fundamentally difficult to formalize the distinction between guidance and manipulation in AI systems.

entry.title: Measuring What Matters: Benchmarking Generative, Multimodal, and Agentic AI in Healthcare

author.name: Prasanna Desikan, Harshit Rajgarhia, Shivali Dalmia, Ananya Mantravadi

entry.summary: Reviews the state of benchmarking for generative, multimodal, and agentic AI in healthcare, arguing that current benchmarks test knowledge but not reliability, safety, or clinical relevance under real-world conditions.

entry.title: SynerDiff: Synergetic Continuous Batching for Fast and Parallel Diffusion Model Inference

author.name: Ziqi Zhou, Peng Yang, Yuxin Liang, Mingliu Liu, Jia Lu

entry.summary: Proposes SynerDiff, a continuous batching system for diffusion model inference that resolves resource contention between UNet and VAE through chunking, adaptive skip-CFG, and synergistic scheduling.

entry.title: Ace-Skill: Bootstrapping Multimodal Agents with Prioritized and Clustered Evolution

author.name: Feng Xiong, Zengbin Wang, Yong Wang, Xuecai Hu, Jinghan He, Liang Lin, Yuan Liu, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Introduces Ace-Skill, a co-evolutionary framework for multimodal agents that jointly optimizes rollout allocation and knowledge organization through prioritized evolution and clustered skill banks.

entry.title: PnP-Corrector: A Universal Correction Framework for Coupled Spatiotemporal Forecasting

author.name: Hao Wu, Fan Xu, Yuxu Lu, Penghao Zhao, Fan Zhang, Hao Jia, Yuxuan Liang, Ruijian Gou, Qingsong Wen, Xian Wu, Xiaomeng Huang, Yuan Gao

entry.summary: Introduces PnP-Corrector for coupled spatiotemporal forecasting that addresses Reciprocal Error Amplification by decoupling physical simulation from error correction, training only a lightweight correction module.

entry.title: Agentic MIP Research: Accelerated Constraint Handler Generation

author.name: Liding Xu, Yugeng Zhou, Sebastian Pokutta

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic framework for MIP research that embeds LLM agents into a solver-aware harness for generating, verifying, and evaluating constraint handler plugins for SCIP solver. Demonstrates automatic construction of propagation-only constraint handlers.

entry.title: Dsat: A Native SAT Solver for Discrete Logic

author.name: Yaofang Zhang, Ken Zhou, Adnan Darwiche

entry.summary: Develops Dsat, a native SAT solver for discrete (non-Boolean) logic with unit resolution and clause learning operating directly on multi-valued variables, avoiding binarization overhead.

entry.title: Towards a Virtual Neuroscientist: Autonomous Neuroimaging Analysis via Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Keqi Han, Songlin Zhao, Yao Su, Lifang He, Carl Yang

entry.summary: Introduces NIAgent, a multi-agent system for autonomous neuroimaging analysis that bridges the gap between static pipelines like fMRIPrep and adaptive, closed-loop reasoning about analysis decisions.

entry.title: A Game Theoretic Free Energy Analysis of Higher Order Synergy in Attention Heads of Large Language Models

author.name: Djamel Bouchaffra

entry.summary: Applies the Game Theoretic Free Energy Principle to analyze attention head interactions in LLMs, using Harsanyi dividends to decompose coalition structures. Finds that triple dividends can be negative, indicating higher-order synergy.

entry.title: PDEAgent-Bench: A Multi-Metric, Multi-Library Benchmark for PDE Solver Generation

author.name: Zhen Hang, Yushan Yashengjiang, Junhui Li, Huanshuo Dong, Yang Wei, Zhezheng Hao, Jiangtao Ma, Songlin Bai, Haozhong Kai, Xihang Yue, Gangzong Si, Dongming Jiang, Chao Yao, Zhanhua Hu, Jiangqing Zhang, Pengwei Liu, Yaomin Shen, Xingyu Ren, Lei Liu, Zikang Xu, Han Li, Qingsong Yao, Hande Dong, Hong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PDEAgent-Bench, a multi-metric benchmark for evaluating LLM code generation of PDE solvers, addressing challenges specific to numerical methods including convergence verification and multi-library compatibility.

entry.title: Separate First, Fuse Later: Mitigating Cross-Modal Interference in Audio-Visual LLMs Reasoning with Modality-Specific Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Xuanchen Li, Yuheng Lu, Chenrui Cui, Tianrui Wang, Zikang Huang, Yu Jiang, Long Zhou, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: Proposes Separate First, Fuse Later (SFFL) for audio-visual reasoning, enforcing modality-specific chain-of-thought to reduce cross-modal interference and hallucinations in audio-visual LLMs.

entry.title: CORTEG: Foundation Models Enable Cross-Modality Representation Transfer from Scalp to Intracranial Brain Recordings

author.name: Liuyin Yang, Qiang Sun, Bob Van Dyck, Eva Calvo Merino, Marc M. Van Hulle

entry.summary: Introduces CORTEG, a framework for transferring pretrained scalp-EEG foundation models to intracranial ECoG recordings for brain-computer interfaces. Achieves competitive decoding while calibrating to new patients in 10-30 minutes.

entry.title: How Mobile World Model Guides GUI Agents?

author.name: Weikai Xu, Kun Huang, Yunren Feng, Jiaxing Li, Yuhan Chen, Yuxuan Liu, Zhizheng Jiang, Heng Qu, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Xiaolin Hu, Bo An

entry.summary: Investigates how mobile world models can guide GUI agents by training models across four modalities (delta text, full text, diffusion images, renderable code). Achieves SOTA on mobile world model benchmarks and studies test-time guidance effects.

entry.title: PrimeKG-CL: A Continual Graph Learning Benchmark on Evolving Biomedical Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Yousef A. Radwan, Yao Li, Qing Qing, Ziqi Xu, Xingtong Yu, Jiaxing Huang, Renqiang Luo, Xikun Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PrimeKG-CL, a continual graph learning benchmark built from 9 biomedical databases with genuine temporal snapshots (2021-2023). Addresses the gap between synthetic CGL benchmarks and real biomedical KG evolution.

entry.title: MATRA: Modeling the Attack Surface of Agentic AI Systems -- OpenClaw Case Study

author.name: Tim Van hamme, Thomas Vissers, Javier Carnerero-Cano, Mario Fritz, Emil C. Lupu, Lieven Desmet, Dinil Mon Divakaran

entry.summary: Presents MATRA, a threat modeling framework for agentic AI systems that adapts established risk assessment to systematically map LLM threats to deployment-specific risks. Demonstrates on OpenClaw personal AI agent deployment.

entry.title: Reasoning Is Not Free: Robust Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing for LLM-as-a-Judge

author.name: Wenbo Zhang, Lijinghua Zhang, Liner Xiang, Hengrui Cai

entry.summary: Shows reasoning models improve LLM-as-judge accuracy on structured tasks (math, coding) but not on simpler evaluations. Proposes RACER for dynamically routing between reasoning and non-reasoning judges to optimize cost-accuracy tradeoff.

entry.title: MULTITEXTEDIT: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Degradation in Text-in-Image Editing

author.name: Liwei Cheng, Zirui Song, Shibo Feng, Lunjie Zhou, Yixuan Guan, Dayan Guan

entry.summary: Introduces MULTITEXTEDIT, a controlled benchmark of 3,600 instances spanning 12 languages for evaluating cross-lingual text-in-image editing, with a new language fidelity metric for detecting script-level errors.

entry.title: Generalized Category Discovery in Federated Graph Learning

author.name: Zhongzheng Yuan, Lianshuai Guo, Xunkai Li, Wenyu Wang, Meixia Qu

entry.summary: Addresses Federated Graph Generalized Category Discovery - discovering novel categories across decentralized graph clients while retaining known categories. Identifies challenges of Neighborhood Absorption Effect and Global Semantic Fragmentation.

entry.title: Quantile Geometry Regularization for Distributional Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhaofan Zhang, Minghao Yang, Rufeng Chen, Sihong Xie, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes RQIQN, a distributionally robust enhancement to quantile-based distributional RL using Wasserstein robustness to correct Bellman targets, addressing distorted distribution estimates in bootstrapped methods.

entry.title: TRAM: Training Approximate Multiplier Structures for Low-Power AI Accelerators

author.name: Chang Meng, Hanyu Wang, Yuyang Ye, Mingfei Yu, Wayne Burleson, Giovanni De Micheli

entry.summary: Proposes TRAM, a framework that jointly optimizes approximate multiplier structure and AI model parameters for low-power AI accelerators, achieving up to 27% power reduction on vision transformers.

entry.title: Trapping Attacker in Dilemma: Examining Internal Correlations and External Influences of Trigger for Defending GNN Backdoors

author.name: Fan Yang, Binyan Xu, Di Tang, Kehuan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PRAETORIAN, a defense against GNN backdoor attacks that targets intrinsic requirements (large injection or high influence) rather than surface-level trigger patterns, making it robust to adaptive attackers.

entry.title: A Qualitative Test-Risk Mechanism for Scaling Behavior in Normalized Residual Networks

author.name: Daning Cheng, Zeyu Liu, Jun Sun, Fen Xia, Boyang Zhang, Dongping Liu, Yunquan Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical framework for understanding scaling behavior in normalized residual networks by decomposing depth expansion into representational gain, optimization gain, and generalization transfer.

entry.title: When Attention Beats Fourier: Multi-Scale Transformers for PDE Solving on Irregular Domains

author.name: Brandon Yee, Pairie Koh, Jack Rodriguez, Mihir Tekal

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Scale Attention Transformer (MSAT) for PDE solving, showing when learned attention outperforms Fourier-domain neural operators, particularly on irregular domains. Evaluates against 9 baselines across 5 benchmarks.

entry.title: Interactive Critique-Revision Training for Reliable Structured LLM Generation

author.name: Fei Xu Yu, Zuyuan Zhang, Mahdi Imani, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Proposes DPA-GRPO, a dual paired-action training method for generator-verifier systems producing structured LLM outputs with safety assurance cases, targeting form filling, compliance, and maintenance workflows.

entry.title: Effective Explanations Support Planning Under Uncertainty

author.name: Hanqi Zhou, Britt Besch, Charley M. Wu, Tobias Gerstenberg

entry.summary: Proposes a computational model where LLMs translate navigation explanations into program-like guidance (policy priors and value maps), and evaluates explanation quality through resulting navigation efficiency in a preregistered study with 1,200 explanations.

entry.title: Do Benchmarks Underestimate LLM Performance? Evaluating Hallucination Detection With LLM-First Human-Adjudicated Assessment

author.name: I. F. Atasoy, B. Mutlu, E. A. Sezer, A. Wahdan

entry.summary: Examines whether benchmarks underestimate LLM performance on hallucination detection by re-evaluating conflicted samples with human adjudication, finding 6-8% increases in agreement after resolving human annotation errors.

entry.title: PrepBench: How Far Are We from Natural-Language-Driven Data Preparation?

author.name: Jingzhe Xu, Rui Wang, Jiannan Wang, Guoliang Li

entry.summary: PrepBench benchmarks LLM-based agents for natural-language-driven data preparation, capturing real-world challenges like ambiguous user intents and imperfect data. Evaluates how far current agents are from replacing GUI-based data preparation tools.

entry.title: cuRegOT: A GPU-Accelerated Solver for Entropic-Regularized Optimal Transport

author.name: Yixuan Qiu

entry.summary: cuRegOT is a GPU-accelerated solver for entropic-regularized optimal transport that addresses the limitations of Sinkhorn on GPUs. Bridges the gap between convergence rate and GPU parallelism for large-scale OT problems.

entry.title: Towards Backdoor-Based Ownership Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ming Sun, Rui Wang, Xingrui Yu, Lihua Jing, Hangyu Du, Zhenglin Wan, Xu Pan, Ivor Tsang

entry.summary: GuardVLA is the first backdoor-based ownership verification framework for Vision-Language-Action models, embedding watermarks in embodied visual data with a swap-and-detect verification mechanism.

entry.title: Contextual Plackett-Luce: An Efficient Neural Model for Probabilistic Sequence Selection under Ambiguity

author.name: Noam Mizrachi, Nadav Har-Tuv, Shai Shalev-Shwartz

entry.summary: Contextual Plackett-Luce (CPL) extends classical Plackett-Luce to context-dependent sequence selection with Ising-style pairwise interactions, handling ambiguous targets where multiple valid outputs exist for each input.

entry.title: Improving Generalization by Permutation Routing Across Model Copies

author.name: Shuhei Kashiwamura, Timothee Leleu

entry.summary: Introduces M-cover transform for machine learning, replicating a model M times and rewiring contexts through permutation-based routing rather than parameter averaging. The mixing kernel Q defines a topology for message transport controlling exploration-exploitation tradeoff.

entry.title: Beyond Continuity: Challenges of Context Switching in Multi-Turn Dialogue with LLMs

author.name: Aditya Sinha, Harald Steck, Vito Ostuni, Matteo Rinaldi

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs handle topic shifts in multi-turn conversations, testing detection of pivots vs refinements and shortlisting relevant context. Evaluates 10 LLMs on synthetic benchmarks showing models often miss topic shifts and carry irrelevant context.

entry.title: Neural Information Causality

author.name: Jeongho Bang, Marcin Paw{\l}owski

entry.summary: Formalizes 'neural information causality' by embedding information causality into representation learning, showing that query-separated architectures induce communication experiments and obey specific information inequalities. Bridges quantum information theory with ML.

entry.title: When Few Steps Are Enough: Training-Free Acceleration of Identity-Preserved Generation

author.name: Dongqi Zheng

entry.summary: Shows that a frozen identity adapter trained for multi-step diffusion transfers directly to distilled backbone without retraining, achieving 5.9x speedup with improved identity similarity. Finds identity fidelity enters an effective regime within 4-8 steps.

entry.title: PhysHanDI: Physics-Based Reconstruction of Hand-Deformable Object Interactions

author.name: Jihyun Lee, Changmin Lee, Donghwan Kim, Tae-Kyun Kim

entry.summary: PhysHanDI enables full 3D reconstruction of hand-deformable object interactions by physically simulating object deformations driven by forces from reconstructed hand motions, handling non-rigid objects like cloth and stuffed animals.

entry.title: Causal Parametric Drift Simulation: A Digital Twin Framework for Classifier Robustness Evaluation

author.name: Julien Lafrance, Richard Khoury, V\'eronique Tremblay

entry.summary: Proposes using Structural Causal Models as 'Digital Twins' to stress-test classifiers against concept drift through causal interventions that preserve structural dependencies in tabular data.

entry.title: Learning Multi-Indicator Weights for Data Selection: A Joint Task-Model Adaptation Framework with Efficient Proxies

author.name: Jingze Song, Zihao Chen, Wenqing Chen, Zibin Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for learning multi-indicator weights for data selection in instruction tuning that jointly adapts to both downstream task and specific model capabilities using efficient proxies.

entry.title: Security Risks in Tool-Enabled AI Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Privileged Execution Environments

author.name: Hardik Goel

entry.summary: Presents a structured analysis of security risks in cloud-hosted tool-enabled AI agents with privileged execution environments, introducing a taxonomy of risk categories and mitigation strategies.

entry.title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective State Space Models

author.name: Taylan Soydan, Miguel A. Bessa, Dirk Mohr, Rui Barreira

entry.summary: Proposes TIDES, a selective state space model variant that reconciles selective and continuous SSM architectures by moving input-dependence off the step size onto diagonal state matrices, enabling better irregular time series modeling.

entry.title: Continuous Latent Contexts Enable Efficient Online Learning in Transformers

author.name: Emile Anand, Abdullah Ateyeh, Xinyuan Cao, Max Dabagia

entry.summary: Studies whether continuous latent context tokens enable transformers to more effectively perform online learning, motivated by continuous transformer architectures with latent chain of thought.

entry.title: Combining Mechanical and Agentic Specification Inference for Move

author.name: Wolfgang Grieskamp, Teng Zhang, Vineeth Kashyap

entry.summary: Describes early work combining weakest-precondition analysis with agentic coding CLI (Claude Code) for specification inference in the Move Prover, using AI for loop invariants where mechanical analysis is weakest.

entry.title: Guided Streaming Stochastic Interpolant Policy

author.name: Puming Jiang, Meiyi Wang, Kelvin Lin, Ce Hao, Harold Soh

entry.summary: Derives optimal guidance for Stochastic Interpolants in real-time robot control via the Backward Kolmogorov Equation, applying it to Streaming Stochastic Interpolant Policy for test-time preference alignment and obstacle avoidance.

entry.title: Think as Needed: Geometry-Driven Adaptive Perception for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Donghyun Kim, Jaehyoung Park

entry.summary: Proposes Enhanced HOPE, an adaptive perception architecture for autonomous driving that measures geometric complexity of LiDAR frames and routes them through shallow or deep processing paths to save computation on simple scenes.

entry.title: MTA-RL: Robust Urban Driving via Multi-modal Transformer-based 3D Affordances and Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Guangli Chen, Dianzhao Li, Wenjian Zhong, Bangquan Xie, Ostap Okhrin

entry.summary: Proposes MTA-RL, combining multi-modal transformer-based 3D affordance prediction with reinforcement learning for autonomous driving, bridging perception and control through interpretable intermediate representations.

entry.title: HeteroGenManip: Generalizable Manipulation For Heterogeneous Object Interactions

author.name: Zhenhao Shen, Zeming Yang, Yue Chen, Yuran Wang, Shengqiang Xu, Mingleyang Li, Hao Dong, Ruihai Wu

entry.summary: Proposes HeteroGenManip, a framework for generalizable robotic manipulation involving heterogeneous object interactions, decomposing the problem into contact point localization and trajectory planning with category-specific models.

entry.title: RW-Post: Auditable Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Fact-Checking in the Wild

author.name: Danni Xu, Shaojing Fan, Harry Cheng, Mohan Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Introduces RW-Post, a multimodal fact-checking benchmark with auditable annotations linking social media posts to evidence items via reasoning traces, supporting evaluation across closed-book and open-web regimes.

entry.title: Real vs. Semi-Simulated: Rethinking Evaluation for Treatment Effect Estimation

author.name: George Panagopoulos

entry.summary: Conducts large-scale empirical study comparing treatment effect evaluation in semi-simulated benchmarks vs. real-world applications, systematically examining the gap between methodological progress and practical deployment.

entry.title: DuetFair: Coupling Inter- and Intra-Subgroup Robustness for Fair Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Yiqi Tian, Sangjoon Park, Bo Zeng, Pengfei Jin, Yujin Oh, Quanzheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes DuetFair for medical image segmentation fairness, jointly addressing inter-subgroup performance gaps and intra-subgroup hidden failures using mixture-of-experts and distributionally robust optimization.

entry.title: Training-Free Cultural Alignment of Large Language Models via Persona Disagreement

author.name: Huynh Trung Kiet, Dao Sy Duy Minh, Tuan Nguyen, Chi-Nguyen Tran, Phu-Hoa Pham, Nguyen Lam Phu Quy, The Anh Han, Long Tran-Thanh

entry.summary: Proposes DISCA, a training-free cultural alignment method for LLMs that uses within-country sociodemographic disagreement as the primary steering signal via World Values Survey-grounded persona panels at inference time.

entry.title: Interactive Inverse Reinforcement Learning of Interaction Scenarios via Bi-level Optimization

author.name: Yue Mao, Shicheng Liu, Siyuan Xu, Minghui Zhu

entry.summary: Studies interactive inverse reinforcement learning where the learner actively interacts with the expert during learning, formulated as stochastic bi-level optimization.

entry.title: Quantitative Sobolev Approximation Bounds for Neural Operators with Empirical Validation on Burgers Equation

author.name: Nicole Hao

entry.summary: Derives quantitative Sobolev approximation bounds for neural operators and validates them empirically on FNOs solving Burgers equation, connecting functional analysis theory with practical performance.

entry.title: Synergistic Simplex: Cooperative Runtime Assurance for Safety-Critical Autonomous Systems

author.name: Ayoosh Bansal, Mikael Yeghiazaryan, Artyom Khachatryan, Tianyi Zhu, Hunmin Kim, Naira Hovakimyan, Lui Sha

entry.summary: Proposes Synergistic Simplex architecture for safety-critical autonomous systems that enables bidirectional integration between ML components and safety monitors while preserving formal guarantees.

entry.title: Exactness Matters for Physical Rule Enforcement

author.name: Bum Jun Kim

entry.summary: Studies when physical constraint enforcement helps vs. hurts in autoregressive forecasting through the lens of operator exactness, comparing repair strategies across different PDE settings.

entry.title: Reflective Prompted Policy Optimization: Trajectory-Grounded Revision and Salience Bias

author.name: Rahaf Abu Hara, Vaibbhav Murarri, Claudio Zito

entry.summary: Proposes R2PO, a two-stage LLM framework for policy optimization that augments scalar rewards with trajectory-level behavioral evidence, separating search and critique functions.

entry.title: FLUX: Geometry-Aware Longitudinal Flow Matching with Mixture of Experts

author.name: Josue Ortega Caro, Yongxu Zhang, Hannah M Batchelor, Sizhuang He, Jessica Cardin, Shreya Saxena

entry.summary: Introduces FLUX, a geometry-aware longitudinal flow matching method with mixture of experts for biological systems that evolve through regime-switching dynamics observed as unpaired snapshots.

entry.title: The Global Empirical NTK: Self-Referential Bias and Dimensionality of Gradient Descent Learning

author.name: James Hazelden, Laura Driscoll, Eli Shlizerman, Eric Shea-Brown

entry.summary: Defines and studies the Global Empirical NTK for finite-width networks, decomposing it into parameter-to-state and state-to-state operators, revealing self-referential bias in training dynamics.

entry.title: The Wristband Gaussian Loss: Deterministic, Composable Latents via a Sphere-Interval Decomposition

author.name: Mikhail Parakhin, Andr\'e M. Carvalho, Patrick Haluptzok

entry.summary: Presents the Wristband Gaussian Loss, a deterministic batch loss for Gaussianizing embeddings without sampling or KL terms, using a sphere-interval decomposition with proofs verified in Lean 4.

entry.title: Anchoring the Eigengap: Cross-Modal Spectral Stabilization for Sample-Efficient Representation Learning

author.name: Nikhil J. Dhinagar, Vidhi Chhatbar, Chirag Jagad, Pavithra Senthilkumar, Sophia I. Thomopoulos, Mahir H. Khan, Sook-Lei Liew, the ENIGMA-Stroke Recovery Working Group, Paul M. Thompson

entry.summary: Proposes cross-modal spectral stabilization for sample-efficient representation learning in medical imaging, using perturbation theory to quantify recoverable eigenmodes and anchoring the eigengap via cross-modal regularization.

entry.title: PRIM: Meta-Learned Bayesian Root Cause Analysis

author.name: Christopher Lohse, Anish Dhir, Amadou Ba, Bradley Eck, Marco Ruffini, Jonas Wahl

entry.summary: Introduces PRIM, a causal meta-learning approach for root cause analysis that frames RCA as Bayesian inference over synthetic causal models, avoiding explicit structure learning at test time.

entry.title: Compact SO(3) Equivariant Atomistic Foundation Models via Structural Pruning

author.name: Chen Wang, Siyu Hu, Guangming Tan, Weile Jia

entry.summary: Proposes structural pruning for SO(3) equivariant atomistic foundation models that preserves equivariance by pruning complete irreducible representation blocks along channel and order dimensions.

entry.title: When More Parameters Hurt: Foundation Model Priors Amplify Worst-Client Disparity Under Extreme Federated Heterogeneity

author.name: Kiran Naseer, Umar Shoaib

entry.summary: Reveals that foundation model priors can hurt worst-performing clients in federated learning under extreme data heterogeneity. DistilBERT+LoRA shows 56% larger worst-client accuracy gap compared to smaller TextCNN under extreme label skew.

entry.title: Predicting Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning: A Theoretical Perspective

author.name: Jiuqi Wang, Jayanth Srinivasa, Claire Chen, Shuze Daniel Liu, Ali Payani, Shangtong Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates whether existing diagnostics can predict neural network plasticity (ability to learn new tasks) in continual learning. Shows via counterexamples that some widely-adopted diagnostics fail, and proposes gradient-norm-based predictors that succeed.

entry.title: TileQ: Efficient Low-Rank Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with 2D Tiling

author.name: Hongyaoxing Gu, Xinzhe Chen, Lijuan Hu, Fangfang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes TileQ, a post-training quantization method for MoE models using 2D-tiling to share low-rank factors across expert dimensions. Achieves efficient inference by fusing multiple expert computations.

entry.title: Discrete Langevin-Inspired Posterior Sampling

author.name: Chaitanya Amballa, Sattwik Basu, Jorge Van\v{c}o Sampedro, Romit Roy Choudhury

entry.summary: Proposes ΔLPS, a discrete Langevin-inspired posterior sampler for inverse problems with discrete diffusion priors. Uses gradient information for efficient parallel token updates without leaving discrete space.

entry.title: Near-Optimal Last-Iterate Convergence for Zero-Sum Games with Bandit Feedback and Opponent Actions

author.name: Soumita Hait, Ping Li, Haipeng Luo, Mengxiao Zhang

entry.summary: Proves near-optimal last-iterate convergence rates for zero-sum games with bandit feedback when opponent actions are also observed. Shows this additional information enables faster convergence than pure bandit settings.

entry.title: SEMASIA: A Large-Scale Dataset of Semantically Structured Latent Representations

author.name: Mario Edoardo Pandolfo, Enrico Grimaldi, Lorenzo Marinucci, Leonardo Di Nino, Simone Fiorellino, Sergio Barbarossa, Paolo Di Lorenzo

entry.summary: Introduces SEMASIA, a large-scale dataset of ~1,700 latent representations from diverse models for studying latent space alignment across architectures, training objectives, and random seeds.

entry.title: Dystruct: Dynamically Structured Diffusion Language Model Decoding via Bayesian Inference

author.name: Bian Sun, Kevin Zhai, Mubarak Shah, Zhenyi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Dystruct, a method enabling diffusion language models to generate variable-length sequences using Bayesian inference for dynamic structure determination during decoding, overcoming the fixed-length limitation of existing DLMs.

entry.title: TopoU-Net: a U-Net architecture for topological domains

author.name: Gaurav Gaurav, Ibrahem ALJabea, Yaroslav Zakomornyy, Eric Frank, Mohamed Elhamdadi, Theodore Papamarkou, Mustafa Hajij

entry.summary: Introduces TopoU-Net, extending the U-Net encoder-decoder principle to topological domains (combinatorial complexes), enabling hierarchical processing of data with higher-order structure beyond grids, graphs, or sequences.

entry.title: Fix the Loss, Not the Radius: Rethinking the Adversarial Perturbation of Sharpness-Aware Minimization

author.name: Jinping Wang, Qinhan Liu, Zhiwu Xie, Zhiqiang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes Loss-Equated SAM (LE-SAM) that inverts the traditional SAM mechanism by fixing loss-space budget instead of perturbation radius, shifting optimization toward curvature-dominated terms for better generalization.

entry.title: Valid Best-Model Identification for LLM Evaluation via Low-Rank Factorization

author.name: Elad Tolochinsky, Yaniv Tenzer, Yaniv Romano

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining multi-armed bandits with low-rank factorization for efficient LLM benchmark evaluation, with statistical guarantees against incorrect best-model identification from predicted scores.

entry.title: Don't Fix the Basis -- Learn It: Spectral Representation with Adaptive Basis Learning for PDEs

author.name: Xuxiang Zhao, Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero

entry.summary: Proposes ABLE, a framework learning data-dependent spectral bases for neural operators instead of fixed Fourier bases, constructing spatially adaptive Parseval frames while maintaining O(N log N) complexity.

entry.title: SlimSpec: Low-Rank Draft LM-Head for Accelerated Speculative Decoding

author.name: Anton Plaksin, Sergei Krutikov, Sergei Skvortsov, Alexander Samarin

entry.summary: Proposes SlimSpec, a low-rank parameterization of the draft model's LM-head for speculative decoding that reduces the vocabulary projection bottleneck without vocabulary truncation or complex inference logic.

entry.title: MulTaBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Tabular Learning with Text and Image

author.name: Alan Arazi, Eilam Shapira, Shoham Grunblat, Mor Ventura, Elad Hoffer, Gioia Blayer, David Holzm\"uller, Lennart Purucker, Ga\"el Varoquaux, Frank Hutter, Roi Reichart

entry.summary: Introduces MulTaBench, a benchmark of 40 datasets for evaluating multimodal tabular learning with text and image data, showing that tuning embeddings to the task improves performance over frozen pretrained embeddings. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks that focus on mere co-occurrence of modalities.

entry.title: Why Zeroth-Order Adaptation May Forget Less: A Randomized Shaping Theory

author.name: Yao Shu, Jian Mu, Zhongxiang Dai

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis explaining why zeroth-order optimization methods forget less in continual learning compared to first-order methods. Shows that the advantage comes from how ZO gradient shaping interacts with retention curvature, not merely from noise.

entry.title: Kernel-Gradient Drifting Models

author.name: Maria Esteban-Casadevall, Jorge Carrasco-Pollo, Max Welling, Jan-Willem van de Meent, Erik J. Bekkers, Floor Eijkelboom

entry.summary: Proposes kernel-gradient drifting, a one-step generative modeling framework that generalizes drifting models beyond Gaussian kernels by using kernel-induced directions. Shows the drift equals the score difference between kernel-smoothed distributions, providing identifiability for characteristic kernels.

entry.title: Optimal and Scalable MAPF via Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport and Schr\"odinger Bridges

author.name: Usman A. Khan, Joseph W. Durham

entry.summary: Casts anonymous multi-agent path finding as multi-marginal optimal transport, showing it collapses to a polynomial-size linear program under Markovian structure. Uses Schrödinger bridges for scalability to large problems.

entry.title: DECO: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts with Dense-Comparable Performance on End-Side Devices

author.name: Chenyang Song, Weilin Zhao, Xu Han, Chaojun Xiao, Yingfa Chen, Zhiyuan Liu

entry.summary: Presents DECO, a sparse MoE architecture designed to match dense transformer performance under identical total parameter budgets using ReLU-based routing with learnable expert-wise scaling. Introduces NormSiLU activation for improved expert contribution balancing.

entry.title: On Observation Time for Recovering Latent Hawkes Networks

author.name: Jonas Linkerh\"agner, Michele Bortolasi, Lorenzo Baldassari, Maarten V. de Hoop, Ivan Dokmani\'c

entry.summary: Proves that the minimum observation time for exact recovery of latent Hawkes network structure is O(log d) where d is the number of entities, for sparse weak interactions. Establishes information-theoretic lower bounds matching the achievable upper bound.

entry.title: Sliced Inner Product Gromov-Wasserstein Distances

author.name: Xiaoyun Gong, Gabriel Rioux, Ziv Goldfeld

entry.summary: Proposes sliced inner-product Gromov-Wasserstein (IGW) distances with closed-form solutions in 1D, enjoying rotational invariance and computational scalability for high-dimensional heterogeneous dataset alignment.

entry.title: Beyond the All-in-One Agent: Benchmarking Role-Specialized Multi-Agent Collaboration in Enterprise Workflows

author.name: Tao Yu, Hao Wang, Changyu Li, Shenghua Chai, Minghui Zhang, Zhongtian Luo, Yuxuan Zhou, Haopeng Jin, Zhaolu Kang, Jiabing Yang, YiFan Zhang, Xinming Wang, Hongzhu Yi, Zheqi He, Jing-Shu Zheng, Xi Yang, Yan Huang, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces EntCollabBench, a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent LLM collaboration in enterprise environments with role specialization, access control, and permission-isolated organizations across 11 agents and 6 departments.

entry.title: Local LMO: Constrained Gradient Optimization via a Local Linear Minimization Oracle

author.name: Peter Richt\'arik, Kaja Gruntkowska, Hanmin Li

entry.summary: Proposes Local LMO, a projection-free optimization method replacing the global linear minimization oracle in Frank-Wolfe with a local oracle over the constraint set intersected with a small ball, bridging FW and projected gradient methods.

entry.title: Optimality of Sub-network Laplace Approximations: New Results and Methods

author.name: Swarnali Raha, Kshitij Khare, Rohit K Patra

entry.summary: Provides rigorous theoretical analysis of sub-network Laplace approximations, proving optimal subset selection via D-optimal design and proposing practical algorithms with formal guarantees.

entry.title: LagrangianSplats: Divergence-Free Transport of Gaussian Primitives for Fluid Reconstruction

author.name: Ningxiao Tao, Baoquan Chen, Mengyu Chu

entry.summary: Introduces LagrangianSplats for 3D fluid reconstruction from sparse video, combining divergence-free kernel velocity representation with Lagrangian 3D Gaussian Splatting to structurally enforce incompressibility and transport coherence.

entry.title: TD3B: Transition-Directed Discrete Diffusion for Allosteric Binder Generation

author.name: Hanqun Cao, Aastha Pal, Sophia Tang, Yinuo Zhang, Jingjie Zhang, Pheng Ann Heng, Pranam Chatterjee

entry.summary: Introduces TD3B, a sequence-based generative framework for designing allosteric binders with specified agonist/antagonist behavior for GPCRs using transition-directed discrete diffusion.

entry.title: A Stability Benchmark of Generative Regularizers for Inverse Problems

author.name: Alexander Denker, Johannes Hertrich, Sebastian Neumayer

entry.summary: Benchmarks the stability of generative (diffusion) priors for inverse problems in imaging against classical optimization-based methods. Evaluates convergent regularization, robustness to OOD data, and sensitivity to forward model inaccuracies.

entry.title: Scalable Gaussian process inference via neural feature maps

author.name: Anthony Stephenson

entry.summary: Presents a Gaussian process framework using neural feature maps for kernel construction, with theoretical guarantees including consistency of GP posteriors and spectral analysis. Introduces product feature-map kernels to address oversmoothing.

entry.title: Reflections and New Directions for Human-Centered Large Language Models

author.name: Caleb Ziems, Dora Zhao, Rose E. Wang, Matthew J\"orke, Ahmad Rushdi, Advit Deepak, Sunny Yu, Anshika Agarwal, Harshvardhan Agarwal, Gabriela Aranguiz-Dias, Aditri Bhagirath, Justine Breuch, Huanxing Chen, Ruishi Chen, Sarah Chen, Haocheng Fan, William Fang, Cat Gonzales Fergesen, Daniel Frees, Tian Gao, Ziqing Huang, Vishal Jain, Yucheng Jiang, Kirill Kalinin, Su Doga Karaca, Arpandeep Khatua, Teland La, Isabelle Levent, Miranda Li, Xinling Li, Yongce Li, Angela Liu, Minsik Oh, Nathan J. Paek, Anthony Qin, Emily Redmond, Michael J. Ryan, Aadesh Salecha, Xiaoxian Shen, Pranava Singhal, Shashanka Subrahmanya, Mei Tan, Irawadee Thawornbut, Michelle Vinocour, Xiaoyue Wang, Zheng Wang, Henry Jin Weng, Pawan Wirawarn, Shirley Wu, Sophie Wu, Yichen Xie, Patrick Ye, Sean Zhang, Yutong Zhang, Cathy Zhou, Yiling Zhao, James Landay, Diyi Yang

entry.summary: Presents a framework for Human-Centered LLMs integrating NLP, HCI, and responsible AI perspectives, addressing ethics, economics, and technical objectives across applications in healthcare, education, law, and science.

entry.title: GSM-SEM: Benchmark and Framework for Generating Semantically Variant Augmentations

author.name: Jyotika Singh, Fang Tu, Aziza Mirzadova, Amit Agarwal, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Sandip Ghoshal, Miguel Ballesteros, Yassine Benajiba, Weiyi Sun, Graham Horwood, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Introduces GSM-SEM, a stochastic framework for generating semantically diverse benchmark variants of GSM8K that modify entities, attributes, and relationships rather than just surface-level features, requiring models to recompute solutions.

entry.title: Securing Computer-Use Agents: A Unified Architecture-Lifecycle Framework for Deployment-Grounded Reliability

author.name: Zejian Chen, Zhanyuan Liu, Chaozhuo Li, Mengxiang Han, Songyang Liu, Litian Zhang, Feng Gao, Yiming Hei, Xi Zhang

entry.summary: Develops an architecture-lifecycle framework for securing computer-use agents deployed in real software environments, connecting capability formation, authority exposure, failure manifestation, and control placement.

entry.title: Topology-Enhanced Alignment for Large Language Models: Trajectory Topology Loss and Topological Preference Optimization

author.name: Yurui Pan, Ke Xu, Bo Peng

entry.summary: Proposes topology-enhanced LLM alignment using persistent homology, introducing Trajectory Topology Loss for SFT (aligning with topological bridges in embedding space) and Topological Preference Optimization for DPO.

entry.title: The Proxy Presumption: From Semantic Embeddings to Valid Social Measures

author.name: Baishi Li, Ta Yu, Kelvin J. L. Koa, Ke-Wei Huang

entry.summary: Identifies the 'Proxy Presumption' problem where researchers use embedding geometric properties as direct measures of social constructs without validation. Proposes a Construct Validity Protocol (CVP) to bridge embeddings and valid social measures.

entry.title: DRIP-R: A Benchmark for Decision-Making and Reasoning Under Real-World Policy Ambiguity in the Retail Domain

author.name: Hsuvas Borkakoty, Sebastian Pohl, Cheng Wang, Bei Chen, Yufang Hou

entry.summary: Introduces DRIP-R, a benchmark exploiting real-world retail policy ambiguities where no single correct resolution exists, testing LLM agents on consequential decisions under genuine policy uncertainty with customer personas and multi-judge evaluation.

entry.title: Chain-based Distillation for Effective Initialization of Variable-Sized Small Language Models

author.name: Boyu Shi, YiCheng Jiang, Chang Liu, Qiufeng Wang, Xu Yang, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes Chain-based Distillation (CBD) for efficiently initializing variable-sized small language models through a distillation chain of intermediate anchors, avoiding repeated access to large teachers for different target sizes.

entry.title: PolySQL: Scaling Text-to-SQL Evaluation Across SQL Dialects via Automated Backend Isomorphism

author.name: Yotam Perlitz, Elad Venezian, Corentin Royer, Francesco Fusco, Andrea Giovannini

entry.summary: Introduces PolySQL, a dual-execution method for evaluating Text-to-SQL across multiple SQL dialects without query transpilation, by comparing normalized execution results. Shows SQLite performance is unreliable proxy for other dialects.

entry.title: SCENE: Recognizing Social Norms and Sanctioning in Group Chats

author.name: Mateusz Jacniacki, Maksymilian Bilski

entry.summary: Introduces SCENE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to recognize and adapt to implicit social norms in multi-party chat, measuring responsiveness to sanctioning and norm adaptation from peers.

entry.title: When Does a Language Model Commit? A Finite-Answer Theory of Pre-Verbalization Commitment

author.name: Long Zhang, Wei-neng Chen, Feng-feng Wei, Zi-bo Qin

entry.summary: Studies when language models commit to answers during reasoning by defining finite-answer preference stabilization through log-odds codes. Introduces parser-based answer onset and retrospective stabilization time metrics.

entry.title: MEMOREPAIR: Barrier-First Cascade Repair in Agentic Memory

author.name: Yang Zhao, Chengxiao Dai, Mengying Kou, Yue Xiu

entry.summary: Formalizes the cascade update problem in agentic memory systems where derived artifacts become stale after source changes. Presents MemoRepair, a barrier-first cascade-repair contract that ensures consistent memory state through controlled transitions.

entry.title: SYNCR: A Cross-Video Reasoning Benchmark with Synthetic Grounding

author.name: Sara Ghazanfari, Siddharth Garg, Prashanth Krishnamurthy, Farshad Khorrami

entry.summary: Introduces SYNCR, a controlled synthetic benchmark for cross-video reasoning with programmatically verified grounding, containing 8,163 multi-video QA pairs evaluating MLLMs across eight tasks in four diagnostic pillars.

entry.title: FlowADMM: Plug-and-play ADMM with Flow-based Renoise-Denoise Priors

author.name: Hendrik Sommerhoff, Michael Moeller

entry.summary: Proposes FlowADMM, identifying and formalizing the deterministic renoise-denoise operator in flow-based plug-and-play methods, enabling convergence analysis and integration into ADMM framework.

entry.title: Probability-Flow Distillation: Exact Wasserstein Gradient Flow for High-Fidelity 3D Generation

author.name: Rohith Ramanan, A. N. Rajagopalan

entry.summary: Probability-Flow Distillation addresses mode collapse in SDS-based text-to-3D generation by showing the bottleneck is the posterior mean estimator's single-step Euler approximation. Proposes exact Wasserstein gradient flow for higher fidelity.

entry.title: DeformMaster: An Interactive Physics-Neural World Model for Deformable Objects from Videos

author.name: Can Li, Zhoujian Li, Ren Li, Jie Gu, Lei Lei, Jingmin Chen, Lei Sun

entry.summary: DeformMaster presents a video-derived interactive physics-neural world model for deformable objects that recovers geometry, appearance, physical dynamics, and material behavior from real interaction videos.

entry.title: From Pixels to Concepts: Do Segmentation Models Understand What They Segment?

author.name: Shuang Liang, Zeqing Wang, Yuxian Li, Xihui Liu, Han Wang

entry.summary: CAFE benchmark evaluates whether promptable segmentation models (like SAM3) truly understand queried concepts or rely on visually salient but semantically misleading cues, using counterfactual attribute factuality evaluation.

entry.title: EchoPrune: Interpreting Redundancy as Temporal Echoes for Efficient VideoLLMs

author.name: Jiameng Li, Minye Wu, Jiezhang Cao, Aleksei Tiulpin, Matthew B. Blaschko

entry.summary: EchoPrune interprets redundant video tokens as 'temporal echoes' (tokens reconstructable from past frames) and prunes them training-free, improving temporal resolution for VideoLLMs under fixed token budgets.

entry.title: Thermal-Det: Language-Guided Cross-Modal Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Thermal Object Detection

author.name: Yasiru Ranasinghe, Elim Schenck, Florence Yellin, Shuowen Hu, Christopher Funk, Vishal M. Patel

entry.summary: Thermal-Det is the first LLM-supervised open-vocabulary detector for thermal images, using a synthetic thermal dataset converted from GroundingCap-1M with cross-modal distillation from RGB teacher.

entry.title: V-ABS: Action-Observer Driven Beam Search for Dynamic Visual Reasoning

author.name: Zhiwei Ning, Xuanang Gao, Jiaxi Cao, Gengming Zhang, Shengnan Ma, Wenwen Tong, Hanming Deng, Jie Yang, Wei Liu

entry.summary: V-ABS introduces an action-observer driven beam search framework for dynamic visual reasoning in MLLMs, addressing the imagination-action-observer bias through entropy-based adaptive weighting.

entry.title: AdaptSplat: Adapting Vision Foundation Models for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Mingwei Xing, Xinliang Wang, Yifeng Shi

entry.summary: AdaptSplat demonstrates that a single 1.5M-parameter adapter added to vision foundation models achieves strong cross-domain generalization for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting without complex architecture engineering.

entry.title: Adaptive Context Matters: Towards Provable Multi-Modality Guidance for Super-Resolution

author.name: Jinyi Luo, Minghao Liu, Yifan Li, Zejia Fan, Jiaying Liu

entry.summary: This work provides the first theoretical modeling of multi-modal super-resolution, showing that prior methods are bottlenecked by sub-optimal modality utilization and proposing adaptive context-aware fusion.

entry.title: VeloGauss: Learning Physically Consistent Gaussian Velocity Fields from Videos

author.name: Nengbo Lu, Bin Zhao

entry.summary: VeloGauss learns physical velocity fields from dynamic multi-view videos without physical priors, correctly modeling interaction mechanisms between rigid and non-rigid particles through Gaussian representations.

entry.title: CausalGS: Learning Physical Causality of 3D Dynamic Scenes with Gaussian Representations

author.name: Nengbo Lu, Minghua Pan

entry.summary: CausalGS learns causal dynamics of 3D scenes from multi-view videos without explicit priors, using an inverse physics inference module to decouple complex dynamics and model rigid/non-rigid interactions.

entry.title: A Theory of Multilevel Interactive Equilibrium in NeuroAI

author.name: Zhe Sage Chen, Quanyan Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Multilevel Interactive Equilibrium theory extending game theory to NeuroAI systems with internal computation, partial observability, bounded computation, and uncertainty—where equilibrium emerges across neural, cognitive, and behavioral levels.

entry.title: Trajectory-Consistent Flow Matching for Robust Visuomotor Policy Learning

author.name: Riad Ahmed, Sujosh Nag, Moniruzzaman Akash, Mostafa Hussein, Momotaz Begum

entry.summary: Proposes four complementary remedies for flow matching policies in robot manipulation: auxiliary rectified flow regression, multi-step trajectory consistency training, velocity field regularization, and adaptive step scheduling to close the train-inference gap.

entry.title: ATAAT: Adaptive Threat-Aware Adversarial Tuning Framework against Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Kewei Chen, Yayu Long, Shuai Li, Mingsheng Shang

entry.summary: ATAAT investigates backdoor attacks on VLA models' visual pathway, identifying 'Gradient Interference' as the core failure mechanism of traditional attacks, and proposes an adaptive framework that selects optimal gradient decoupling strategies.

entry.title: Drift is a Sampling Error: SNR-Aware Power Distributions for Long-Horizon Robotic Planning

author.name: Kewei Chen, Yayu Long, Mingsheng Shang

entry.summary: Reconceptualizes instruction drift in VLA models as systematic sampling error, identifying 'Negative Pivotal Windows' as irreversible local optima, and proposes Context-Aware Power Sampling for training-free inference-time improvement.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Learning: A Dexterous Manipulation Study on Reactive Catching

author.name: Kejia Ren, Gaotian Wang, Andrew S. Morgan, Kaiyu Hang

entry.summary: Proposes Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) for sim-to-real transfer in dexterous manipulation, propagating multiple randomized instances simultaneously to provide richer approximation of uncertain dynamics. Demonstrated on reactive catching.

entry.title: Dynamic Skill Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Junhao Shen, Teng Zhang, Xiaoyan Zhao, Hong Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes SLIM, a dynamic skill lifecycle management framework for LLM agents that treats the active external skill set as a dynamic optimization variable during RL, allowing non-monotonic skill adoption and retirement based on task stage.

entry.title: Alignment as Jurisprudence

author.name: Nicholas Caputo

entry.summary: Draws parallels between AI alignment and jurisprudence (the study of how judges should decide cases), arguing both fields share the fundamental challenge of constraining powerful decision-makers through language specification.

entry.title: DiagnosticIQ: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Industrial Maintenance Action Recommendation from Symbolic Rules

author.name: Devin Yasith De Silva, Dhaval Patel, Christodoulos Constantinides, Shuxin Lin, Nianjun Zhou, Paul J Adams, Sal Rosato, Nicolas Constantinides, Deborah L. McGuinness, Jayant Kalagnanam

entry.summary: Introduces DiagnosticIQ, a benchmark of 6,690 expert-validated questions from 118 rule-action pairs across 16 industrial asset types for evaluating LLMs on maintenance action recommendation from symbolic rules.

entry.title: EquiMem: Calibrating Shared Memory in Multi-Agent Debate via Game-Theoretic Equilibrium

author.name: Yuqiao Meng, Sakshi Sunil Narvekar, Luoxi Tang, Rupali Rajendra Vaje, Yingxue Zhang, Muchao Ye, Zhaohan Xi

entry.summary: Proposes EquiMem, a game-theoretic approach to calibrating shared memory in multi-agent debate systems. Formulates memory updating as a zero-trust memory game where equilibrium indicates optimal memory trust.

entry.title: CHAINTRIX: A multi-pipeline LLM-augmented framework for automated smart-contract security auditing

author.name: Gabriela Dobrita, Simona-Vasilica Oprea, Adela Bara

entry.summary: Proposes CHAINTRIX, an LLM-augmented framework for smart contract security auditing where every LLM-generated claim must be verified against a deterministic structural contract representation. Introduces Cross-Contract Interaction Model.

entry.title: Attribution-based Explanations for Markov Decision Processes

author.name: Paul Kobialka, Andrea Pferscher, Francesco Leofante, Erika \'Abrah\'am, Silvia Lizeth Tapia Tarifa, Einar Broch Johnsen

entry.summary: Introduces attribution-based explanations for Markov Decision Processes, formalizing what attributions should represent in sequential decision-making and showing how to compute importance scores for states and execution paths.

entry.title: HAGE: Harnessing Agentic Memory via RL-Driven Weighted Graph Evolution

author.name: Dongming Jiang, Yi Li, Guanpeng Li, Qiannan Li, Bingzhe Li

entry.summary: Proposes HAGE, a weighted multi-relational memory framework for LLM agents that uses RL-driven graph evolution with query-conditioned traversal for memory retrieval.

entry.title: Learning the Interaction Prior for Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction: A Model-Agnostic Approach

author.name: Ziqi Gao, Chenyi Zi, Zijing Liu, Ziqiao Meng, Yu Li, Jia Li

entry.summary: Proposes L3-PPI, a biologically informed protein-protein interaction classifier based on the L3 rule (length-3 paths indicate interaction likelihood). Uses graph prompt learning with L3-path regularization.

entry.title: GuardAD: Safeguarding Autonomous Driving MLLMs via Markovian Safety Logic

author.name: Tianyuan Zhang, Peng Yue, Zihao Peng, Jiangfan Liu, Zonghao Ying, Jiakai Wang, Tianlin Li, Jian Yang, Yaodong Yang, Aishan Liu, Xianglong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes GuardAD, a model-agnostic safeguard for autonomous driving MLLMs that formulates safety as an evolving Markovian logical state. Uses neuro-symbolic logic to reason about temporal safety over dynamic traffic interactions.

entry.title: SkillEvolver: Skill Learning as a Meta-Skill

author.name: Genrui Zhang, Erle Zhu, Jinfeng Zhou, Caiyan Jia, Hongning Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SkillEvolver, a lightweight framework where a meta-skill iteratively authors, deploys, and refines domain-specific skills as prose and code. Skills are learned online without retraining and can be dropped into any agent.

entry.title: Budget-Efficient Automatic Algorithm Design via Code Graph

author.name: Maxime Bouscary, Manxi Wu, Saurabh Amin

entry.summary: Proposes a DAG representation of algorithms for budget-efficient automatic algorithm design. Uses LLMs to generate compact corrections (add/replace/remove code blocks) rather than rewriting full algorithms, improving search efficiency.

entry.title: The Open-Box Fallacy: Why AI Deployment Needs a Calibrated Verification Regime

author.name: Phongsakon Mark Konrad, Tim Lukas Adam, Ane Cathrine Holst Merrild, Riccardo Terrenzi, Rebecca De Rosa, Toygar Tanyel, Serkan Ayvaz

entry.summary: Argues against the 'open-box fallacy' - the assumption that AI deployment requires full mechanistic interpretability. Proposes calibrated verification as an alternative governance framework inspired by how societies govern opaque expertise.

entry.title: Navigating the Sea of LLM Evaluation: Investigating Bias in Toxicity Benchmarks

author.name: Regina Gugg, Selina Niederl\"ander, Andreas St\"ockl, Martin Flechl

entry.summary: Investigates biases in LLM toxicity benchmarks, finding significant discrepancies when evaluation setups are altered (e.g., task format changes). Shows that current benchmarks may give misleading safety assessments.

entry.title: VLADriver-RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Rui Zhao, Haofeng Hu, Zhenhai Gao, Jiaqiao Liu, Gao Fei

entry.summary: Proposes VLADriver-RAG, a retrieval-augmented framework for autonomous driving that uses spatiotemporal semantic graphs to abstract sensory inputs and retrieve relevant historical driving scenarios for improved planning.

entry.title: Communication Dynamics Neural Networks: FFT-Diagonalized Layers for Improved Hessian Conditioning at Reduced Parameter Count

author.name: Lurong Pan

entry.summary: Introduces CDLinear, a block-circulant linear layer using FFT diagonalization that achieves 1/B parameter reduction while improving Hessian conditioning, inspired by the Communication Dynamics framework from physics.

entry.title: Echo-LoRA: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Cross-Layer Representation Injection

author.name: Yihang Peng, Peng Jin, Jie Gong, Xingyuan Chen, Lingjiao Xu, Ning Su, Yan Ran

entry.summary: Proposes Echo-LoRA, which injects aggregated representations from deeper layers back into shallower layers during fine-tuning, enabling cross-layer information flow with minimal additional parameters.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Concept Learning for Object-centric Visual Reasoning

author.name: Sparsh Tiwari, Bettina Finzel, Gesina Schwalbe

entry.summary: Introduces weakly supervised concept learning for object-centric visual reasoning using slot-based architecture with VAE, competing with concept guidance on latent dimensions for symbol grounding without costly labels.

entry.title: SAFformer:Improving Spiking Transformer via Active Predictive Filtering

author.name: Zequan Xie, Weiming Zeng, Yunhua Chen, Sichang Ling, Tongyang Chen, Jinsheng Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes SAFformer, a spiking transformer using active predictive filtering inspired by the brain's predictive coding, suppressing predictable signals and focusing on salient visual features for energy efficiency.

entry.title: What If We Let Forecasting Forget? A Sparse Bottleneck for Cross-Variable Dependencies

author.name: Fan Zhang, Shiming Fan, Hua Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MS-FLOW, a sparse-bottleneck framework for multivariate time series forecasting that models inter-variable interactions as capacity-limited information flow, addressing spurious correlations and over-smoothing from dense channel interactions.

entry.title: SDG-MoE: Signed Debate Graph Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Stepan Kulibaba, Kirill Labzin, Artem Dzhalilov, Roman Pakhomov, Oleg Svidchenko, Alexander Gansnikov, Aleksei Shpilman

entry.summary: Proposes SDG-MoE, adding a lightweight iterative deliberation step among active experts in MoE models using signed interaction matrices, enabling expert communication before final aggregation.

entry.title: CDS4RAG: Cyclic Dual-Sequential Hyperparameter Optimization for RAG

author.name: Pengzhou Chen, Tao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes CDS4RAG, a cyclic dual-sequential framework for optimizing retriever and generator hyperparameters in RAG systems, distinguishing between the two component types for more efficient optimization.

entry.title: ZAYA1-VL-8B Technical Report

author.name: Hassan Shapourian, Kasra Hejazi, Olabode M. Sule, Beren Millidge

entry.summary: Presents ZAYA1-VL-8B, a compact MoE vision-language model with vision-specific LoRA adapters and bidirectional attention over image tokens, achieving competitive performance with larger models.

entry.title: Privacy-Aware Video Anomaly Detection through Orthogonal Subspace Projection

author.name: Lei Wang, Wenxiang Diao, Andrew Busch, Jun Zhou, Yongsheng Gao

entry.summary: Proposes an Orthogonal Projection Layer (OPL) for privacy-aware video anomaly detection that removes task-irrelevant information (especially facial attributes) while preserving anomaly-relevant cues like pose and motion. Introduces a privacy-aware evaluation framework for human-centered surveillance.

entry.title: REAP: Reinforcement-Learning End-to-End Autonomous Parking with Gaussian Splatting Simulator for Real2Sim2Real Transfer

author.name: Changze Li, Zhe Chen, Shaoyu Chen, Lisen Mu, Yijian Li, Yuelong Yu, Qian Zhang, Qing Su, Ming Yang, Tong Qin

entry.summary: REAP uses Gaussian Splatting to build a photorealistic parking simulator for Real2Sim2Real reinforcement learning transfer, enabling end-to-end autonomous parking that handles extreme scenarios like mechanical and dead-end parking slots.

entry.title: MeshFIM: Local Low-Poly Mesh Editing via Fill-in-the-Middle Autoregressive Generation

author.name: Dingdong Yang, Jian Liu, Biwen Lei, Haohan Weng, Zhuo Chen, Song Guo, Hao Richard Zhang, Ali Mahdavi Amiri, Chunchao Guo

entry.summary: MeshFIM introduces a Fill-in-the-Middle framework for local editing of autoregressive low-poly meshes, allowing targeted region regeneration while preserving surrounding context. Addresses boundary attachment, topological order, and overflow challenges.

entry.title: Benchmarking Compositional Generalisation for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials

author.name: Amir Masoud Nourollah, Irtaza Khalid, Stefano Leoni, Steven Schockaert

entry.summary: Proposes a benchmark for compositional generalization in machine learning interatomic potentials, testing whether models learn compositional chemistry structure or merely interpolate training patterns.

entry.title: Beyond Self-Play: Hierarchical Reasoning for Continuous Motion in Closed-Loop Traffic Simulation

author.name: Weifan Zhang, Xiaofeng Zhao, Adel Bazzi, Mingrui Li, Yifan Wei, Dengfeng Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical architecture for traffic simulation combining Stackelberg-style multi-agent RL for interaction reasoning with a low-level continuous motion module, going beyond self-play to capture socially aware driving behavior.

entry.title: Select-then-differentiate: Solving Bilevel Optimization with Manifold Lower-level Solution Sets

author.name: Saeed Masiha, Zebang Shen, Negar Kiyavash, Niao He

entry.summary: This paper studies optimistic bilevel optimization when the lower-level problem has a manifold of minimizers rather than a unique solution. It provides theoretical results showing differentiability only requires uniqueness of optimistic selection, and derives practical gradient formulas.

entry.title: Towards Robust Sequential Decomposition for Complex Image Editing

author.name: Zilai Zeng, Mingdeng Cao, Zijie Li, Xiaochen Lian, Yichun Shi, Peihao Zhu, Chen Sun, Peng Wang

entry.summary: Addresses complex image editing with multiple operations by analyzing editing behaviors to develop a robust sequential decomposition approach. Tackles the compounding error problem in sequential editing while avoiding single-turn parsing failures.

entry.title: SWIFT: Prompt-Adaptive Memory for Efficient Interactive Long Video Generation

author.name: Shanwen Tan, Hao Li, Jingtao Zhang, Xiaosong Jia, Xue Yang, Shaofeng Zhang, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: SWIFT presents a training-free framework for multi-prompt long-video generation with efficient semantic switching through prompt-adaptive memory management, enabling flexible transitions while preserving temporal coherence.

entry.title: RAwR: Role-Aware Rewiring via Approximate Equitable Partition

author.name: Riccardo Porcedda, Giuseppe Squillace, Bastian Epping, Andrea Vandin, Michael Schaub, Mirco Tribastone, Francesca Chiaromonte

entry.summary: RAwR introduces a graph rewiring framework using approximate equitable partitions to address oversquashing in GNNs. Augments input graphs with quotient graphs to accelerate communication between structurally equivalent nodes.

entry.title: Spectral Transformer Neural Processes

author.name: Xianhe Chen, Hao Chen, Yingzhen Li

entry.summary: Proposes Spectral Transformer Neural Processes (STNPs) that inject frequency-domain information into TNPs via a Spectral Aggregator, improving performance on periodic and quasi-periodic data.

entry.title: Any2Any 3D Diffusion Models with Knowledge Transfer: A Radiotherapy Planning Study

author.name: Yuhan Wang, Zihan Li, Han Liu, Simon Arberet, Martin Kraus, Yuyin Zhou, Florin-Cristian Ghesu, Dorin Comaniciu, Ali Kamen, Riqiang Gao

entry.summary: DiffKT3D leverages pretrained video diffusion models for 3D voxel-wise radiotherapy dose prediction with an Any2Any conditional paradigm supporting multiple clinical modalities without cross-attention.

entry.title: Distilling 3D Spatial Reasoning into a Lightweight Vision-Language Model with CoT

author.name: Alaa Asfour, Christopher Indris, Leihan Chen, Tejas Vyas, Guanghui Wang

entry.summary: Proposes distilling 3D spatial reasoning from a 7B teacher VLM to a 2.29B student model, achieving 8.7x lower latency with 54-72% performance retention. Introduces 'Hidden CoT' using learnable latent tokens as internal scratchpad.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Neuroevolution for Diverse LLM Generation: Quality-Diversity Optimization via Prompt Embedding Evolution

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Presents QD-LLM, which evolves prompt embeddings (~32K params) to steer frozen 70B+ LLMs within a Quality-Diversity optimization framework, addressing mode collapse in generation without model fine-tuning.

entry.title: Free Energy Manifold: Score-Based Inference for Hybrid Bayesian Networks

author.name: Cheol Young Park, Shou Matsumoto

entry.summary: Introduces Free Energy Manifold (FEM), a score-trained conditional energy model for inference in hybrid Bayesian networks with discrete and continuous variables, identifying and addressing the 'mode-bridge artifact'.

entry.title: PruneTIR: Inference-Time Tool Call Pruning for Effective yet Efficient Tool-Integrated Reasoning

author.name: Luan Zhang, Dandan Song, Zhijing Wu, Zhengyu Chen, Chen Zhang, Yuhang Tian, Huipeng Ma, Chenhao Li, Changzhi Zhou, Xudong Li, Shuhao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PruneTIR, an inference-time method to prune erroneous tool calls during LLM reasoning, observing that erroneous calls correlate with incorrect answers and can be pruned to boost performance without additional training.

entry.title: GLiNER2-PII: A Multilingual Model for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction

author.name: Urchade Zaratiana, Ash Lewis, George Hurn-Maloney

entry.summary: Presents GLiNER2-PII, a compact 0.3B model for detecting 42 types of personally identifiable information across multiple languages, trained on synthetic data generated to overcome privacy constraints.

entry.title: Adaptive Action Chunking via Multi-Chunk Q Value Estimation

author.name: Yongjae Shin, Jongseong Chae, Seongmin Kim, Jongeui Park, Youngchul Sung

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Action Chunking (ACH) for offline-to-online RL that dynamically modulates action chunk length during training and inference based on multi-chunk Q value estimation.

entry.title: Swarm Skills: A Portable, Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System Specification for Coordination Engineering

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Zhicheng Dou, Deyang Li, Jianjun Tao, Shuo Cheng, Ruifeng Shi, Fangchao Liu, Enrui Hu, Yangkai Ding, Hongbo Wang, Qi Ye, Xuefeng Jin, Zhangchun Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Swarm Skills, a portable specification extending Anthropic Skills standard with multi-agent semantics, enabling multi-agent workflows to be shared as distributable assets across systems.

entry.title: When Reviews Disagree: Fine-Grained Contradiction Analysis in Scientific Peer Reviews

author.name: Sandeep Kumar, Yash Kamdar, Abid Hossain, Bharti Kumari, Tanik Saikh, Asif Ekbal

entry.summary: Introduces RevCI, a dataset and fine-grained formulation for detecting contradictions in scientific peer reviews, identifying evidence spans and graded disagreement intensity rather than binary detection.

entry.title: One-Step Graph-Structured Neural Flows for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Classification

author.name: Mengzhou Gao, Kaiwei Wang, Pengfei Jiao

entry.summary: Proposes one-step Graph-Structured Neural Flows for irregular multivariate time series classification, introducing auxiliary-trajectory self-supervision strategies to model inter-variable interactions without iterative solvers.

entry.title: LeapTS: Rethinking Time Series Forecasting as Adaptive Multi-Horizon Scheduling

author.name: Sheng Pan, Ming Jin, Bo Du, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Introduces LeapTS, which reformulates time series forecasting as a dynamic scheduling process with hierarchical controllers that adaptively select prediction targets and determine step sizes.

entry.title: SCALAR: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Automated Conjecture and Reasoning in Quantum Circuit Analysis

author.name: Sean Feeney, Pooja Rao, Andreas Klappenecker, Reuben Tate, Yuri Alexeev, Stefano Mensa, Elica Kyoseva, Stephan Eidenbenz

entry.summary: Introduces SCALAR, a neurosymbolic framework combining quantum simulation, symbolic conjecture generation, and LLM interpretation for automated conjecture in quantum circuit analysis, evaluated on MaxCut instances.

entry.title: AnomalyClaw: A Universal Visual Anomaly Detection Agent via Tool-Grounded Refutation

author.name: Xi Jiang, Yinjie Zhao, Zesheng Yang, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Presents AnomalyClaw, a training-free visual anomaly detection agent using VLMs with tool-grounded refutation approach, performing cross-domain anomaly detection without domain-specific training.

entry.title: Formally Verifying Analog Neural Networks Under Process Variations Using Polynomial Zonotopes

author.name: Yasmine Abu-Haeyeh, Tobias Ladner, Matthias Althoff, Lars Hedrich

entry.summary: Presents a polynomial-based approach to formally verify analog neural network circuits under manufacturing process variations using reachability analysis with polynomial zonotopes.

entry.title: CMKL: Modality-Aware Continual Learning for Evolving Biomedical Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Yousef A. Radwan, Yao Li, Qing Qing, Ziqi Xu, Qixin Zhang, Yongcheng Jing, Renqiang Luo, Xikun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CMKL, a continual learning framework for evolving biomedical knowledge graphs that handles multimodal information and applies modality-aware regularization to address different forgetting dynamics.

entry.title: LLaVA-CKD: Bottom-Up Cascaded Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Nikolaos Gkalelis, Vasileios Mezaris

entry.summary: Proposes LLaVA-CKD, a cascaded knowledge distillation approach for vision-language models that addresses the teacher-student capacity gap through intermediate-sized models.

entry.title: Active Learning for Gaussian Process Regression Under Self-Induced Boltzmann Weights

author.name: Jixiang Qing, Henry Moss, Matthias Sachs

entry.summary: Proposes AB-SID-iVAR, a Gaussian Process-based active learning acquisition function for learning functions under self-induced Boltzmann distributions, relevant to potential energy surface modeling in computational chemistry.

entry.title: Provable Sparse Inversion and Token Relabel Enhanced One-shot Federated Learning with ViTs

author.name: Li Shen, Xiaolei Hao, Qinglun Li, Xiaochun Cao, Zhifeng Hao, Xun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FedMITR for one-shot federated learning with ViTs, using sparse model inversion to generate high-quality synthetic data and token relabeling to address semantic misalignment in non-IID settings.

entry.title: Do Foundation Model Embeddings Improve Cross-Country Crop Yield Generalisation? A Leave-One-Country-Out Evaluation in Sub-Saharan Africa

author.name: Yaw Osei Adjei

entry.summary: Evaluates geospatial foundation model embeddings (Prithvi, ViT-Base) for cross-country crop yield prediction in sub-Saharan Africa, finding all methods fail under leave-one-country-out validation with negative R².

entry.title: Statistical Inference and Quality Measures of KV Cache Quantisations Inspired by TurboQuant

author.name: Paolo D'Alberto

entry.summary: Analyzes three KV cache quantization schemes under fair bit budgets, showing KQV (WHT+MSE on K, WHT+MSE+QJL on V) wins at the practical n=4 budget and that K-V asymmetry in quantization is unconditional.

entry.title: Revitalizing the Beginning: Avoiding Storage Dependency for Model Merging in Continual Learning

author.name: Xi Wang, Cheng Deng

entry.summary: Analyzes model merging methods under continual learning constraints, identifying error accumulation and vanishing gradient issues, and proposing solutions for storage-free model merging.

entry.title: P-Flow: Proxy-gradient Flows for Linear Inverse Problems

author.name: Zehua Jiang, Fenghao Zhu, Xinquan Wang, Chongwen Huang, Zhaoyang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes P-Flow for inverse problems using flow matching with proxy gradients to update source points, avoiding numerical instability of long-chain differentiation with Gaussian spherical projection.

entry.title: SACHI: Structured Agent Coordination via Holistic Information Integration in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nikunj Gupta, James Zachary Hare, Jesse Milzman, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna

entry.summary: Proposes SACHI, a multi-agent RL method using graph transformer convolutions over inter-agent coordination graphs for structured information integration, addressing the partial observability bottleneck in cooperative MARL.

entry.title: TARO: Temporal Adversarial Rectification Optimization Using Diffusion Models as Purifiers

author.name: Daniel Wesego, Pedram Rooshenas

entry.summary: Proposes TARO, an inference-time adversarial purification method using diffusion models that builds temporally guided score priors from multiple denoising views, balancing semantic preservation and robustness.

entry.title: SeBA: Semi-supervised few-shot learning via Separated-at-Birth Alignment for tabular data

author.name: Kacper Jurek, Wojciech Batko, Marek \'Smieja, Marcin Przewi\k{e}\'zlikowski

entry.summary: Proposes SeBA (Separated-at-Birth Alignment), a joint-embedding framework for semi-supervised few-shot learning on tabular data that eliminates dependence on data augmentation.

entry.title: Skill-CMIB: Multimodal Agent Skill for Consistent Action via Conditional Multimodal Information Bottleneck

author.name: Zihan Huang, Junda Wu, Tong Yu, Qianqi Yan, Rohan Surana, Uttaran Bhattacharya, Lina Yao, Xin Eric Wang, Julian McAuley

entry.summary: Proposes Skill-CMIB for distilling multimodal agent trajectories into reusable skills using a conditional multimodal information bottleneck, separating verbalizable from perceptual skill content.

entry.title: Generative Actor-Critic with Soft Bridge Policies

author.name: Ke He, Le He, Shunpu Tang, Yafei Wang, Lisheng Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a generative actor-critic for MaxEnt RL using 'soft bridge policies' that provide tractable densities without iterative sampling or backpropagation through time.

entry.title: RareCP: Regime-Aware Retrieval for Efficient Conformal Prediction

author.name: Manuel Heurich, Maximilian Granz, Tim Landgraf

entry.summary: Introduces RareCP, a regime-aware conformal prediction method for time series that uses mixture of cosine-attention experts to separate smoothly drifting errors from distinct error regimes.

entry.title: TopoGeoScore: A Self-Supervised Source-Only Geometric Framework for OOD Checkpoint Selection

author.name: Farid Hazratian, Ali Zia, Hien Duy Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes TopoGeoScore, a source-only geometric method for selecting OOD-robust checkpoints using topological and geometric properties of source embeddings without any target domain data.
