entry.summary: Presents a multi-tier labeling cascade combining physics rules, Kalman filtering, and LLM-based annotation for orbital anomaly detection across LEO satellites, addressing the fundamental bottleneck of label scarcity.

entry.title: NaiAD: Initiate Data-Driven Research for LLM Advertising

author.name: Yihang Zhang, Zimeng Huang, Ren Zhai, Yipeng Kang, Tonghan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces NaiAD, the first comprehensive dataset for LLM-native advertising with 58,999 ad-embedded responses, organized around metrics that separately capture user and commercial utility.

entry.title: Geometric 4D Stitching for Grounded 4D Generation

author.name: Sunwoo Park, Taesung Kwon, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Proposes Geometric 4D Stitching for 4D scene generation that explicitly identifies missing geometric regions and fills them with geometrically grounded patches, avoiding expensive radiance-based optimization.

entry.title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Jihyeon Baek, Seunghoon Lee, Gitaek Kwon, Doohyun Park

entry.summary: Compares traditional ML and deep learning for out-of-distribution detection in medical imaging, finding both achieve near-perfect performance on standardized medical image data, questioning the necessity of DL for this specific task.

entry.title: Developing a foundation model for high-resolution remote sensing data of the Netherlands

author.name: Paul Vermeeren, Heysem Kaya

entry.summary: Develops a foundation model for high-resolution satellite images of the Netherlands combining CNNs and Vision Transformers, leveraging temporal data for improved representation learning with fewer labeled samples.

entry.title: Can Language Models Analyze Data? Evaluating Large Language Models for Question Answering over Datasets

author.name: Andreas Xenofontos, Pavlos Fafalios

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM effectiveness in answering questions over datasets both directly and via SQL generation, comparing state-of-the-art and smaller models across different prompting strategies.

entry.title: An agentic framework for gravitational-wave counterpart association in the multi-messenger era

author.name: Yiming Dong, Yacheng Kang, Junjie Zhao, Xinyuan Zhu, Ziming Wang, Lijing Shao

entry.summary: Develops an agentic framework for associating gravitational wave signals with electromagnetic counterparts, addressing scalability challenges from next-generation detectors.

entry.title: An Uncertainty-Aware Resilience Micro-Agent for Causal Observability in the Computing Continuum

author.name: Suvi De Silva, Alfreds Lapkovskis, Alaa Saleh, Sasu Tarkoma, Praveen Kumar Donta

entry.summary: Presents AURORA, a lightweight framework for diagnosing grey failures in edge computing using micro-agents that integrate the free-energy principle, causal do-calculus, and localized causal state-graphs for counterfactual root-cause analysis.

entry.title: Geospatial-Temporal Sensemaking of Remote Sensing Activity Detections with Multimodal Large Language Model

author.name: David F. Ramirez, Tim Overman, Kristen Jaskie, Andreas Spanias

entry.summary: Introduces SMART-HC-VQA, a Sentinel-2 satellite imagery VQA dataset for spatiotemporal analysis of construction activity, transforming existing annotations into natural language QA format.

entry.title: Geometry-free prediction of inertial lift forces in microfluidic devices using deep learning

author.name: Jesse Ward-Bond, Ali Mashadian, Timothy C. Y. Chan, Edmond W. K. Young

entry.summary: Develops a geometry-free deep learning approach for predicting particle lift forces in microfluidic devices that works across arbitrary channel cross-sections without retraining per geometry.

entry.title: Block-Wise Differentiable Sinkhorn Attention: Tail-Refinement Gradients with a Gap-Aware Dustbin Bridge

author.name: Dylan Forde

entry.summary: Studies long-context optimal transport attention on TPU hardware through a stopped-base, fixed-depth tail-refinement surrogate with block-wise implementation for Sinkhorn attention.

entry.title: A PyTorch Library of Turing-Complete Neural Networks

author.name: Jonathan Bates

entry.summary: Presents a PyTorch package that compiles neural networks from Turing machine descriptions, implementing both transformer and RNN architectures that exactly simulate specified machines without training.

entry.title: Learngene Search Across Multiple Datasets for Building Variable-Sized Models

author.name: Boyu Shi, Junbo Zhou, Chang Liu, Xu Yang, Qiufeng Wang, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes LSAMD for extracting transferable learngene components across multiple datasets to initialize variable-sized descendant models, expanding beyond single-dataset learngene extraction.

entry.title: Hierarchical Multi-Fidelity Learning for Predicting Three-Dimensional Flame Wrinkling and Turbulent Burning Velocity

author.name: Saghar Zolfaghari, Yu Xie, Junfeng Yang, Safa Jamali

entry.summary: Develops hierarchical multi-fidelity neural networks integrating sparse high-fidelity experimental data with structured low-fidelity representations for predicting turbulent flame properties.

entry.title: A Deep Risk Estimator for Known Operator Learning

author.name: Andreas Maier, Md Hasan, Paulina Conrad, Paula Andrea Perez-Toro

entry.summary: Derives a deep risk estimator for networks with mixed learned and known operators, showing that replacing learned layers with known operators provably reduces the risk bound.

entry.title: MicroFuse: Protein-to-Genome Expert Fusion for Microbial Operon Reasoning

author.name: Seungik Cho

entry.summary: Proposes MicroFuse for predicting microbial operon co-membership by fusing protein-scale and genome-context representations through a conflict-aware expert fusion mechanism.

entry.title: Non-Parametric Rehearsal Learning via Conditional Mean Embeddings

author.name: Wen-Bo Du, Tian-Zuo Wang, Han-Jia Ye, Zhi-Hua Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes the first non-parametric rehearsal learning approach for the 'avoiding undesired future' problem using kernel conditional mean embeddings, removing restrictive parametric assumptions like linearity or additive noise.

entry.title: DiffATS: Diffusion in Aligned Tensor Space

author.name: Jinhua Lyu, Tianmin Yu, Brian Kim, Lizhuo Zhou, Chanwook Park, Naichen Shi

entry.summary: Proposes DiffATS for spatiotemporal diffusion modeling using Tucker decomposition with orthogonal Procrustes alignment to resolve non-uniqueness of factors. Enables parameter-efficient diffusion without pretrained compression.

entry.title: Adversary-Robust Learning from Fully Asynchronous Directional Derivative Estimates

author.name: Anik Kumar Paul, Nibedita Roy, Nagesh Talagani, Swetha Ganesh, Gugan Thoppe, Alexandre Reiffers-Masson

entry.summary: Proposes FAR-SIGN for adversary-resilient distributed optimization using sign-based updates with two-timescale bias correction. Supports both first-order and zeroth-order implementations with fully asynchronous execution.

entry.title: When Adaptation Fails: A Gradient-Based Diagnosis of Collapsed Gating in Vision-Language Prompt Learning

author.name: Yunxuan Fang, Ziwei Zhang, Xinhe Wang

entry.summary: Systematically diagnoses why adaptive prompting mechanisms collapse in frozen few-shot CLIP-based prompt learning. Identifies gradient magnitude imbalance and gate degradation as recurring failure modes.

entry.title: On Uniform Error Bounds for Kernel Regression under Non-Gaussian Noise

author.name: Johannes Teutsch, Oleksii Molodchyk, Marion Leibold, Timm Faulwasser, Armin Lederer

entry.summary: Derives novel non-asymptotic probabilistic uniform error bounds for kernel regression under non-Gaussian noise including sub-exponential and bounded distributions, extending beyond the standard sub-Gaussian assumption to correlated noise.

entry.title: From Syntax to Semantics: Unveiling the Emergence of Chirality in SMILES Translation Models

author.name: Zehao Li, Yasuhiro Yoshikai, Shumpei Nemoto, Hiroyuki Kusuhara, Tadahaya Mizuno

entry.summary: Studies how chemical language models learn chirality during SMILES translation training, revealing distinct learning phases and showing that chiral awareness emerges abruptly as a phase transition during training.

entry.title: Unveiling High-Probability Generalization in Decentralized SGD

author.name: Jiahuan Wang, Ping Luo, Ziqing Wen, Dongsheng Li, Tao Sun

entry.summary: Develops high-probability generalization bounds for decentralized SGD that close the gap with centralized SGD bounds, achieving optimal O(1/√(mn) log(1/δ)) rates.

entry.title: Sample-Mean Anchored Thompson Sampling for Offline-to-Online Learning with Distribution Shift

author.name: Bochao Li, Yao Fu, Wei Chen, Fang Kong

entry.summary: Develops Sample-Mean Anchored Thompson Sampling for offline-to-online bandits under distribution shift, addressing the challenge that posterior samples in TS aren't guaranteed optimistic unlike UCB indices.

entry.title: Causal Explanations from the Geometric Properties of ReLU Neural Networks

author.name: Hector Woods, Philippa Ryan, Rob Alexander

entry.summary: Proposes causal explanations from the geometric properties of ReLU networks directly, without model distillation, using the piecewise-linear structure to provide why/why-not explanations for autonomous system policies.

entry.title: AxiomOcean: Forecasting the Three-Dimensional Structure of the Upper Ocean

author.name: Sensen Wu, Yifan Chen, Guantao Pu, Xiaoyao Sun, Yijun Chen, Jin Qi, Ming Kong, Keyi Yang, Lichen Xu, Wenguan Wang, Xiaofeng Li, Zhenhong Du

entry.summary: Presents AxiomOcean, a global AI ocean forecasting model that explicitly represents vertical hierarchy in the water column, jointly predicting upper-ocean temperature, salinity, and currents with 3D structure preservation.

entry.title: Neural Posterior Estimation of Terrain Parameters from Radar Sounder Data

author.name: Jordy Dal Corso, Annalena Kofler, Marco Cortellazzi, Lorenzo Bruzzone, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf

entry.summary: Applies simulation-based inference with neural posterior estimation for inverting terrain parameters from radar sounder data, using GPU-based simulation and neural density estimation. Enables systematic evaluation of posterior correlations and noise effects.

entry.title: Non-intrusive Body Composition Assessment from Full-body mmWave Scans

author.name: Miriam Senne, Benjamin D. Killeen, Tony Wang, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Explores using millimeter wave (mmWave) radar scans for non-intrusive body composition assessment, showing ML can estimate tissue distributions from security-style body scans as an alternative to CT/MRI.

entry.title: Learning Pure Quantum States in Any Dimension (Almost) Without Regret

author.name: Josep Lumbreras, Marco Tomamichel

entry.summary: Extends quantum state tomography with minimal cumulative disturbance to arbitrary finite-dimensional pure states, overcoming limitations of qubit-specific Bloch sphere methods by working locally on the pure-state manifold.

entry.title: Nonlinear GENERIC Informed Neural Networks (N-GINNs): learning GENERIC dynamics with non-quadratic dissipation potentials

author.name: Vojt\v{e}ch Votruba, Zequn He, Weilun Qiu, Celia Reina, Michal Pavelka

entry.summary: Introduces N-GINNs, a deep learning framework for discovering thermodynamically consistent evolution equations with non-quadratic dissipation potentials using the GENERIC formalism.

entry.title: PGID: Progressive Guided Inversion and Denoising for Robust Watermark Detection

author.name: Minh Quoc Duong, Chun Tong Lei, Chun Pong Lau

entry.summary: Proposes PGID for robust watermark detection in diffusion-model-generated images, addressing vulnerabilities where attacks displace watermarked latents into unwatermarked regions.

entry.title: Learning stochastic multiscale models through normalizing flows

author.name: Anan Saha, Arnab Ganguly

entry.summary: Develops a data-driven framework using normalizing flows to learn effective stochastic dynamics of slow variables from a single observed trajectory of multiscale systems.

entry.title: Deep Learning under Fractional-Order Differential Privacy

author.name: Mohammad Partohaghighi, Roummel Marcia

entry.summary: Already analyzed above.

entry.title: Parameterized Complexity of Stationarity Testing for Piecewise-Affine Functions and Shallow CNN Losses

author.name: Yuhan Ye

entry.summary: Studies parameterized complexity of testing approximate stationarity for piecewise-affine functions (relevant to ReLU networks) with ambient dimension as parameter. Provides XP algorithms and W[1]-hardness results.

entry.title: Multifidelity Gaussian process regression for solving nonlinear partial differential equations

author.name: Fatima-Zahrae El-Boukkouri, Josselin Garnier, Olivier Roustant

entry.summary: Proposes a multifidelity Gaussian process approach for solving nonlinear PDEs, using cokriging to learn kernels from low-fidelity simulations and transfer to high-fidelity solutions.

entry.title: Scalable Mamba-Based Message-Passing Neural Decoder for Error-Correcting Codes

author.name: Rostislav Gusev, Nikita Aleksandrov, Artem Solomkin, Dmitry Artemasov

entry.summary: Introduces MMPD, a Mamba-based message-passing decoder for error-correcting codes that replaces attention with bidirectional Mamba state-space blocks for scalable long-range information propagation on Tanner graphs.

entry.title: MultiSoc-4D: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Instruction-Induced Label Collapse in Closed-Set LLM Annotation of Bengali Social Media

author.name: Souvik Pramanik, S. M. Riaz Rahman Antu, Shak Mohammad Abyad, Md. Ibrahim Khalil, Md. Shahriar Hussain

entry.summary: Presents MultiSoc-4D, a Bengali social media benchmark revealing 'instruction-induced label collapse' where LLMs systematically prefer certain labels in closed-set annotation tasks for low-resource languages.

entry.title: MIPIAD: Multilingual Indirect Prompt Injection Attack Defense with Qwen -- TF-IDF Hybrid and Meta-Ensemble Learning

author.name: Al Muhit Muhtadi, Mostafa Rifat Tazwar

entry.summary: Presents MIPIAD, a multilingual defense framework against indirect prompt injection attacks combining a LoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5 classifier with TF-IDF features and ensemble methods, evaluated on English and Bangla.

entry.title: GRaSp: Automatic Example Optimization for In-Context Learning in Low-Data Tasks

author.name: Simen Bihaug-Fr{\o}yland, Henrik Br{\aa}dland

entry.summary: Proposes GRaSp, a three-stage framework for optimizing in-context examples using synthetic candidate generation, clustering-based structuring, and genetic algorithms for selection. Targets low-data domain-specific NER tasks.

entry.title: Is Class Signal Clustered or Routed in Task-Induced Implicit Neural Representation Weight Spaces?

author.name: Xinyi Guo, Mingyi He, Haobin Ding, Weiming Chen, Xinrui Chen, Jiawen Li, Di Zhang, Minxi Ouyang, Yizhi Wang, Xitong Ling

entry.summary: Tests whether end-to-end trained implicit neural representations cluster by class in weight space, finding that this geometric hypothesis fails - clustering doesn't reliably predict classifier accuracy and can even hurt performance.

entry.title: A Two-Stage Motion-Aware Framework for mmWave-based Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Hoang Hai Pham, Shuntian Zheng, Jiaqi Li, Yu Guan

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for mmWave radar-based human mesh recovery that decouples signal interpretation from geometric reasoning and exploits temporal motion cues.

entry.title: IPAD-CLIP: Teaching CLIP to Detect Image Local Perceptual Artifacts

author.name: Juan Wang, Xinyu Sun, Ke Zhang, Jin Wang, Bing Li, Weiming Hu, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces IPAD-CLIP for detecting local perceptual image artifacts (ghosting, lens flare, moire) by formalizing the Image Perceptual Artifact Detection task with a benchmark of 3,520 images.

entry.title: ProDG: Prototypes for Data-Free Generative Post-Hoc Explainability

author.name: Piotr Borycki, Magdalena Tr\k{e}dowicz, Jacek Tabor, {\L}ukasz Struski, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek

entry.summary: ProDG introduces data-free post-hoc explainability using generative models to produce visual prototypes without requiring access to any dataset. This addresses a fundamental limitation of existing prototype-based explanation methods.

entry.title: Semantic Alignment in Hyperbolic Space for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Hoang M. Truong, Hai Nguyen-Truong, Dang Huynh

entry.summary: HyRo proposes a hyperbolic fine-tuning framework for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation that decouples hierarchical and semantic alignment in the Poincaré ball model. Addresses the overlooked problem of semantic misalignment within the same hierarchical level.

entry.title: The Direct Integration Theorem: A Rigorous Framework for Consistent Discrete Solutions of the Inverse Radon Problem

author.name: Mikhail G. Mozerov

entry.summary: Presents a Direct Integration Theorem for computed tomography that provides a mathematically consistent continuous-to-discrete transition, eliminating need for frequency-domain interpolation and ramp filtering.

entry.title: KEPIL: Knowledge-Enhanced Prompt-Image Learning for Prompt-Robust Disease Detection

author.name: Haozhe Luo, Shelley Zixin Shu, Ziyu Zhou, Robert Berke, Mauricio Reyes

entry.summary: KEPIL presents a prompt-robust framework for medical VLMs that integrates curated medical knowledge from ontologies and knowledge graphs to stabilize zero-shot generalization for disease detection.

entry.title: Noise-Started One-Step Real-World Super-Resolution via LR-Conditioned SplitMeanFlow and GAN Refinement

author.name: Wei Zhu, Kai Zhang, Yu Zheng, Lei Luo, Yong Guo, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a noise-started one-step super-resolution method combining LR-conditioned SplitMeanFlow with GAN refinement, maintaining stochastic generation capability while achieving one-step efficiency.

entry.title: PermuQuant: Lowering Per-Group Quantization Error by Reordering Channels for Diffusion Models

author.name: Yongsen Cheng, Kai Liu, Kaiwen Tao, Junxian Li, Zhixin Wang, Zhikai Chen, Renjing Pei, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: PermuQuant identifies channel ordering as an underexplored factor in per-group quantization of diffusion models and proposes channel reordering to lower quantization error under extremely low-bit settings.

entry.title: BEA-GS: BEyond RAdiance Supervision in 3DGS for Precise Object Extraction

author.name: Alessio Mazzucchelli, Maria Naranjo-Almeida, Jorge Bustos-Sanchez, Mariella Dimiccoli, Francesc Moreno-Noguer, Jordi Sanchez-Riera, Adrian Penate-Sanchez

entry.summary: BEA-GS advances Gaussian Splatting object extraction by introducing losses that modify geometry of both visible and non-visible Gaussians to respect semantic boundaries, achieving near-perfect extraction.

entry.title: ConFixGS: Learning to Fix Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Confidence-Aware Diffusion Priors in Driving Scenes

author.name: Rui Song, Tianhui Cai, Markus Gross, Xingcheng Zhou, Zewei Zhou, Zhiyu Huang, Olaf Wysocki, Jiaqi Ma

entry.summary: ConFixGS is a plug-and-play method that fixes feedforward 3DGS in driving scenes using confidence-aware diffusion priors, with reprojection-based cross-checking to validate pseudo-targets and suppress hallucinations.

entry.title: Learning to Align Generative Appearance Priors for Fine-grained Image Retrieval

author.name: Shijie Wang, Yadan Luo, Zijian Wang, Xin Yu, Zi Huang

entry.summary: GAPan reformulates fine-grained image retrieval from category prediction toward appearance modeling using normalizing flows, aligning generative appearance priors to improve retrieval of unseen categories.

entry.title: Adversarial Attacks Against MLLMs via Progressive Resolution Processing and Adaptive Feature Alignment

author.name: Haobo Wang, Xiaorong Ma, Weiqi Luo, Xiaojun Jia, Jiwu Huang

entry.summary: PRAF-Attack proposes progressive resolution processing and adaptive feature alignment for transfer-based targeted adversarial attacks against MLLMs, improving transferability to black-box models.

entry.title: Towards Generalist Game Players: An Investigation of Foundation Models in the Game Multiverse

author.name: Kuan Zhang, Dongchen Liu, Qiyue Zhao, Tianyu Xin, Yue Su, Haisheng Wang, Han Yin, Hongbo Ma, Peize Li, Tianjun Gu, Xiangnan Wu, Xinran Zhang, Yongxuan Li, Zirong Chen, Yiming Li

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey investigating foundation models as generalist game players across the game multiverse, tracing evolution from environment-specific agents to current large foundation models.

entry.title: Slum Detection and Density Mapping with AlphaEarth Foundations: A Representation Learning Evaluation Across 12 Global Cities

author.name: Shuyang Hou, Ziqi Liu, Haoyue Jiao, Zhangyan Xu, Xiaopu Zhang, Lutong Xie, Yaxian Qing, Jianyuan Liang, Xuefeng Guan, Huayi Wua

entry.summary: This paper evaluates AlphaEarth Foundations (a 10m-resolution global surface embedding) for slum detection and density mapping across 12 cities, testing lightweight monitoring approaches on this pre-computed representation.

entry.title: MicroViTv2: Beyond the FLOPS for Edge Energy-Friendly Vision Transformers

author.name: Novendra Setyawan, Chi-Chia Sun, Mao-Hsiu Hsu, Wen-Kai Kuo, Jun-Wei Hsieh

entry.summary: MicroViTv2 is a lightweight Vision Transformer optimized for real-device edge deployment, using reparameterized designs and single depth-wise transposed attention to achieve better accuracy-latency tradeoffs.

entry.title: PolarVSR: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Continuous Space-Time Polarization Video Reconstruction

author.name: Chenggong Li, Yidong Luo, Junchao Zhang, Boxin Shi, Degui Yang

entry.summary: PolarVSR proposes the first space-time polarization video reconstruction architecture, jointly modeling polarization directions in space and time for enhanced DoFP camera output.

entry.title: Sens-VisualNews: A Benchmark Dataset for Sensational Image Detection

author.name: Andreas Goulas, Damianos Galanopoulos, Evlampios Apostolidis, Vasileios Mezaris

entry.summary: Sens-VisualNews introduces the task of sensational image detection in news media with a 9,576-image benchmark, aiming to identify provocative visual content that bypasses critical evaluation.

entry.title: UAV-Assisted Scan-to-Simulation for Landslides Using Physics-Informed Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Zhenyu Liang, Jack C. P. Cheng

entry.summary: This paper proposes a UAV-based scan-to-simulation framework using physics-informed 3D Gaussian Splatting for photorealistic landslide simulation, bridging visual realism with physics-based modeling.

entry.title: BabelDOC: Better Layout-Preserving PDF Translation via Intermediate Representation

author.name: Qi Yang, Xiangyao Ma, Xiao Wang, Hao Wang, Rui Wang

entry.summary: BabelDOC introduces an Intermediate Representation-based framework for layout-preserving PDF translation, decoupling visual layout from semantic content to enable document-level translation operations.

entry.title: Coarse-to-Fine: Progressive Image Compression for Semantically Hierarchical Classification

author.name: Jungwoo Kim, Jun-Hyuk Kim, Jong-Seok Lee

entry.summary: Introduces a semantic hierarchy-aware progressive image compression codec that enables coarse-to-fine semantic scalability from a single bitstream. Systematically categorizes ImageNet-1K classes into CLIP-based semantic hierarchies for machine-oriented progressive coding.

entry.title: CAGS: Color-Adaptive Volumetric Video Streaming with Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Daheng Yin, Yili Jin, Jianxin Shi, Isaac Ding, Miao Zhang, Fangxin Wang, Zhaowu Huang, Cong Zhang, Jiangchuan Liu, Fang Dong

entry.summary: CAGS proposes color-adaptive volumetric video streaming using dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting, addressing bandwidth limitations through color-based Levels of Detail rather than density-based approaches for real-time immersive access.

entry.title: Nano-U: Efficient Terrain Segmentation for Tiny Robot Navigation

author.name: Federico Pizzolato, Francesco Pasti, Nicola Bellotto

entry.summary: Nano-U develops a compact binary terrain segmentation network with only thousands of parameters for microcontroller deployment, using Quantization-Aware Distillation to compensate for minimal network capacity.

entry.title: Hierarchical Prompting with Dual LLM Modules for Robotic Task and Motion Planning

author.name: Karolina \'Zr\'obek, Tessa Pulli, Pawe{\l} Gajewski, Antonio Galiza Cerdeira Gonzalez, Bipin Indurkhya

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical LLM framework for robotic task and motion planning with separate high-level planning and low-level spatial reasoning modules, using ReAct-style prompting for natural language commanded manipulation.

entry.title: AssemPlanner: A Multi-Agent Based Task Planning Framework for Flexible Assembly System

author.name: Chenhao Zhang, Chaoran Zhang, Zhaobo Xu, Yongbo Yang, Pingfa Feng, Long Zeng

entry.summary: AssemPlanner uses a multi-agent LLM framework for flexible assembly task planning, converting natural language instructions to production operations through specialized agents for scheduling, knowledge, and line balancing.

entry.title: Continuum Robot Modeling with Action Conditioned Flow Matching

author.name: Jiong Lin, Jinchen Ruan, Hod Lipson

entry.summary: Proposes using action-conditioned flow matching for predicting steady-state shapes of tendon-driven continuum robots, learning point cloud flow matching models from randomly sampled quasi-static configurations.

entry.title: Minimizing Worst-Case Weighted Latency for Multi-Robot Persistent Monitoring: Theory and RL-Based Solutions

author.name: Weizhen Wang, Ziheng Wang, Jianping He, Xinping Guan, Xiaoming Duan

entry.summary: Studies multi-robot persistent monitoring on weighted graphs with novel tail-performance objectives that generalize worst-case latency, establishing theoretical properties and proposing RL-based solutions.

entry.title: Learning Point Cloud Geometry as a Statistical Manifold: Theory and Practice

author.name: Jinwoo Lee, Jiwoo Kim, Woojae Shin, Giseop Kim, Hyondong Oh

entry.summary: Models point cloud geometry as a statistical manifold using information geometry, providing a principled mathematical framework for geometric reasoning on sparse LiDAR data without hand-crafted statistics or large labeled datasets.

entry.title: ReasonSTL: Bridging Natural Language and Signal Temporal Logic via Tool-Augmented Process-Rewarded Learning

author.name: Bowen Ye, Zhijian Li, Junyue Huang, Junkai Ma, Xiang Yin

entry.summary: Presents ReasonSTL, a tool-augmented process-rewarded learning approach for translating natural language to Signal Temporal Logic specifications, addressing privacy and cost concerns of commercial LLM APIs for industrial deployment.

entry.title: Safe Exploration for Nonlinear Processes Using Online Gaussian Process Learning

author.name: Stefano Tonini, Soroush Rastegarpour, Hamid Reza Feyzmahdavian, Nicola Bastianello, Karl Henrik Johansson

entry.summary: Proposes a safe data-driven control framework for nonlinear systems using online Gaussian process learning with probabilistic safety guarantees through Lyapunov-based control-invariant sets, maximizing information gain while respecting constraints.

entry.title: Quantifying the Risk-Return Tradeoff in Forecasting

author.name: Philippe Goulet Coulombe

entry.summary: Proposes treating forecast loss differentials as a return series and evaluating them with risk-adjusted performance measures from finance (Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, etc.), showing professional forecasters are harder to beat on risk-adjusted metrics than on averages.

entry.title: How useful is the information you get from working inside an AI company?

author.name: Buck

entry.summary: Buck Shlegeris estimates how much advance knowledge working inside an AI company provides compared to being a well-connected external researcher, concluding it's roughly 1-3 months of advance information for safety-relevant insights.

entry.title: Sparsity Hurts: Simple Linear Adapter Can Boost Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Bo Ye, Kai Gan, Tong Wei, Min-Ling Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LAGCD for generalized category discovery using a simple linear adapter on pretrained ViTs, showing this outperforms partial fine-tuning and visual prompt tuning which are prone to overfitting or limited flexibility.

entry.title: LLM-guided Semi-Supervised Approaches for Social Media Crisis Data Classification

author.name: Jacob Ativo, Bharaneeshwar Balasubramaniyam, Anh Tran, Khushboo Gupta, Hongmin Li, Doina Caragea, Cornelia Caragea

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-guided semi-supervised learning for crisis tweet classification, finding that LG-CoTrain significantly outperforms classical approaches in low-resource settings with as few as 5-25 labeled examples per class.

entry.title: What Will Happen Next: Large Models-Driven Deduction for Emergency Instances

author.name: Zhengqing Hu, Dong Chen, Junkun Yuan, Liang Liu, Hua Wang, Zhao Jin, Yingchaojie Feng, Wei Chen, Mingliang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes the World Line Divergence System (WLDS) using large models to generate diversified emergency scenario deductions for risk assessment, enabling visualization of multiple possible futures from emergency instances.

entry.title: Latency Analysis and Optimization of Alpamayo 1 via Efficient Trajectory Generation

author.name: Yunseong Jeon, Namcheol Lee, Yoonsu Lee, Jangwoon Park, Sol Ahn, Jong-Chan Kim, Seongsoo Hong

entry.summary: Analyzes and optimizes latency of Alpamayo 1 autonomous driving system, comparing multi-reasoning vs single-reasoning trajectory generation and showing efficiency gains without sacrificing diversity.

entry.title: Shaping Schema via Language Representation as the Next Frontier for LLM Intelligence Expanding

author.name: Zhiqin Yang, Yuhan Liu, Jingwen Fu, Pei Fu anf Bo Han, Masashi Sugiyama, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: Argues that natural language's limited expressive capacity bottlenecks LLM problem-solving and that shaping schemas through advanced language representation is the next frontier. Proposes that knowledge activation depends on structural sophistication of task representation.

entry.title: Explainable Knowledge Tracing via Probabilistic Embeddings and Pattern-based Reasoning

author.name: Siyu Wu, Cong Xu, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PLKT, an interpretable knowledge tracing framework using Beta-distributed probabilistic embeddings and goal-conditioned evidence reasoning over learning behaviors.

entry.title: Functional Stable Model Semantics and Answer Set Programming Modulo Theories

author.name: Michael Bartholomew, Joohyung Lee

entry.summary: Demonstrates that functional stable model semantics plays a key role in Answer Set Programming Modulo Theories (ASPMT), showing tight ASPMT programs can be translated to SMT instances.

entry.title: Beyond Autonomy: A Dynamic Tiered AgentRunner Framework for Governable and Resilient Enterprise AI Execution

author.name: Kai Pan, Rong Hou

entry.summary: Proposes a Dynamic Tiered AgentRunner framework for enterprise AI with risk-adaptive resource allocation, separation of powers architecture, and acceptance testing. Derived from production multi-tenant SaaS platform experience.

entry.title: IndustryBench: Probing the Industrial Knowledge Boundaries of LLMs

author.name: Songlin Bai, Xintong Wang, Linlin Yu, Bin Chen, Zhiang Xu, Yuyang Sheng, Changtong Zan, Xiaofeng Zhu, Yizhe Zhang, Jiru Li, Mingze Guo, Ling Zou, Yalong Li, Chengfu Huo, Liang Ding

entry.summary: Introduces IndustryBench, a 2,049-item benchmark for industrial procurement QA grounded in Chinese national standards. Tests LLMs on domain-specific knowledge where partial correctness can mask safety-critical contradictions.

entry.title: PaperFit: Vision-in-the-Loop Typesetting Optimization for Scientific Documents

author.name: Bihui Yu, Xinglong Xu, Junjie Jiang, Jiabei Cheng, Caijun Jia, Siyuan Li, Conghui He, Jingxuan Wei, Cheng Tan

entry.summary: Formalizes Visual Typesetting Optimization (VTO) for LaTeX documents, using vision-in-the-loop LLM agents to fix layout issues like misplaced floats and overflowing equations. Creates a closed-loop system that verifies visual output after each edit.

entry.title: Bridging Sequence and Graph Structure for Epigenetic Age Prediction

author.name: Yao Li, Xikun Zhang, Xiaotao Shen, Sonika Tyagi, Xin Zheng, Jiaxing Huang, Feng Xia

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for epigenetic age prediction that jointly models co-methylation graph structure and DNA sequence context. Integrates sequence features through gated modulation within a graph neural network.

entry.title: TrajPrism: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Language-Grounded Urban Trajectory Understanding

author.name: Lihuan Li, Wilson Wongso, Baiyu Chen, Hao Xue, Ruiyi Yang, Yifan Duan, Xiachong Lin, Yang Song, Flora Salim

entry.summary: Introduces TrajPrism, a multi-task benchmark for language-trajectory alignment unifying trajectory generation, retrieval, and captioning. Evaluates fine-grained alignment between natural language and underlying routes.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning: Integrating Zero-Knowledge Proofs in Scalable Distributed Architectures

author.name: Divya Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes integrating zero-knowledge proofs into federated learning for privacy-preserving gradient verification, combining cryptographic verification with distributed computing frameworks.

entry.title: Information Density as a Quantitative Measure for AI-enabled Virtual Sensing: Feasibility and Limits

author.name: Hrishikesh Dutta, Roberto Minerva, Reza Farahbakhsh, Noel Crespi

entry.summary: Proposes Information Density as a metric for AI-driven virtual sensing, using spatial/temporal/inter-modal correlations to perform sensing tasks without physical sensors.

entry.title: Resource-Aware Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search for Cardiac MRI Segmentation

author.name: Farhana Yasmin, Mahade Hasan, Haipeng Liu, Amjad Ali, Ghulam Muhammad, Yu Xue

entry.summary: Proposes CardiacNAS, an evolutionary neural architecture search framework for cardiac MRI segmentation that jointly optimizes accuracy metrics and computational cost under fixed budgets.

entry.title: Diagnosing Spectral Ceilings in Equivariant Neural Force Fields

author.name: Hyunmog Kim

entry.summary: Introduces a spectral-injection diagnostic to measure which angular frequencies equivariant neural force fields preserve, revealing sharp spectral ceilings at predicted boundaries in NequIP backbones.

entry.title: SGC-RML: A reliable and interpretable longitudinal assessment for PD in real-world DNS

author.name: Wenbin Wei, Ruixiang Gao, Suyuan Yao, Xuanzhen Zhao, Cheng Huang, Hen-Wei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes SGC-RML for longitudinal Parkinson's disease assessment from heterogeneous real-world data (speech, gait, wearable motion), mapping multimodal inputs to a shared symptom node space with reliability mechanisms.

entry.title: PYTHALAB-MERA: Validation-Grounded Memory, Retrieval, and Acceptance Control for Frozen-LLM Coding Agents

author.name: Mehmet Iscan

entry.summary: Introduces PYTHALAB-MERA, a controller for frozen local LLMs that provides validation-grounded episodic memory, adaptive retrieval, and structural skill reuse for code generation agents.

entry.title: Compressed Video Aggregator: Content-driven Module for Efficient Micro-Video Recommendation

author.name: Yang Xiao, Huiyuan Chen, Kaiyuan Deng, Chao Jiang, Zinan Ling, Ruimeng Ye, Xiaolong Ma, Bo Hui

entry.summary: CVA is a lightweight micro-video recommendation module that decouples video information from preference learning using frozen VFM embeddings and latent reasoning, achieving large reductions in training time and GPU memory.

entry.title: Hierarchical Attention-based Graph Neural Network with Relevance-driven Pruning

author.name: Seungwoo Kum

entry.summary: HA-HeteroGNN proposes a hierarchical attention-based heterogeneous GNN with an explainability-to-pruning pipeline. Two-tier attention produces per-node relevance scores used for principled graph pruning without gradient backpropagation.

entry.title: Relational Retrieval: Leveraging Known-Novel Interactions for Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Yulin Xu, Chunqi Guo, Yuanzhen Shuai, Jianyuan Ni

entry.summary: Proposes Relational Pattern Consistency for Generalized Category Discovery, coupling labeled and unlabeled data through bidirectional knowledge transfer and leveraging invariant relationships with known-class prototypes.

entry.title: LASSA Architecture-Based Autonomous Fault-Tolerant Control of Unmanned Underwater Vehicles

author.name: Hong Chen, Zixiang Tang, Yuanbao Chen, Yu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes LASSA architecture for autonomous fault-tolerant control of underwater vehicles, using LLMs for fault identification while addressing hallucination risks through a structured solver-sensor-actuator framework.

entry.title: Assessment of RAG and Fine-Tuning for Industrial Question-Answering-Applications

author.name: Jakob Sturm, Josef Pichlmeier, Christian Bernhard, Maka Karalashvili, Johannes Klepsch, Georg Groh, Andre Luckow

entry.summary: Compares RAG and fine-tuning for industrial question-answering on automotive datasets, extending the Cost-of-Pass framework to jointly assess quality, generation cost, and user interaction cost.

entry.title: Insight: Enhancing Mobile Accessibility for Blind and Visually Impaired Users with LLMs

author.name: Joshua Owusu Ansah, Anuj Kapoor, Ayush Khanna, Manvika Vinod, Precious Njeck, Shuai Gao

entry.summary: Introduces Insight, an Android accessibility service using LLMs to provide natural language interaction and screen summarization for blind and visually impaired users, showing reduced mental effort and task time vs TalkBack.

entry.title: MoPO: Incorporating Motion Prior for Occluded Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Tao Tang, Hong Liu, Xinshun Wang, Wanruo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MoPO for occluded human mesh recovery by incorporating motion priors from pose sequences, using spatial-temporal occlusion detection and a motion prediction module to estimate occluded body parts.

entry.title: SDTalk: Structured Facial Priors and Dual-Branch Motion Fields for Generalizable Gaussian Talking Head Synthesis

author.name: Peng Jia, Zhen Xiao, Jia Li, Xueliang Liu, Zhenzhen Hu, Lingyun Yu

entry.summary: Proposes SDTalk, a one-shot 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for talking head synthesis that generalizes to unseen identities using structured facial priors and dual-branch motion fields.

entry.title: CFSPMNet: Cross-subject Fourier-guided Spatial-Patch Mamba Network for EEG Motor Imagery Decoding in Stroke Patients

author.name: Xiangkai Wang, Yun Zhao, Dongyi He, Qingling Xia, Gen Li, Xinlai Xing, Yuchi Pan, Bin Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CFSPMNet for cross-patient motor imagery EEG decoding in stroke patients, combining Fourier-reorganized state modeling with shared-private prototype matching to handle pathological neural variability.

entry.title: SoK: A Systematic Bidirectional Literature Review of AI & DLT Convergence

author.name: Ali Irzam Kathia, Yimika Erinle, Abylay Satybaldy, Paolo Tasca, Nikhil Vadgama, Marco Alberto Javarone

entry.summary: Provides a systematic bidirectional literature review of AI and DLT (blockchain) integration from 2020-2025, classifying how AI enhances DLT systems and how DLT supports AI across multiple architectural layers.

entry.title: Measuring Embedding Sensitivity to Authorial Style in French: Comparing Literary Texts with Language Model Rewritings

author.name: Benjamin Icard, Lila Sainero, Alice Breton, Evangelia Zve, Jean-Gabriel Ganascia

entry.summary: Studies how much authorial style information is preserved in embeddings before and after LLM rewriting in French, finding embeddings reliably capture stylistic features that persist after rewriting.

entry.title: Why Low-Resource NLP Needs More Than Cross-Lingual Transfer: Lessons Learned from Luxembourgish

author.name: Fred Philippy, Siwen Guo, Jacques Klein, Tegawend\'e F. Bissyand\'e

entry.summary: Synthesizes research on Luxembourgish NLP to argue that cross-lingual transfer alone is insufficient for low-resource languages, even those typologically close to high-resource languages. Highlights the need for language-specific data and efforts.

entry.title: MPerS: Dynamic MLLM MixExperts Perception-Guided Remote Sensing Scene Segmentation

author.name: Ziyi Wang, Xianping Ma, Ziyao Wang, Hongyang Zhang, Man On Pun

entry.summary: Proposes MPerS for remote sensing scene segmentation using multiple MLLM-generated captions from diverse expert perspectives, with dynamic mixture-of-experts fusion of text and visual features.

entry.title: Attractor-Vascular Coupling Theory: Formal Grounding and Empirical Validation for AAMI-Standard Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation from Smartphone Photoplethysmography

author.name: Timothy Oladunni, Farouk Ganiyu Adewumi

entry.summary: Proposes Attractor-Vascular Coupling Theory for cuffless blood pressure estimation from smartphone PPG using cardiac attractor geometry, validated with LightGBM achieving AAMI-standard accuracy.

entry.title: Dendritic Neural Networks with Equilibrium Propagation

author.name: Yoshimasa Kubo

entry.summary: Integrates dendritic neural networks with equilibrium propagation, showing dendritic EP achieves comparable performance to standard EP while potentially benefiting from biologically-inspired architecture.

entry.title: Higher-Order Equilibrium Tracking for EM-Compressible Online Estimation

author.name: ZhiMing Li, Yue Song

entry.summary: Studies online estimation in latent-variable models as equilibrium tracking, proving a batch-to-online transfer theorem showing when online EM inherits the batch central limit theorem.

entry.title: Functional Graphs for Predicting and Explaining Goal Failure in Sparse Goal-Conditioned RL

author.name: Shalley Dash

entry.summary: Introduces functional graph analysis for diagnosing goal-level failures in sparse goal-conditioned RL. Defines local goal support (LGS) metric that predicts goal failure and reveals structural properties of learned policies.

entry.title: End-to-End Keyword Spotting on FPGA Using Graph Neural Networks with a Neuromorphic Auditory Sensor

author.name: Wiktor Matykiewicz, Piotr Wzorek, Kamil Jeziorek, Tom\'as Mu\~noz, Antonio Rios-Navarro, Angel Jim\'enez-Fern\'andez, Tomasz Kryjak

entry.summary: First end-to-end FPGA implementation combining a neuromorphic auditory sensor with a graph neural network for keyword spotting, processing raw event-based audio without conventional preprocessing.

entry.title: TeleResilienceBench: Quantifying Resilience for LLM Reasoning in Telecommunications

author.name: Pranshav Gajjar, Emmanuel Ojo, Vijay K Shah

entry.summary: Introduces TeleResilienceBench, a benchmark measuring LLM reasoning resilience in telecommunications - the ability to continue and correct flawed reasoning traces from upstream steps. Proposes Correct Flip Rate as a metric.

entry.title: Generating synthetic electronic health record data using agent-based models to evaluate machine learning robustness under mass casualty incidents

author.name: Roben Delos Reyes, Daniel Capurro, Nicholas Geard

entry.summary: Proposes using agent-based models to generate synthetic EHR data simulating mass casualty incidents, enabling evaluation of ML model robustness under distribution shifts that are rare and can't be captured in real data.

entry.title: TrajDLM: Topology-Aware Block Diffusion Language Model for Trajectory Generation

author.name: Wilson Wongso, Lihuan Li, Arian Prabowo, Xiachong Lin, Baiyu Chen, Hao Xue, Flora D. Salim

entry.summary: Proposes TrajDLM, a topology-aware trajectory generation framework using block diffusion language models that models trajectories as discrete road segments, bridging the gap between fast generation and road network faithfulness.

entry.title: Generalization Error Bounds for Picard-Type Operator Learning in Nonlinear Parabolic PDEs

author.name: Koichi Taniguchi, Sho Sonoda

entry.summary: Provides generalization error bounds for Picard-type operator learning for nonlinear parabolic PDEs, formulating Picard iteration as abstract state-transition and deriving implementation-agnostic bounds.

entry.title: Set Prediction for Next-Day Active Fire Forecasting

author.name: Yuchen Bai, Georgios Athanasiou, Xin Yu, Diogenis Antonopoulos, Ioannis Papoutsis, Stijn Hantson, Nuno Carvalhais

entry.summary: Proposes WISP, a set prediction model for next-day active fire forecasting that predicts point-sets of fire locations rather than grid-based probability maps, using meteorological and satellite data.

entry.title: PC3D: Zero-Shot Cooperation Across Variable Rosters via Personalized Context Distillation

author.name: Ahmet Onur Akman, Rafa{\l} Kucharski

entry.summary: Proposes PC3D for multi-agent RL with variable team sizes, training decentralized policies to infer and adapt to team composition without communication or retraining at execution time.

entry.title: QT-Net: Rethinking Evaluation of AI Models in Atomic Chemical Space

author.name: Pablo Mart\'inez Crespo, Stefano Ribes, Martin Rahm, Richard Beckmann, Robert S. Jordan, Marisa Gliege, Santiago Miret, Vijay Kris Narasimhan, Roc\'io Mercado

entry.summary: Proposes a held-out evaluation protocol for atomic property prediction using SOAP descriptor clustering, and compares E(3)-equivariant vs. non-equivariant models for electron populations and multipole prediction.

entry.title: Compander-Aligned Query Geometry for Quantized Zeroth-Order Optimization

author.name: Yao Shu, Zilin Zhu

entry.summary: Addresses the challenge of zeroth-order optimization with quantized model evaluations, identifying 'query geometry' as the key missing concept when using non-uniform companding quantizers. Proposes methods to align ZO queries with the quantization codebook structure.

entry.title: Domain-Adaptive Arrhythmia Classification Using a Hybrid Transformer on Wearable Heart Signals

author.name: Maedeh H. Toosi, Siamak Mohammadi

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid transformer model for arrhythmia classification on wearable ECG devices that processes both raw signals and HRV features, with domain adaptation to handle distribution shifts between clinical and wearable data.

entry.title: Survey-aware Machine Learning: A Guideline for Valid Population Health Inference based on Scoping Review

author.name: YongKyung Oh, Henry W. Zheng, Jeffrey Feng, Alex A. T. Bui

entry.summary: Proposes Survey-aware Machine Learning (SaML), a nine-step guideline for incorporating survey design metadata (sampling weights, stratification) across the ML lifecycle for valid population health inference.

entry.title: LLiMba: Sardinian on a Single GPU -- Adapting a 3B Language Model to a Vanishing Romance Language

author.name: Luca Ballore

entry.summary: Presents LLiMba, a 3B parameter model adapted for Sardinian language from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct using continued pretraining on 11.5M tokens, demonstrating feasibility of single-GPU adaptation for low-resource languages.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy Audio Deepfake Detection: A Systematic Framework for Diagnosing and Mitigating Gender Bias

author.name: Aishwarya Fursule, Shruti Kshirsagar, Anderson R. Avila

entry.summary: Presents the first diagnosis-first framework for gender bias in audio deepfake detection, identifying bias sources (representation differences, feature leakage) before applying targeted mitigation.

entry.title: Discriminative Span as a Predictor of Synthetic Data Utility via Classifier Reconstruction

author.name: Radhika Amar Desai, Modigari Narendra

entry.summary: Proposes a geometry-driven metric in foundation model embedding space to predict synthetic data utility for binary classification without requiring model training.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Lossy Compression via Constrained Minimum Entropy Coupling

author.name: Nam Nguyen, Hassan Tavakoli, An Vuong, Thinh Nguyen, Bella Bose

entry.summary: Studies cross-domain lossy compression through minimum entropy coupling with rate and classification constraints, maximizing coupling strength between source and reconstruction under target distribution constraints.

entry.title: APEX: Audio Prototype EXplanations for Classification Tasks

author.name: Piotr Kawa, Kornel Howil, Piotr Borycki, Mi{\l}osz Adamczyk, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek, Piotr Syga

entry.summary: Introduces APEX, a post-hoc explainability framework for audio classifiers that disentangles explanations into four perspectives (square, time, frequency, audio-based prototypes). Requires no fine-tuning and preserves output invariance.

entry.title: MARGIN: Margin-Aware Regularized Geometry for Imbalanced Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Yuteng Zhang, Huifang Ma, Jiahui Wei, Qingqing Li, Yafei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MARGIN, a metric-based framework for software vulnerability detection that addresses frequency and difficulty imbalance through adaptive margin metric learning and hyperspherical prototype modeling using von Mises-Fisher distributions.

entry.title: Priority-Driven Control and Communication in Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Qingyun Guo, Junyi Shi, Tomasz Piotr Kucner, Dominik Baumann

entry.summary: Proposes a model-free RL algorithm that jointly learns communication priorities and control policies in decentralized multi-agent systems, avoiding hybrid action spaces typical in event-triggered control.

entry.title: The Translation Tax Is Not a Scalar: A Counterfactual Audit of English-Source Cue Inheritance in Chinese Multilingual Benchmarks

author.name: Zezheng Lin, Fengming Liu, Handi Li

entry.summary: Audits the 'Translation Tax' assumption in English-to-Chinese benchmark translation, finding that score inflation is not a simple scalar but varies by model family and item characteristics through multiple proxy estimators.

entry.title: Quality-Conditioned Agreement in Automated Short Answer Scoring: Mid-Range Degradation and the Impact of Task-Specific Adaptation

author.name: Abigail Victoria Gurin Schleifer, Moriah Ariely, Beata Beigman Klebanov, Asaf Salman, Giora Alexandron

entry.summary: Studies quality-conditioned agreement in automated short answer scoring, finding that mid-range (partially correct) responses are hardest for models. Compares GPT-5.2, GPT-4o, Claude Opus 4.5 with fine-tuned BERT and human experts.

entry.title: Accurate and Efficient Statistical Testing for Word Semantic Breadth

author.name: Yo Ehara

entry.summary: Proposes accurate statistical testing for comparing word semantic breadth (contextual diversity) from token embeddings, addressing how direction differences can masquerade as dispersion differences and inflate Type-I errors.

entry.title: On the Complexity of the Matching Problem of Regular Expressions with Backreferences

author.name: Soh Kumabe, Yuya Uezato

entry.summary: Studies computational complexity of regular expression matching with backreferences, motivated by ReDoS attacks. Analyzes whether provably efficient near-linear-time matching engines are possible for practical regex features.

entry.title: An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object Tracking

author.name: Weijing Wu, Qihua Liang, Bineng Zhong, Haiying Xia, Zhiyi Mo, Shuxiang Song

entry.summary: Proposes ETCTrack, a compress-then-interact tracking framework that efficiently compresses template tokens from historical frames into compact representations before interaction with search tokens.

entry.title: UIESNN: A Scale-Aware Spiking Network for Underwater Image Enhancement

author.name: Shuang Chen, Ruochen Li, Zihan Zhu, Ronald Thenius, Farshad Arvin, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei

entry.summary: Proposes UIESNN, a spiking neural network for underwater image enhancement with a Multi-scale Pooling LIF Block that injects hierarchical pooling responses into membrane dynamics for enlarged receptive fields.

entry.title: Egocentric Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery with Prior-Guided Learning

author.name: Soyeon Na, Seung Young Noh, Ju Yong Chang

entry.summary: Proposes a prior-guided learning framework for egocentric whole-body human mesh recovery from head-mounted cameras, constructing better pseudo-GT and leveraging priors for hands and face.

entry.title: LightAVSeg: Lightweight Audio-Visual Segmentation

author.name: Qing Zhong, Guodong Ding, Lingqiao Liu, Zaiwen Feng, Lin Yuanbo Wu, Angela Yao

entry.summary: LightAVSeg proposes a lightweight audio-visual segmentation framework that replaces heavy cross-modal attention with a decoupled design for semantic filtering and spatial grounding, achieving linear scaling with spatial resolution. An auxiliary alignment loss enforces semantic consistency during training with zero inference overhead.

entry.title: An Elastic Shape Variational Autoencoder for Skeleton Pose Trajectories

author.name: Arafat Rahman, Shashwat Kumar, Laura E. Barnes, Anuj Srivastava

entry.summary: ES-VAE proposes a geometry-aware variational autoencoder for skeletal trajectories using the TSRVF representation on Kendall's shape manifold, inherently removing nuisance factors like camera orientation and scale.

entry.title: SoccerLens: Grounded Soccer Video Understanding Beyond Accuracy

author.name: Ismael Elsharkawi, Ahmed Sait, Silvio Giancola, Bernard Ghanem, Hossam Sharara, Abdelrahman Eldesokey

entry.summary: SoccerLens benchmark evaluates whether VLMs use meaningful visual evidence or spurious correlations for soccer video understanding, with structured visual cues at three levels of semantic relevance.

entry.title: DAP: Doppler-aware Point Network for Heterogeneous mmWave Action Recognition

author.name: Jiaying Lin, Shiman Wu, Jinfu Liu, Can Wang, Mengyuan Liu

entry.summary: DAP-Net addresses heterogeneous mmWave radar action recognition with a Doppler-aware network and introduces UniMM-HAR, the largest multi-source mmWave point cloud HAR dataset.

entry.title: MOTOR-Bench: A Real-world Dataset and Multi-agent Framework for Zero-shot Human Mental State Understanding

author.name: Xiaoyu Yuan, Niklas Heikkala, Tiina T\"orm\"anen, Hanna J\"arvenoja, Guoying Zhao, Haoyu Chen

entry.summary: MOTOR-Bench introduces a benchmark with 1,440 multimodal video clips for understanding human mental states in collaborative learning, labeled by educational experts. Evaluates state-of-the-art MLLMs on structured mental state analysis.

entry.title: DRIVE-C: A Controlled Corruption Dataset for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Shiva Aher

entry.summary: DRIVE-C is a controlled corruption dataset for evaluating visual perception robustness in autonomous driving, with 600 corrupted clips spanning 12 degradation types across five severity levels.

entry.title: Clip-level Uncertainty and Temporal-aware Active Learning for End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Riku Inoue, Shogo Sato, Kazuhiko Murasaki, Tomoyasu Shimada, Toshihiko Nishimura, Ryuichi Tanida

entry.summary: Proposes clip-level active learning for end-to-end multi-object tracking, formulating uncertainty at the clip level to align with modern transformer-based tracker architectures that operate on multi-frame clips.

entry.title: Hystar: Hypernetwork-driven Style-adaptive Retrieval via Dynamic SVD Modulation

author.name: Yujia Cai, Boxuan Li, Chenghao Xu, Jiexi Yan

entry.summary: Hystar uses a hypernetwork to dynamically adapt CLIP model weights via SVD perturbations for style-adaptive image retrieval, enabling robust performance across diverse query styles like sketches and artworks.

entry.title: BathyFacto: Refraction-Aware Two-Media Neural Radiance Fields for Bathymetry

author.name: Markus Brezovsky, Anatol G\"unthner, Frederik Schulte, Lukas Winiwarter, Boris Jutzi, Gottfried Mandlburger

entry.title: Increasing the Efficiency of DETR for Maritime High-Resolution Images

author.name: Tinsae Yehuala, Hao Cheng, Ville Lehtola

entry.summary: This paper leverages Vision Mamba backbones for efficient maritime object detection in high-resolution imagery, achieving linear scaling with sequence length for real-time detection on edge devices.

entry.title: BGG: Bridging the Geometric Gap between Cross-View images by Vision Foundation Model Adaptation for Geo-Localization

author.name: Wei Wang, Dou Quan, Ning Huyan, Shuang Wang, Yi Li, Pei He, Licheng Jiao

entry.summary: BGG adapts vision foundation models (DINOv3) for cross-view geo-localization between drone and satellite views through parameter-efficient adaptation that bridges geometric gaps.

entry.title: Automated Detection of Abnormalities in Zebrafish Development

author.name: Sarath Sivaprasad, Hui-Po Wang, Anna-Lisa J\"ackel, Jonas Baumann, Carole Baumann, Jennifer Herrmann, Mario Fritz

entry.summary: This paper introduces a large-scale zebrafish embryo development dataset with expert annotations for fertility classification and toxicity assessment, benchmarking automated detection of developmental abnormalities.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Semantic-Enhanced Diffusion Framework for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading

author.name: Yiqun Wang (Beijing Jiaotong University)

entry.title: Meta-Black-Box Optimization Can Do Search Guidance for Expensive Constrained Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Yukun Du, Haiyue Yu, Jiang Jiang, Shuaiwen Tang, Xiaotong Xie, Haobo Liu, Chongshuang Hu, Shengkun Chang

entry.title: Energy-Efficient Implementation of Spiking Recurrent Cells on FPGA

author.name: Pascal Harmeling, Florent De Geeter, Guillaume Drion

entry.summary: Presents an FPGA accelerator for spiking neural networks using Spiking Recurrent Cell neurons, with mathematical simplifications removing costly operations while maintaining biologically plausible dynamics.

entry.title: Model-Reference Adaptive Flight Control of the 95-mg Bee++

author.name: Francisco M. F. R. Gon\c{c}alves, Conor K. Trygstad, N\'estor O. P\'erez-Arancibia

entry.summary: Introduces MRAC architecture for positional tracking of the 95-mg Bee++ insect-scale flapping-wing aerial vehicle, demonstrated through real-time flight experiments.

entry.title: PECMAN: Perception-enabled Collaborative Multi-Agent Navigation in Unknown Environments

author.name: Tianchonghui Fang, Shaunak Roy, Shalabh Gupta

entry.summary: PECMAN extends SMART-3D tree morphing to multi-agent navigation with shared perception in unknown environments, using distributed tree repair and collaborative obstacle discovery.

entry.title: High Precision Hydraulic Excavator Control for Heavy-Duty Grading

author.name: Lennart Werner, Pol Eyschen, Sean Costello, Andrei Cramariuc, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Presents an autonomous controller for high-precision heavy-duty excavator grading that works across different hydraulic architectures (Load Sensing and Negative Flow Control) with a hydraulic-aware low-level loop.

entry.title: MVB-Grasp: Minimum-Volume-Box Filtering of Diffusion-based Grasps for Frontal Manipulation

author.name: Bibek Poudel, Abdul Basit, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: MVB-Grasp injects minimum volume bounding box geometric priors into diffusion-based grasp generation for frontal manipulation on workspace-constrained robots, improving success rates by filtering infeasible grasps.

entry.title: EFGCL: Learning Dynamic Motion through Spotting-Inspired External Force Guided Curriculum Learning

author.name: Keita Yoneda, Kento Kawaharazuka, Kei Okada

entry.summary: Proposes External Force Guided Curriculum Learning (EFGCL), inspired by spotting in gymnastics, where external assistive forces during training help legged robots learn dynamic motions like backflips without reward shaping or reference trajectories.

entry.title: VISOR: A Vision-Language Model-based Test Oracle for Testing Robot

author.name: Prasun Saurabh, Pablo Valle, Aitor Arrieta, Shaukat Ali, Paolo Arcaini

entry.summary: Proposes VISOR, a VLM-based automated test oracle for robot testing that replaces expensive human evaluations with automated assessment of task correctness and quality, going beyond pass/fail judgments of symbolic oracles.

entry.title: Decentralized Contingency MPC based on Safe Sets for Nonlinear Multi-agent Collision Avoidance

author.name: Max Studt, Georg Schildbach

entry.summary: Develops a decentralized contingency MPC framework for multi-agent collision avoidance with nonlinear dynamics that achieves collision-free motion under a state-only information pattern without trajectory communication between agents.

entry.title: Minimax Optimal Estimation of Transport-Growth Pairs in Unbalanced Optimal Transport

author.name: Donlapark Ponnoprat, Noboru Isobe, Masaaki Imaizumi

entry.summary: Studies minimax optimal estimation of transport-growth pairs in unbalanced optimal transport with quadratic cost and KL penalties, developing estimators that achieve optimal rates and proving matching lower bounds.

entry.title: A PAC-Bayes Approach for Controlling Unknown Linear Discrete-time Systems

author.name: Yujia Luo, Ye Pu, Jonathan H. Manton, Jingge Zhu

author.name: Yair Halberstadt

entry.summary: Argues that AI companies are already profitable on marginal serving costs (the cost per API call is below its price), and that infrastructure spending is investment rather than operational loss, countering narratives about unsustainable AI business models.

entry.title: [Linkpost] Language Models Can Autonomously Hack and Self-Replicate

author.name: Gunnar_Zarncke

entry.summary: As first reported in Reddit on Saturday, Linkpost to Palisade Research demonstrating that language models can autonomously self-replicate by exploiting web application vulnerabilities, with Qwen3.5-122B succeeding 6-19% and frontier models (Opus 4.6) reaching 81% success rates.

entry.title: OracleTSC: Oracle-Informed Reward Hurdle and Uncertainty Regularization for Traffic Signal Control

author.name: Darryl Jacob, Xinyu Liu, Muchao Ye, Xiaoyong Yuan, Pan He

entry.title: E-TCAV: Formalizing Penultimate Proxies for Efficient Concept Based Interpretability

author.name: Hasib Aslam, Muhammad Ali Chattha, Muhammad Taha Mukhtar, Muhammad Imran Malik, Andreas Dengel, Sheraz Ahmed

entry.title: Modular Retrieval-Augmented Generalization for Human Action Recognition

author.name: Peng Liao, Shangsong Liang, Lin Chen, Peijia Zheng

entry.title: Fast Training of Mixture-of-Experts for Time Series Forecasting via Expert Loss Integration

author.name: Btissame El Mahtout, Florian Ziel

entry.title: CapCLIP: A Vision-Language Representation Alignment Approach for Wireless Capsule Endoscopy Analysis

author.name: Haroon Wahab, Irfan Mehmood, Hassan Ugail

entry.title: Unified Modeling of Lane and Lane Topology for Driving Scene Reasoning

author.name: Han Li, Yulu Gao, Si Liu, Yuhang Wang, Bo Liu, Beipeng Mu

entry.title: Improving Temporal Action Segmentation via Constraint-Aware Decoding

author.name: Philippe Goulet Coulombe

author.name: Prasenjit Dhara, Daniel Romero

entry.title: Transfer Learning for Dead Fuel Moisture Prediction Using Time-Warping Recurrent Neural Networks

entry.title: Biological Plausibility and Representational Alignment of Feedback Alignment in Convolutional Networks

entry.title: Value-Decomposed Reinforcement Learning Framework for Taxiway Routing with Hierarchical Conflict-Aware Observations

entry.title: Yield Curve Forecasting using Machine Learning and Econometrics: A Comparative Analysis

author.name: Aman Singh, Tokunbo Ogunfunmi, Sanjiv Das

entry.title: From Single-Step Edit Response to Multi-Step Molecular Optimization

The approach improves data efficiency over oracle-in-the-loop methods.

entry.title: Hierarchical Causal Abduction: A Foundation Framework for Explainable Model Predictive Control

author.name: Dongdong Wang, Deepak Balakrishnan, Ravi Srinivasan, Shenhao Wang

author.name: Jiaxin Liu, Peng Yang, Yuping Li, Xinyue Xie

entry.title: Extrusion Segmentation Strategy to improve CAD Reconstruction from Point Cloud

author.name: Said Harb, Mehdi Maboudi, Markus Gerke

entry.title: Key Coverage Matters: Semi-Structured Extraction of OCR Clinical Reports

entry.title: Learning Unified Representations of Normalcy for Time Series Anomaly Detection

entry.title: Adaptive Data Harvesting for Efficient Neural Network Learning with Universal Constraints

author.name: Siteng Kang, Xinhua Zhang

entry.title: CrossVL: Complexity-Aware Feature Routing and Paired Curriculum for Cross-View Vision-Language Detection

author.name: Zhipeng Liu, Chunbo Luo

entry.title: Hyperbolic Distillation: Geometry-Guided Cross-Modal Transfer for Robust 3D Object Detection

author.name: Kanglin Ning, Wenrui Li, Houde Quan, Qifan Li, Xingtao Wang, Xiaopeng Fan

entry.title: HapticLDM: A Diffusion Model for Text-to-Vibrotactile Generation

author.name: Jiahao Xiong, Fei Wang, Anran Xu, Pinzhi Huang, Tao Wen, Lijia Pan, Cai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes HapticLDM, the first text-to-vibration diffusion model that converts natural language descriptions into haptic vibration feedback for applications in metaverse and gaming.

entry.title: Explainability of Recurrent Neural Networks for Enhancing P300-based Brain-Computer Interfaces

author.name: Anton Bazdyrev, Ivan Bashtovyi, Ivan Havlytskyi, Oleksandr Kharytonov, Artur Khodakovskyi

entry.title: Threat Modelling using Domain-Adapted Language Models: Empirical Evaluation and Insights

author.name: Saba Pourhanifeh, AbdulAziz AbdulGhaffar, Ashraf Matrawy

entry.title: BEACON: A Multimodal Dataset for Learning Behavioral Fingerprints from Gameplay Data

author.name: Ishpuneet Singh, Gursmeep Kaur, Uday Pratap Singh Atwal, Guramrit Singh, Gurjot Singh, Maninder Singh

entry.title: A Simulated Federated Analysis of MS-Induced Brain Lesions

author.name: Evelyn Trautmann, Jo\"el Federer-Gsponer, Markus C. Elze, Jos\'e-Tom\'as Prieto

entry.title: Social Determinants of Health and Fentanyl Overdose Mortality Across US Counties: An XGBoost and SHAP Analysis Identifying Silent Risk Counties and Treatment Deserts

author.name: Kabi Raj Tiruwa (Clark University), Abhisan Ghimire (Clark University), Anuj Kumar Shah (Yeshiva University)

entry.title: PHIDA: Persistence-Guided Node-to-Cluster Mapping for Online Clustering

author.name: Naoki Masuyama, Yusuke Nojima, Stefan Wermter, Yuichiro Toda, Hisao Ishibuchi, Chu Kiong Loo

entry.title: Trustworthy AI: Ensuring Reliability and Accountability from Models to Agents

author.name: Carol Xuan Long

entry.summary: A thesis presenting algorithms with theoretical guarantees for trustworthy ML systems spanning bias mitigation, content provenance, and LLM agent evaluation. Introduces kernel-based multiaccuracy methods and tools grounded in information theory and optimization.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Token Importance Estimation in Spiking Transformers

author.name: Wenxuan Liu, Zecheng Hao, Tong Bu, Yuran Wang, Zhaofei Yu

entry.title: From Regression to Inference: Meta-Learning Predictors for Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Liping Deng, MingQing Xiao

entry.title: A Controlled Diagnostic Study of Hardware-Induced Distortions in Hardware-Aware Training

author.name: Yunxuan Fang, Xinhe Wang

entry.title: FedCIGAR: A Personalized Reconstruction Approach for Federated Graph-level Anomaly Detection
